model_requirements.description: A United States title-insurance and settlement-services business serving residential purchase, refinance, home-equity, construction, and selected commercial real-estate transactions. Services include title-order intake, title search and examination, curative processing, underwriting, commitments, owner and lender policies, endorsements, closing, settlement, escrow, recording, property information, independent-agent oversight, premium remittance, and claims administration. Business is produced through direct branches, centralized lender channels, and independent title agents. The model must preserve evidence, provenance, effective-dated ownership interests, lifecycle history, and the legal and operational distinctions among searches, examinations, findings, requirements, exceptions, commitments, policies, settlement statements, and escrow ledgers.
model_requirements.business_domains: operations, property, underwriting, settlement, recording, agency, claim

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the title order record. Primary key for the title_order entity in the operations domain.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: References the independent title agent profile when the order is produced through the independent agent channel. Null for direct branch and centralized lender orders.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: order_channel_id
attributes.description: References the order channel through which this title order was received (direct branch, centralized lender, or independent agent).

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: References the parcel record associated with the subject property for this title order.

attributes.name: actual_closing_date
attributes.description: Date the transaction actually closed and funds were disbursed. Populated post-closing. Used for cycle-time analysis and comparison against scheduled closing date.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number assigned by the county assessor to uniquely identify the subject property for tax and recording purposes. Also known as PIN in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Property Information and County Data System

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the buyer (purchase) or borrower (refinance/HELOC). Restricted PII. Used for vesting, policy issuance, and NPPI-controlled workflows.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date the title order was cancelled, if applicable. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled'. Used for fallout analysis and pipeline reporting.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for order cancellation. Used for fallout root-cause analysis and pipeline management reporting.

attributes.name: closing_disclosure_form_type
attributes.description: Type of settlement/closing disclosure form required: Closing Disclosure (CD) for TRID loans, HUD-1 for pre-TRID or exempt, ALTA Settlement Statement, or none for non-applicable transactions.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; CFPB

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: County name where the subject property is located. Determines the recording jurisdiction and county recorder/register of deeds office for document submission.

attributes.name: cpl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) must be issued to the lender for this order. Required by most institutional lenders for independent agent closings.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the title_order record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for record provenance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Defaults to USD for domestic US transactions.

attributes.name: erecording_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether documents for this order will be submitted via eRecording (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording) rather than physical recording at the county recorder's office.
attributes.references: URPERA; County Recorder Requirements; eRecording Gateway

attributes.name: escrow_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the escrow officer or closing agent assigned to manage the escrow trust account and closing for this title order.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code identifying the county of the subject property. Used for county-level regulatory reporting, recording jurisdiction routing, and MERS reporting.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: iolta_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether escrow funds must be held in an IOLTA-compliant trust account for this order, as required by state bar rules in applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Bar Rules

tag_set.value: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Required Flag

attributes.name: lender_loan_number
attributes.description: Lender-assigned loan number for cross-referencing the title order with the lender's origination system. Required for TRID compliance and closing disclosure reconciliation.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the mortgage lender or financial institution ordering the lender title policy. Key party reference for lender channel routing and CPL issuance.

attributes.name: lender_policy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lender's title policy (LTP) is required for this order. Typically required by the mortgage lender as a condition of the loan.

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount in US dollars for which the lender title policy (LTP) will be issued. Drives lender policy premium calculation and LTV/CLTV analysis.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; ALTA Rate Manual

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the loan amount to the property sales price or appraised value, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 = 80%). Used for underwriting risk tier assignment and referral thresholds.

attributes.name: mers_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mortgage instrument must be registered with MERS. Applicable when the lender uses MERS as the mortgagee of record.

tag_set.value: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Reporting Required Flag

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Calendar date the title order was received and entered into the Title Production System. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP anchor for SLA and cycle-time measurement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by intake staff or processors regarding special instructions, lender requirements, or order-specific conditions.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable order number assigned at intake by the Title Production System (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest, Qualia). Used across all downstream modules.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: order_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the title order was received by the system, including timezone offset. Used for intraday SLA measurement and intake-to-search cycle-time analytics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the title order from intake through closing. Drives workflow routing and SLA tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_search|in_examination|commitment_issued|cleared_to_close|closed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: owner_policy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an owner's title policy (OTP) is required or requested for this order. Drives policy issuance workflow and premium calculation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: prior_order_number
attributes.description: Order number of a prior title order on the same property, if this order is a continuation, reissue, or refinance of a previous transaction. Supports chain-of-title and reissue rate credit.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; ALTA Rate Manual

attributes.name: production_source
attributes.description: Identifies the production channel source for this order: direct branch, centralized lender, or independent agent. Used for revenue attribution and channel performance reporting.

attributes.name: property_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the subject property for this title order. Denormalized here for operational convenience and search/reporting without joining to property.

attributes.name: property_city
attributes.description: City of the subject property. Used for jurisdiction routing, state filing, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: property_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the subject property. Drives state-specific underwriting rules, rate filings, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; NAIC; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: property_zip_code
attributes.description: Five- or nine-digit ZIP code of the subject property. Used for geographic risk segmentation, rate zone assignment, and county routing.

attributes.name: respa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RESPA requirements apply to this transaction, governing settlement service disclosures and affiliated business arrangements.

tag_set.value: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: ron_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Remote Online Notarization (RON) is authorized and enabled for the closing of this title order, subject to state law.
attributes.references: State Notary Laws; MISMO RON Standards

attributes.name: sales_price_amount
attributes.description: Contract purchase price of the subject property in US dollars. Used for owner policy premium calculation, LTV computation, and underwriting risk assessment. Null for refinance orders.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; ALTA Rate Manual

attributes.name: scheduled_closing_date
attributes.description: Anticipated closing date for the transaction as scheduled at order intake or updated during the order lifecycle. Drives closing readiness and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: seller_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the property seller. Restricted PII. Applicable to purchase transactions; null for refinance/HELOC. Used for chain-of-title and vesting verification.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: sla_commitment_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Commitment Due Date
attributes.description: Target date by which the title commitment must be issued per the applicable SLA for this order's channel and transaction type. Used for commitment issuance lag reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Lender SLA Agreements

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Commitment Due Date

attributes.name: title_examiner_name
attributes.description: Name of the title examiner assigned to perform the title examination and identify defects, encumbrances, and chain-of-title breaks for this order.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real estate transaction type driving this title order: purchase, refinance (REFI), home equity line of credit (HELOC), construction, or commercial.

attributes.name: trid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether TRID disclosure requirements apply to this transaction. True for most residential purchase and refinance loans; false for exempt transaction types.

attributes.name: underwriter_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the title insurance underwriter (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) backing the policies issued on this order. Drives premium split and remittance routing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the title_order record in the data platform. Used for change detection and incremental processing.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: party
products.description: Master entity for every natural person or legal entity participating in a title transaction. Stores identity attributes (name, entity type, tax-ID reference, contact information, address) without embedding a role.
products.reference: CRM / Order Routing Platform (Salesforce); Title Production System — Party module

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a party record in the title-insurance master party registry. Serves as the primary key across all title production, escrow, underwriting, and claims systems.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: party_code
attributes.description: Business-facing alphanumeric identifier assigned to the party by the title production system (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest, Qualia). Used for cross-system reconciliation and CRM lookup.
attributes.references: MISMO Party Data Standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the party record was first created in the title production or CRM system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX control evidence.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Birth date of a natural-person party. Used for identity verification, OFAC/FinCEN screening, and distinguishing same-name individuals in chain-of-title searches. Stored per GLBA NPPI controls.
attributes.references: GLBA; FinCEN; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or assumed name under which an organization operates, distinct from its legal entity name. Relevant for independent title agents and settlement service providers.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: Date of death for a natural-person party. Used to determine whether a conveyance occurred before or after death, which is critical for chain-of-title validity and estate underwriting.
attributes.references: ALTA Underwriting Guidelines; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: entity_formation_date
attributes.description: Date on which a legal entity was formally incorporated, organized, or registered. Used to verify the entity existed at the time of a conveyance for chain-of-title validity.
attributes.references: ALTA Underwriting Guidelines; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: entity_formation_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where a legal entity (corporation, LLC, trust) was formed or registered. Used to validate authority to convey and underwriting risk assessment for organizational parties.
attributes.references: ALTA Underwriting Guidelines; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the party, primarily used for lender, attorney, and independent agent communications where fax remains a standard document delivery channel.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of a natural-person party. Populated only when party_type is individual. Used for closing document preparation and NPPI-controlled communications.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: identity_doc_ref
attributes.description: Vault reference token pointing to the party's government-issued identity document (driver's license, passport) stored in the NPPI Vault. Required for RON/IPEN and closing identity verification.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; FinCEN; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: is_deceased
attributes.description: Indicates the party is deceased. Triggers estate/probate underwriting review, blocks new transaction role assignments, and preserves historical chain-of-title and claims records.
attributes.references: ALTA Underwriting Guidelines; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: is_do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates the party has opted out of marketing and non-essential communications. Enforced in CRM and title production system routing to comply with TCPA and CCPA opt-out requirements.

attributes.name: is_foreign_national
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a non-US citizen or foreign entity. Triggers FIRPTA withholding analysis, additional underwriting review, and FinCEN beneficial ownership disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IRS FIRPTA; FinCEN; ALTA Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: is_nppi_consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has provided consent for sharing Non-Public Personal Information (NPPI) with affiliated settlement service providers per GLBA privacy notice requirements.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Surname of a natural-person party. Used in grantor/grantee index searches and chain-of-title assembly. Retained for historical vesting even after legal name change.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party exactly as it appears on vesting instruments, deeds, or articles of incorporation. Used for title commitment Schedule A vesting and policy issuance.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; MISMO Party Data Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the party's mailing address (street number and name). Used for commitment and policy delivery, 1099-S mailing, and RESPA/TRID disclosure delivery.
attributes.references: GLBA; CFPB RESPA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the party's mailing address (suite, unit, apartment number). Supplements mailing_address_line1 for complete postal delivery.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City component of the party's mailing address. Required for RESPA/TRID disclosure delivery and IRS 1099-S reporting.
attributes.references: GLBA; CFPB RESPA; IRS; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the party's mailing address. Relevant for foreign national buyers, foreign lenders, and FIRPTA withholding determination.

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the party's mailing address. Used for geographic risk segmentation, premium tax filing, and USPS delivery validation.
attributes.references: GLBA; IRS; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the party's mailing address. Used for state-specific regulatory disclosure routing and premium tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: GLBA; State Departments of Insurance; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Marital status of a natural-person party at the time of the transaction. Drives spousal signature requirements, homestead rights analysis, and vesting options on title commitment Schedule A.
attributes.references: ALTA Underwriting Guidelines; State Departments of Insurance; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of a natural-person party. Required for grantor/grantee name matching in chain-of-title searches to distinguish parties with common first and last names.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile telephone number for the party. Used for SMS closing alerts, RON session links, and two-factor identity verification during electronic notarization.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to an individual party name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II). Critical for distinguishing same-name grantor/grantee pairs in chain-of-title searches.
attributes.references: MISMO Party Data Standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: nppi_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party provided or last renewed NPPI consent. Used to determine consent currency and trigger re-consent workflows per GLBA annual notice requirements.

attributes.name: ofac_screen_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the party was screened against the OFAC SDN list. Used to determine whether a re-screen is required before closing based on elapsed time thresholds.

attributes.name: ofac_screen_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent OFAC SDN screening for this party. A hit or inconclusive result blocks closing until underwriting review is completed.

attributes.name: ofac_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has been screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Required for FinCEN compliance and underwriting approval prior to closing.

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal entity name for organizations, trusts, estates, or government bodies. Populated when party_type is not individual. Used for vesting, lender identification, and agency agreement records.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the party record. Inactive or dissolved parties are retained for historical chain-of-title and claims analysis but excluded from active transaction routing.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as a natural person or legal entity. Drives vesting, signature, and NPPI handling rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|organization|trust|estate|government|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MISMO Party Data Standards; GLBA; CCPA/CPRA

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Party's preferred channel for receiving closing documents, commitment updates, and settlement communications. Drives automated delivery routing in the title production system.
attributes.references: CFPB TRID; GLBA; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the party used for closing coordination, commitment delivery, and TRID/CD disclosures. Classified as NPPI under GLBA for individual parties.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the party in E.164 format. Used for closing scheduling, RON/IPEN coordination, and identity verification callbacks.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Business-effective date from which this party record version is considered authoritative. Supports bi-temporal modeling for chain-of-title and ownership interest evidence provenance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: record_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party record version is superseded by a newer version. Null indicates the current active version. Supports SCD Type 2 history for party identity changes.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Party Data Standards

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate email address for the party, used when primary email is undeliverable or for routing copies of closing documents to a secondary contact such as a co-borrower or attorney.

attributes.name: source_system_party_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this party in the originating operational system (e.g., SoftPro contact ID, Salesforce Account ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and master data management.

attributes.name: tax_id_ref
attributes.description: Tokenized or vault reference to the party's Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Social Security Number (SSN). Actual value stored in the NPPI Vault per GLBA. Used for IRS 1099-S reporting and IOLTA compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the party record. Used for change-data-capture (CDC) processing, master data synchronization, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: How the party holds or will hold title to real property (e.g., joint tenancy, tenancy in common, community property). Populates Schedule A of the title commitment and drives survivorship and conveyance rules.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; MISMO Party Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: creation_date

products.name: party_role
products.description: Association entity assigning a party (party_id) to a specific contextual role on a specific title_order, enabling one party to hold multiple simultaneous roles (e.g., buyer and borrower, or seller and trustee) per VREQ-006.
products.reference: Title Production System — Party/Role module; ALTA party-role taxonomy

attributes.name: party_role_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party-role assignment record on a title order. Primary key of the party_role association entity.

attributes.name: cpl_issuance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CPL issuance record covering this party in this role. Populated when cpl_required is true and a CPL has been issued.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the person or organization assigned to this role on the title order.

attributes.name: superseded_by_role_party_role_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party_role record that replaced this assignment when a role was revised or transferred. Supports lifecycle transition and revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order on which this party holds the specified role. Anchors the role assignment to the production transaction spine.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the role assignment was formally accepted or confirmed by the relevant party or system. Distinct from execution, effective, submission, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: aml_screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent AML/OFAC screening was performed for this party in this role. Used for compliance audit and re-screening interval tracking.
attributes.references: FinCEN; Bank Secrecy Act; OFAC; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of AML/OFAC/FinCEN screening for this party in this role. Supports fraud controls and regulatory compliance for high-value and cash transactions.
attributes.references: FinCEN; Bank Secrecy Act; OFAC SDN List; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: authority_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the document establishing the party's authority (e.g., POA instrument number, trust agreement reference, letters testamentary). Links to document management system.

attributes.name: authority_type
attributes.description: Basis of authority under which the party acts in this role (e.g., self, power of attorney, trustee, executor, guardian, corporate officer). Drives curative and underwriting requirements.

attributes.name: party_role_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the role type, aligned with MISMO or ALTA role code conventions (e.g., BUYER, SELLER, BRRWR, LNDR). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: cpl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) must be issued naming this party in this role. Typically required for lender parties in lender-channel transactions.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party-role assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party-role assignment became legally or operationally effective. Distinct from execution, submission, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the party executed or signed the document or agreement establishing this role. Distinct from effective, submission, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party-role assignment expires or is no longer valid. Null for open-ended assignments. Supports effective-dated role history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: firpta_withholding_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act (FIRPTA) Withholding Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether FIRPTA withholding applies to this party in this role (typically seller parties who are foreign nationals). Drives escrow withholding and IRS reporting obligations.

tag_set.value: Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act (FIRPTA) Withholding Required Indicator

attributes.name: foreign_national_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a foreign national or foreign entity, triggering FIRPTA withholding requirements, FinCEN beneficial ownership reporting, and enhanced due diligence.
attributes.references: FIRPTA; FinCEN Geographic Targeting Orders; IRS Publication 515

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's identity was verified for this role assignment. Used for compliance audit trails and fraud control.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Framework Pillar 3; GLBA; FinCEN

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the party's identity for this role (e.g., in-person, Remote Online Notarization (RON), In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN), knowledge-based authentication).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Framework Pillar 3; RON State Statutes; FinCEN

attributes.name: identity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party's identity has been verified for this role assignment through an approved identity verification process (e.g., ID check, RON/IPEN verification).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Framework Pillar 3; GLBA; FinCEN

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is the primary holder of the role when multiple parties share the same role type on an order (e.g., primary borrower vs. co-borrower).

attributes.name: is_vesting_party
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party appears on the vesting (title-holding) instrument for the subject property. Critical for Schedule A vesting language and ownership interest tracking.

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Marital status of the party as relevant to vesting and spousal consent requirements. Required for community property states and certain title underwriting determinations.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Property Law; MISMO v3.4

attributes.name: notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering title-related notices and disclosures to this party in this role (email, mail, fax, portal, none). Supports TRID/RESPA disclosure delivery tracking.

attributes.name: nppi_vault_ref
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the NPPI Vault record holding sensitive identifiers (SSN/TIN, identity documents) for this party in this role. Actual NPPI is never stored here per GLBA/CCPA.
attributes.references: GLBA; CCPA/CPRA; ALTA Best Practices Framework Pillar 3

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Fractional ownership interest held by this party when vesting type is tenancy in common or similar. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Null for sole ownership.

attributes.name: party_capacity
attributes.description: Legal capacity in which the party acts in this role: individual (natural person), entity (corporation/LLC/partnership), trust, estate, government body, or other.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO v3.4; State Property Law

attributes.name: respa_affiliated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Affiliated Business Arrangement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party has an affiliated business arrangement (AfBA) with the title company in this role, requiring RESPA Section 8 disclosure.

tag_set.value: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Affiliated Business Arrangement Flag

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this party-role assignment, incremented each time the role record is materially updated. Supports lifecycle history tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: role_category
attributes.description: Broad grouping of the role type for reporting and routing: principal (buyer/seller/borrower), service_provider (agent/attorney/notary), lender, government, or other.

attributes.name: role_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or instructions specific to this party's role on the order (e.g., special handling instructions, POA limitations, trust restrictions). Not for NPPI.

attributes.name: role_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position when multiple parties share the same role type on a single order (e.g., co-buyer 1, co-buyer 2). Enables ordered display and processing of co-principals.

attributes.name: role_source_system
attributes.description: Originating system from which this party-role assignment was created or imported (e.g., title production system, CRM/order routing platform, lender portal, agency management system).

attributes.name: role_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this party-role assignment. Supports lifecycle transition tracking per VREQ-007 (active, inactive, superseded, withdrawn, pending).

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Contextual role the party holds on this title order (e.g., buyer, seller, borrower, lender, trustee, agent). One party may hold multiple simultaneous roles per VREQ-006.

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: External identifier for this party-role record in the originating system of record (e.g., SoftPro party ID, Qualia contact ID, CRM contact ID). Supports cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: spouse_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether spousal consent or joinder is required for this party's role in the transaction, based on marital status and state community property or homestead laws.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Property Law

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date this party-role assignment record was submitted into the title production system. Distinct from execution, effective, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: trid_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether TRID disclosures (Loan Estimate / Closing Disclosure) must be provided to this party in this role. Typically true for borrower parties on covered loan transactions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this party-role assignment record. Supports change detection and audit trail per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title ownership vesting for this party on the subject property (e.g., joint tenancy, tenancy in common, community property, trust). Populated when is_vesting_party is true.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Schedule A; State Property Law

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: title_search
products.description: Legally and operationally distinct entity representing the execution of a title search against public records and the title plant for a specific order. Captures search type (full, update, O&E, two-owner, 30-year), search vendor or plant source (DataTrace
products.reference: Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace / TitlePoint); ALTA search standards

attributes.name: title_search_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the title search record. Primary key for the title_search entity within the operations domain.

attributes.name: abstractor_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.party. Business justification: Links the title search to the party master for the abstractor who performed the search. Currently abstractor_name is stored as STRING (denormalized).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.jurisdiction. Business justification: Searches are performed against specific county recording offices. Jurisdiction determines plant coverage dates, recording fees, erecording capability, and turnaround times.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal description record used as the search boundary for this title search. Ensures search scope is tied to the correct metes-and-bounds or PLSS description.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parcel record against which this title search was executed. Supports chain-of-title assembly and property-level search history.

attributes.name: prior_search_title_search_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior title search on the same property or order, enabling update search linkage and chain-of-search provenance. Null for initial full searches.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title order that initiated this search. Links the search to the order lifecycle and channel routing context.

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number assigned by the county assessor. Used to locate the parcel in county tax and recorder indexes during the title search.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for search cancellation (e.g., order withdrawn, duplicate order, property changed). Populated only when search_status is cancelled.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the title search was cancelled, if applicable. Null when search was not cancelled. Supports cancellation rate and reason analysis.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the title search results were returned and marked complete. Used to calculate actual search turnaround time against SLA targets.

attributes.name: cot_break_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the chain-of-title break identified, including the gap period and missing instrument type. Populated only when cot_break_detected is True.

attributes.name: cot_break_detected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chain of Title (COT) Break Detected Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a break in the chain of title was identified during this search. True triggers escalation to examination and curative processing.

tag_set.value: Chain of Title (COT) Break Detected Indicator

attributes.name: cot_start_year
attributes.description: Earliest year from which the chain-of-title was assembled in this search. Supports COT completeness and break detection metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this title search record was first created in the data platform. Audit timestamp for data lineage and record provenance.

attributes.name: easement_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more easements (ROW, utility, access) were identified during the search. Easements are typically carried as Schedule B-II exceptions.

attributes.name: encroachment_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether an encroachment was identified during the search (e.g., from survey or prior instrument). May require survey endorsement or curative action.

attributes.name: gap_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the gap period, typically the actual recording date. Null until recording is confirmed. Supports gap coverage period duration and risk metrics.

attributes.name: gap_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the gap period between the search cutoff date and the anticipated recording date. Used to assess gap coverage risk and coordinate with the recording team.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: hoa_lien_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether a homeowners association (HOA) lien or delinquent assessment was identified during the search. Requires payoff letter or clearance before closing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State HOA statutes

attributes.name: instrument_count
attributes.description: Total number of recorded instruments (deeds, mortgages, liens, releases, etc.) identified and indexed during this title search. Supports evidence completeness metrics.

attributes.name: is_automated_search
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search was executed via an automated title plant system (e.g., DataTrace automated pull) versus a manual abstractor. Supports quality and cost analytics.

attributes.name: is_sla_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the title search exceeded its SLA target hours. True when completed_timestamp minus ordered_timestamp exceeds sla_hours_target.

tag_set.value: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Indicator

attributes.name: lis_pendens_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lis pendens (LP) was identified against the property during the search. True requires underwriting review before commitment issuance.

attributes.name: open_judgment_count
attributes.description: Number of open judgment liens against the property or vested owners identified during the search. Distinct from tax and mechanics liens for underwriting triage.

attributes.name: open_lien_count
attributes.description: Number of open or unresolved liens (tax, mechanics, judgment, HOA) identified during the search. Feeds unresolved defect and lien aging metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: ordered_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the title search was ordered or requested. Used as the start point for search turnaround and SLA cycle-time measurement.

attributes.name: ordered_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the title search was ordered. Supports intraday SLA tracking and search queue prioritization in the title production system.

attributes.name: plant_coverage_from_date
attributes.description: Earliest date covered by the title plant or public-record index used in this search. Defines the start of the chain-of-title (COT) period examined.

attributes.name: plant_coverage_to_date
attributes.description: Latest date covered by the title plant or public-record index used in this search. Defines the end of the COT period and the effective search cutoff.

attributes.name: prior_deed_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent vesting deed identified in the chain of title (WD, SWD, QCD, grant deed, trustee deed). Informs underwriting risk and coverage scope.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this search record. Incremented when a search is updated or supplemented. Supports lifecycle history and revision frequency metrics.

attributes.name: search_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount charged by the search vendor or abstractor for this title search. Used for vendor cost tracking, settlement statement line items, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: search_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the search fee amount. Defaults to USD for domestic transactions; retained for multi-currency reporting consistency.

attributes.name: search_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the title search period as specified in the search order. May differ from plant coverage dates when a specific lookback period is requested.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: search_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to this title search by the title production system (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest). Used in correspondence and audit trails.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: search_purpose
attributes.description: Transaction type driving the search request: purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction, commercial, or equity loan. Aligns search scope with underwriting requirements.

attributes.name: search_result_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the search result package stored in the document management and imaging system. Supports evidence completeness and provenance tracking.

attributes.name: search_source_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search was performed against a title plant, direct public records, an automated search engine, manual abstractor review, or a hybrid combination.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: search_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the title search. Drives clearance cycle-time metrics and search aging dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ordered|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold|failed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: search_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the title search period as specified in the search order. Represents the effective date through which public records were reviewed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: search_type
attributes.description: Classification of the search scope: full chain-of-title, update, Ownership and Encumbrance (O&E) report, two-owner, 30-year, or current-owner. Determines depth of plant/public-record review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: search_vendor_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the title plant or search vendor used to execute this search (e.g., DataTrace, TitlePoint, county plant). Supports vendor performance and cost tracking.

attributes.name: search_vendor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the title plant or search vendor that performed the search (e.g., DataTrace, TitlePoint). Retained for display and reporting when vendor code alone is insufficient.

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Due Date
attributes.description: Contractual or operational due date by which the title search must be completed. Derived from ordered_date plus channel SLA hours; stored for direct SLA breach detection.

tag_set.value: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Due Date

attributes.name: sla_hours_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Hours
attributes.description: Number of business hours within which the search must be completed per the applicable channel or product SLA. Enables SLA compliance reporting.

tag_set.value: Search Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Hours

attributes.name: source_system_search_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this search record in the originating title production system (e.g., SoftPro Select, RamQuest Horizon, Qualia). Supports system-of-record traceability.

attributes.name: tax_lien_found
attributes.description: Indicates whether a federal or state tax lien was identified against the property or vested owner during the search. Triggers requirement for payoff or release.

attributes.name: ucc_filing_found
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Filing Found Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a UCC filing was identified against the property or owner during the search. Relevant for commercial transactions and fixture filings.

tag_set.value: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Filing Found Indicator

attributes.name: vesting_deed_instrument_number
attributes.description: County recorder instrument number for the most recent vesting deed. Provides direct reference to the recorded instrument for evidence and provenance.

attributes.name: vesting_deed_recording_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent vesting deed was recorded in the county recorder's office. Establishes the effective date of current ownership in the chain of title.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO Title Standards

attributes.name: vesting_grantee_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantee (current vested owner) on the most recent vesting deed. Must match the seller/borrower identity for commitment issuance.

attributes.name: vesting_grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor on the most recent vesting deed as found in the grantor-grantee index. Used to verify current ownership and identify potential title defects.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: operations_title_examination
products.description: Legally and operationally distinct entity representing the examiner's review and analysis of search results for a specific title order. Captures examiner identity, examination date, examination status (in-progress, complete, referred), overall title
products.reference: Title Production System — Examination module; ALTA examination standards

attributes.name: operations_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the title examination record within the operations domain. Globally unique identifier for this examiner review event.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Title examinations performed by agent staff require agent context for oversight reviews, audit sampling, examiner quality tracking, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Title examiners analyze specific legal description versions to identify defects, chain-of-title breaks, and boundary issues.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the title examiner responsible for this examination. Supports examiner workload, performance, and cycle-time analytics.

attributes.name: prior_exam_operations_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior title examination record this examination updates or supersedes. Supports lifecycle revision history and bring-down examination traceability per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title order for which this examination was performed. Links the examination to the originating transaction spine.

attributes.name: title_search_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title search whose results are being examined. Preserves the legally distinct relationship between search assembly and examiner review.

attributes.name: cot_break_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the chain-of-title break identified, including the time period affected and the nature of the gap (missing deed, unrecorded conveyance, etc.).

attributes.name: cot_break_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the examiner identified a break or gap in the chain-of-title during this examination. Directly supports chain-of-title break metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: cot_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date in the chain-of-title reviewed during this examination. Establishes the historical depth of the title review for marketability analysis.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county or jurisdiction in which the subject property is located. Determines applicable recording requirements and county plant search standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this title examination record was first created in the data platform. Audit control field for record provenance.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of title defects, clouds, or encumbrances identified during this examination. Supports unresolved defect and lien metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: easement_count
attributes.description: Number of easements, rights-of-way (ROW), or CC&Rs identified during the examination. Supports encumbrance completeness and Schedule B-II exception population.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date through which the title examination is effective, i.e., the date to which the chain-of-title was examined. Distinct from examination_date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: evidence_completeness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required supporting evidence (deeds, releases, satisfactions, court orders) was available and reviewed during the examination. Supports evidence completeness metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: examination_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the examiner marked the examination complete or referred it. Paired with start timestamp to compute examination cycle time.

attributes.name: examination_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the title examiner completed or substantially performed the examination review. Principal business event date for cycle-time measurement.

attributes.name: examination_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this examination by the title production system (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest exam module). Used for cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: examination_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the examiner began the title examination in the production system. Used to calculate examination duration and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: examination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the title examination. Drives workflow routing: in_progress (active review), complete (exam finished), referred (sent to underwriter), on_hold, cancelled.

attributes.name: examination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the examination scope: full chain-of-title review, update/bring-down of prior exam, O&E (Ownership and Encumbrance) report, or gap period review.

attributes.name: examiner_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued license or certification number of the title examiner, where applicable. Supports regulatory compliance and examiner qualification tracking.

attributes.name: examiner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the title examiner who performed the review, captured at time of examination for historical accuracy independent of party record changes.

attributes.name: examiner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes entered by the title examiner summarizing findings, concerns, or curative recommendations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Total number of Schedule B-II exceptions identified during this examination. Supports unresolved exception and underwriting referral rate metrics.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county of the subject property. Used for jurisdiction-level reporting, plant access, and regulatory reporting alignment.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: gap_coverage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the examiner identified a gap period requiring gap coverage (GAPcure) between the search-through date and the anticipated recording date.

attributes.name: judgment_lien_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a judgment lien against the current owner or a prior owner was identified during the examination. Requires curative action before policy issuance.

attributes.name: lien_count
attributes.description: Total number of open liens (tax, mechanics, judgment, HOA, HELOC, etc.) identified during the examination. Supports unresolved lien metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: lis_pendens_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lis pendens (LP) was identified during the examination, signaling pending litigation affecting the property title.

attributes.name: mers_lien_detected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Lien Detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a MERS-registered mortgage or deed of trust was identified during the examination, requiring MERS-specific curative or release procedures.

tag_set.value: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Lien Detected

attributes.name: missing_evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any evidence items that were unavailable or incomplete at the time of examination, supporting evidence provenance tracking per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: open_lien_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount of all open liens identified during the examination. Supports lien severity and underwriting risk assessment. Currency: USD.

attributes.name: property_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the property jurisdiction. Determines applicable state title standards, examination requirements, and regulatory framework.

attributes.name: requirement_count
attributes.description: Total number of Schedule B-I requirements raised by this examination. Supports open and aging title requirements metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this examination record. Increments when the examination is updated or superseded, preserving the full revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why this examination was revised or superseded (e.g., new search results received, additional instruments found, examiner correction).

attributes.name: search_through_date
attributes.description: The date through which the underlying title search was run and upon which the examination is based. Defines the temporal boundary of the chain-of-title reviewed.

attributes.name: source_system_exam_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this examination record in the originating title production system (SoftPro, RamQuest, Qualia). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.

attributes.name: tax_lien_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a federal, state, or local tax lien was identified during the examination. Triggers curative requirement and potential underwriting referral.

attributes.name: title_opinion
attributes.description: Examiner's overall title opinion resulting from the examination: marketable, insurable, uninsurable, conditional (subject to requirements), or defective. Core underwriting input.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real estate transaction for which this examination was performed. Contextualizes the examination scope and applicable title standards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this title examination record was last modified in the data platform. Audit control field for change tracking and incremental load processing.

attributes.name: uw_referral_reason

attributes.references: GLBA (Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act); CCPA/CPRA; CFPB; Identity and NPPI Vault

tag_set.value: Non-Public Personal Information (NPPI) Data Sharing Permitted Flag

attributes.name: order_intake_method
attributes.description: Technical method by which orders are received through this channel: API integration, web portal, email, phone, fax, or EDI. Determines automation level and SLA baseline for order intake processing.
attributes.references: MISMO v3.4; CRM / Order Routing Platform (Salesforce-based)

attributes.name: premium_split_type
attributes.description: Indicates the premium revenue split model applicable to this channel: direct (100% retained by underwriter), agency (split with independent agent per agency agreement), or net_retained (net premium after agent remittance).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System; ERP / General Ledger and Finance System

attributes.name: production_source
attributes.description: Identifies the business production source model through which orders arrive: branch (direct office), lender_channel (centralized lender integration), independent_agent, consumer_direct, or wholesale. Aligns with ALTA production-source reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: remittance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium remittance to the underwriter is required for orders originating through this channel. True = remittance required (independent agent channels). Supports agency remittance timeliness metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: requires_agency_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether orders originating through this channel require a valid independent agent agreement on file before order acceptance. True = agency agreement mandatory (applies to independent agent channels).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: requires_cpl
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) must be issued for transactions originating through this channel. CPLs protect lenders against agent fraud or dishonesty. Mandatory for most lender and agent channels.
attributes.references: ALTA Closing Protection Letter Guidelines; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: respa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RESPA requirements apply to transactions originating through this channel. Governs settlement service provider disclosures, affiliated business arrangements, and kickback prohibitions.

tag_set.value: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: ron_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Remote Online Notarization (RON) closings are permitted for transactions originating through this channel. Drives closing coordination workflow and notary assignment logic.
attributes.references: MISMO RON Standards; State Departments of Insurance; CFPB

attributes.name: routing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (lower value = higher priority) used by the order routing engine to assign orders from this channel to processing queues, branches, or examiners. Supports SLA-driven workload balancing.
attributes.references: CRM / Order Routing Platform (Salesforce-based); Title Production System (SoftPro Select / RamQuest Horizon / Qualia)

attributes.name: sla_commitment_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Commitment Issuance Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from completed examination to title commitment issuance for this channel. Supports closing readiness and commitment revision frequency metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Commitment Issuance Hours

attributes.name: sla_intake_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Order Intake Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours allowed from order receipt to order acknowledgment/acceptance for this channel. Drives title clearance cycle-time SLA monitoring and operational reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; CRM / Order Routing Platform (Salesforce-based)

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Order Intake Hours

attributes.name: sla_search_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Title Search Hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from order acceptance to title search delivery for this channel. Used to measure and report title clearance cycle time by channel.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace / TitlePoint)

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Title Search Hours

attributes.name: sox_control_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether SOX internal controls over financial reporting apply to revenue and premium transactions originating through this channel. Supports ERP/GL audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ERP / General Ledger and Finance System

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of US state codes (e.g., 'CA,TX,FL') in which this channel is authorized to originate title orders. Null or 'ALL' indicates nationwide authorization. Supports state-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: supports_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is authorized to originate commercial real-estate title orders. True = commercial orders accepted. Commercial orders typically require elevated underwriting referral thresholds.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: supports_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is authorized to originate residential title orders (purchase, refinance, HELOC). True = residential orders accepted; False = residential orders not routed through this channel.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which this channel was suspended from accepting new orders. Null if channel has never been suspended. Preserves lifecycle transition history per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this channel was suspended (e.g., regulatory action, compliance failure, contract termination). Null if channel has never been suspended. Supports audit and lifecycle history.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance; SOC 2

attributes.name: trid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether TRID disclosure requirements (Closing Disclosure / Loan Estimate) apply to transactions originating through this channel. True for most residential purchase and refinance lender channels.
attributes.references: TRID (TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure) 12 CFR Part 1026; CFPB

attributes.name: underwriter_referral_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Liability amount in USD above which orders from this channel must be referred to the underwriter for risk review. Supports underwriting referral and exception rate metrics by channel.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System; ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this channel record. Incremented on each configuration change. Supports lifecycle revision history and prior classification preservation per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; SOC 2; Title Production System (SoftPro Select / RamQuest Horizon / Qualia)

attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.description: User or process that created this record
