products.name: service_level
products.description: Reference/master entity defining service-level agreements and turn-time commitments applied to title orders by channel, transaction type, and product tier.

attributes.name: service_level_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a service-level agreement record defining turn-time commitments for title orders by channel, transaction type, and product tier.

attributes.name: order_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order channel (direct branch, centralized lender, independent agent) to which this service-level agreement applies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA definition was formally approved for use. Distinct from effective_date; supports lifecycle revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operations manager or executive who approved this SLA definition. Supports governance and audit trail for SLA lifecycle management.

attributes.name: breach_penalty_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual penalty or credit applies when this SLA is breached. True for lender channel agreements with negotiated service credits.

attributes.name: breach_penalty_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the contractual penalty or service credit terms that apply upon SLA breach (e.g., fee waiver, rate reduction). Populated only when breach_penalty_applicable is true.

attributes.name: business_hours_end
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour) at which the business day ends for SLA measurement purposes (e.g., '17:00'). Used in conjunction with business_hours_start for cycle-time calculations.

attributes.name: business_hours_start
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour) at which the business day begins for SLA measurement purposes (e.g., '08:00'). Used to calculate business-hour turn-time compliance.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Production channel category for which this SLA is defined: direct branch, centralized lender, or independent agent. Mirrors the channel routing model in the CRM/order routing platform.

attributes.name: closing_disclosure_form_type
attributes.description: Settlement statement form type required for closings under this SLA: Closing Disclosure (CD), HUD-1, ALTA Settlement Statement (ALTA SS), or custom. Driven by TRID/RESPA applicability.
attributes.references: CFPB TRID; RESPA; HUD; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: closing_readiness_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from cleared requirements to confirmed closing readiness (CD/HUD-1/ALTA settlement statement prepared). Supports closing readiness metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: commitment_form_type
attributes.description: ALTA commitment form version or state-specific form required for commitments issued under this SLA (e.g., ALTA 2021, ALTA 2016). Governs Schedule A, B-I, B-II structure.
attributes.references: ALTA Commitment Form (2016/2021); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: commitment_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from examination completion to issuance of the title commitment (Schedule A, B-I, B-II). Drives commitment revision frequency metrics.

attributes.name: cpl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) must be issued to the lender for orders governed by this SLA. Typically required for centralized lender and independent agent channels.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service-level record was first created in the title production system. Audit field supporting SLA lifecycle and revision history tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: curative_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours allocated for curative action processing and clearance of Schedule B-I requirements. Supports curative action aging and effectiveness metrics.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this service-level agreement becomes binding and applicable to new title orders. Distinct from the record creation date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: erecording_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether eRecording via gateway (e.g., Simplifile, CSC) is required for orders under this SLA. Affects recording submission turn-time targets and rejection/resubmission tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder requirements

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of business hours before the total SLA target at which an at-risk order is escalated to a supervisor or account manager. Supports proactive SLA breach prevention.

attributes.name: examination_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from search delivery to completion of title examination and defect identification. Supports open and aging title requirements metrics.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA ceases to be applicable to new orders. Null for open-ended agreements. Supports lifecycle transition tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage (GAP) — insuring the period between search date and recording — is required for orders governed by this SLA. Common in lender channel agreements.

attributes.name: intake_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from order receipt to confirmed order intake/acknowledgment. Supports title clearance cycle-time metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: iolta_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether escrow funds for orders under this SLA must be held in an IOLTA-compliant trust account. State bar and regulatory requirement for attorney-closing states.
attributes.references: State Bar Rules; IOLTA regulations; ALTA Best Practices

tag_set.value: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Required Flag

attributes.name: ipen_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN) is permitted for closings governed by this SLA. Distinct from RON; state-specific authorization required.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the lender or lender channel for which this SLA is specifically negotiated. Null for generic SLAs not tied to a specific lender. Supports lender-specific cycle-time reporting.

attributes.name: lender_platform
attributes.description: Name of the lender integration platform (e.g., Encompass, Blend, SimpleNexus) through which orders governed by this SLA are received. Supports CRM/order routing platform alignment.

attributes.name: measurement_basis
attributes.description: Defines whether SLA turn-time targets are measured in business hours, calendar hours, business days, or calendar days. Critical for accurate cycle-time calculation and lender reporting.

attributes.name: policy_issuance_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from recording confirmation to issuance of owner (OTP) and lender (LTP) title policies. Supports policy issuance lag after recording metric per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: product_tier
attributes.description: Service tier classification applied to this SLA (e.g., standard, expedited, premium, bulk). Drives turn-time targets and pricing in the title production system.

attributes.name: recording_submission_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from closing to submission of documents to the county recorder/register of deeds via eRecording gateway. Supports recording rejection and resubmission rate metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder requirements

attributes.name: respa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RESPA requirements (HUD-1/CD, affiliated business arrangement disclosures) apply to orders governed by this SLA.

tag_set.value: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: ron_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether Remote Online Notarization (RON) is permitted for closings governed by this SLA. State-specific; affects closing coordination and document execution workflows.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; MISMO RON standards

attributes.name: search_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum number of business hours from order intake to delivery of completed title search and chain-of-title (COT) assembly. Key metric for clearance cycle-time analysis.

attributes.name: search_type_required
attributes.description: Minimum search type required for orders under this SLA: full chain-of-title search, two-owner search, update search, Ownership and Encumbrance (O&E) report, or title plant search.

attributes.name: search_years_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of chain-of-title history required for the title search under this SLA (e.g., 40 years for full search, 2 years for two-owner). Drives evidence completeness metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA; State Departments of Insurance; Marketable Title Acts

attributes.name: sla_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this service-level tier (e.g., SLA-REFI-LENDER-GOLD). Used in order routing and lender integration platforms.

attributes.name: sla_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scope, conditions, and special terms of this service-level agreement. Used for lender onboarding documentation and internal reference.

attributes.name: sla_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this service-level tier (e.g., 'Lender Gold Refinance 48-Hour'). Displayed in production system dashboards and lender-facing portals.

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this SLA record: active (in use), draft (pending approval), inactive (suspended), superseded (replaced by newer version), or expired (past end date).

attributes.name: sla_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this SLA definition, supporting lifecycle revision tracking (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Enables audit of prior SLA terms per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (FIPS) for the jurisdiction to which this SLA applies. State-specific regulatory requirements (e.g., state DOI rules) may drive different turn-time commitments.
attributes.references: FIPS 5-2; State Departments of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: superseded_by_sla_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Service Level Agreement (SLA) Code
attributes.description: SLA code of the newer version that replaced this record when status is 'superseded'. Enables forward-chaining of SLA revision history per VREQ-007.

tag_set.value: Superseded By Service Level Agreement (SLA) Code

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the jurisdiction or branch where this SLA is applied (e.g., 'America/Chicago'). Ensures accurate business-hour turn-time measurement across geographies.

attributes.name: total_order_hours_target
attributes.description: Maximum total business hours from order intake to policy issuance, representing the end-to-end title clearance cycle-time commitment. Primary SLA metric for lender channel reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real-estate transaction type to which this SLA applies: purchase, refinance (REFI), home-equity line of credit (HELOC), construction, or commercial.

attributes.name: trid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether TRID disclosure timing requirements apply to orders governed by this SLA. Drives CD issuance timing constraints and closing readiness targets.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this service-level record. Supports change detection and SLA revision frequency analysis in the silver layer.

attributes.name: uw_referral_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Liability amount in USD at or above which orders governed by this SLA require underwriting referral (UWR). Supports underwriting referral and exception rate metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA; State Departments of Insurance; NAIC

products.name: property
products.description: Authoritative SSOT master record for a real-property asset as a legally distinct entity separate from parcel and legal_description. Captures the property type (residential, commercial, condo, co-op, vacant land, construction), transaction type (purchase

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the real-property asset record. Primary key for the property master entity, consumed as a foreign key by parcel, legal_description, title_order, ownership_interest, and all downstream domain products.

attributes.name: prior_property_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the predecessor property record when this property was created from a split, merger, or re-platting event. Preserves chain-of-title continuity and lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: annual_tax_amount
attributes.description: Most recent annual property tax levy amount in USD as recorded by the county tax authority. Used in settlement statement (CD/HUD-1) proration calculations and escrow impound analysis.
attributes.references: County Tax Authority; RESPA; CFPB TRID

attributes.name: assessed_value
attributes.description: Most recent county assessor assessed value of the property in USD. Used as a reference data point for underwriting, policy amount reasonableness checks, and tax lien exposure analysis.

attributes.name: assessed_value_year
attributes.description: Tax year for which the assessed_value was determined by the county assessor. Ensures temporal accuracy when comparing assessed values across multiple tax years.

attributes.name: building_sqft
attributes.description: Total above-grade finished living area or building footprint in square feet as recorded by the county assessor. Supports AVM, underwriting, and policy coverage amount validation.

attributes.name: ccr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property is subject to recorded Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions (CC&Rs). CC&Rs are listed as Schedule B-II exceptions and reviewed for use restriction violations.
attributes.references: ALTA Schedule B-II; CC&R; State Property Law

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau census tract identifier for the property location. Used for HMDA/CRA regulatory reporting, fair lending analysis, and geographic risk segmentation.

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a break in the chain of title has been identified for this property during title examination. A True value requires curative action and underwriting referral before commitment issuance.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality in which the property is located. Used for jurisdiction determination, recording fee schedules, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: cloud_on_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the presence of an unresolved defect, encumbrance, or adverse claim that impairs the property title. Triggers underwriting referral and curative processing workflow.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the property location. Defaults to USA for domestic transactions; supports cross-border commercial title operations.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county or parish in which the property is located. Determines the recording jurisdiction, county recorder office, and applicable recording fees and transfer taxes.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; FIPS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the property master record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and record provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: easement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more recorded easements (e.g., utility, access, ROW) affect the property. Triggers Schedule B-II exception listing and potential ALTA endorsement requirements.
attributes.references: ALTA Schedule B-II; ROW; ALTA Endorsement 28

attributes.name: encroachment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a survey or examination has identified an encroachment onto or from the property. May require ALTA survey, curative action, or endorsement to insure over.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state + 3-digit county) uniquely identifying the county jurisdiction. Used for title plant indexing, recording submission routing, and regulatory geographic reporting.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: flood_zone_code
attributes.description: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood zone designation for the property (e.g., AE, X, VE). Informs underwriting risk assessment and mandatory flood insurance disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: flood_zone_determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current FEMA flood zone determination was made for this property. Required for RESPA flood zone disclosure compliance and underwriting file documentation.

attributes.name: hoa_annual_assessment
attributes.description: Annual HOA assessment amount in USD applicable to this property. Used in settlement statement proration and escrow impound calculations where HOA fees are escrowed.

attributes.name: hoa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property is subject to a Homeowners Association (HOA). A True value triggers HOA lien search, assessment verification, and potential title requirement for HOA estoppel letter.

attributes.name: hoa_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Homeowners Association governing the property. Required for HOA lien search, estoppel letter request, and CC&R review in the title examination process.

attributes.name: land_use_code
attributes.description: Assessor or county land use classification code describing the current use of the property (e.g., single-family residential, multi-family, commercial retail). Sourced from the Property Information and County Data System.
attributes.references: IAAO Standard on Mass Appraisal; County Assessor

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Supports spatial analysis, flood zone determination, and automated valuation model (AVM) inputs.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Supports spatial analysis, flood zone determination, and AVM inputs.

attributes.name: lot_size_sqft
attributes.description: Total land area of the property lot expressed in square feet as recorded by the county assessor. Used in underwriting risk assessment, AVM inputs, and survey comparison.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Estimated fair market value of the property in USD, sourced from an AVM, appraisal, or broker price opinion. Used for policy amount validation, LTV calculation, and underwriting risk assessment.

attributes.name: market_value_source
attributes.description: Source methodology used to derive the market_value (AVM, appraisal, broker price opinion, assessor, sale price, or other). Required for provenance tracking and underwriting file documentation.

attributes.name: marketable_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property currently holds a marketable title status based on the most recent title examination. A False value signals an open cloud on title requiring curative action before policy issuance.
attributes.references: ALTA; State Title Standards; Uniform Marketable Title Acts

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: Name of the incorporated municipality, township, or special district governing the property. Relevant for zoning, building permit history, and local transfer tax determination.

attributes.name: number_of_units
attributes.description: Count of residential or commercial units within the property structure (e.g., 1 for single-family, 4 for a quadplex). Determines applicable policy form and underwriting guidelines.

attributes.name: plat_book
attributes.description: Recorded plat book number or volume in which the subdivision plat map is filed with the county recorder. Used in legal description verification and chain-of-title assembly.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA

attributes.name: plat_page
attributes.description: Recorded plat page or folio number within the plat book where the subdivision map is filed. Used alongside plat_book for precise legal description and title plant cross-reference.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA

attributes.name: property_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the property master record. Tracks whether the property is active in the title plant, has been merged or split into other parcels, condemned, or demolished. Supports chain-of-title continuity.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: property_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real-property asset by use category (e.g., residential single-family, commercial, condominium, co-op, vacant land, construction). Drives underwriting rules, policy forms, and endorsement eligibility.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; MISMO Property Type

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this property record was originally sourced (e.g., title production system, title plant, county data system). Supports data lineage and provenance tracking.

attributes.name: source_system_property_ref
attributes.description: The native property identifier or file number assigned by the originating source system (e.g., SoftPro property ID, DataTrace property key). Enables back-reference to the system of record for reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the property is located. Governs applicable state insurance regulations, recording statutes, and title plant jurisdiction.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: street_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the property including house number, street name, unit/suite designator. Primary human-readable location identifier used in title commitments, policies, and settlement statements.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ALTA Schedule A

attributes.name: subdivision_name
attributes.description: Name of the recorded plat subdivision or development in which the property is located. Used in legal description assembly, title plant indexing, and CC&R identification.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA

attributes.name: tax_delinquency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has any outstanding delinquent property tax amounts as of the most recent tax search. A True value triggers a title requirement for payoff prior to or at closing.
attributes.references: County Tax Authority; ALTA Schedule B-I Requirements

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Tax year corresponding to the annual_tax_amount. Ensures correct proration period is applied in settlement calculations and identifies potential delinquency exposure.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real-estate transaction associated with this property record (purchase, refinance, home equity/HELOC, construction, commercial). Determines applicable TRID/RESPA disclosure requirements and title workflow.
attributes.references: CFPB TRID; RESPA; MISMO Transaction Type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the property master record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Year in which the primary structure on the property was originally constructed, as recorded by the county assessor. Used in underwriting risk scoring and AVM valuation.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: USPS ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the property location. Used for geographic risk segmentation, premium rating, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: zoning_code
attributes.description: Local government zoning classification assigned to the property (e.g., R-1, C-2, M-1). Relevant to underwriting review for use conformity, encroachment analysis, and commercial title risk.
attributes.references: Local Zoning Ordinances; ALTA Survey Standards

products.name: parcel

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the assessor parcel record within the title insurance platform. Primary key for the parcel entity.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the authoritative legal description record associated with this parcel. Supports the legally distinct legal_description entity per VREQ-004.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent property record. Links the assessor parcel to its associated property entity in the property domain.

attributes.name: acreage
attributes.description: Total land area of the parcel expressed in acres as recorded by the county assessor. Used for property valuation, underwriting risk assessment, and legal description verification.

attributes.name: annual_tax_amount
attributes.description: Annual real property tax amount billed for the parcel based on the assessed value and applicable tax rate. Used in settlement statement proration and escrow impound calculations.

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number assigned by the county assessor office. Primary external identifier used to locate the parcel in county tax and recorder systems.

attributes.name: assessed_improvement_value
attributes.description: County assessor's assessed value of improvements (structures) on the parcel, excluding land. Used with assessed_land_value for total assessed value and tax computation.

attributes.name: assessed_land_value
attributes.description: County assessor's assessed value of the land component of the parcel, excluding improvements. Used for tax calculation, underwriting valuation, and LTV analysis.

attributes.name: assessed_total_value
attributes.description: Total assessed value of the parcel (land plus improvements) as determined by the county assessor. Used for property tax billing and underwriting risk analysis.

attributes.name: assessment_year
attributes.description: Tax year for which the assessed values on this parcel record are applicable. Used to track annual assessment changes and historical valuation trends.

attributes.name: block_number
attributes.description: Block number assigned to the parcel within its recorded subdivision plat. Used with lot_number to form the platted legal description.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Full name of the county or parish in which the parcel is located as recognized by the county recorder or register of deeds office.

attributes.name: data_effective_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the parcel data in this record is current and authoritative. Used to track data currency for title search, examination, and ownership interest analysis.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code identifying the county in which the parcel is located. Used for jurisdictional routing, regulatory reporting, and county recorder integration.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: flood_map_panel_number
attributes.description: FEMA Flood Insurance Rate Map (FIRM) panel number applicable to the parcel. Used with flood_zone_code to identify the specific FIRM panel for flood determination documentation.

attributes.name: flood_zone_code
attributes.description: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood zone designation for the parcel (e.g., AE, X, VE). Used in underwriting risk assessment and lender flood insurance requirements.

attributes.name: hoa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parcel is subject to a Homeowners Association (HOA). A true value requires HOA lien search and assessment verification during title examination.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices / State HOA Statutes

attributes.name: hoa_name
attributes.description: Name of the Homeowners Association (HOA) governing the parcel. Used to identify the HOA for lien search, assessment demand, and CC&R review during title examination.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices / State HOA Statutes

attributes.name: land_use_code
attributes.description: Assessor land use code assigned to the parcel indicating the specific use classification (e.g., single-family residential, multi-family, commercial retail). Sourced from county assessor records.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the parcel centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for spatial analysis, flood zone determination, and property information services.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the parcel centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used with latitude for spatial analysis, flood zone determination, and mapping.

attributes.name: lot_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total lot area of the parcel expressed in square feet. Complements acreage for residential and commercial underwriting analysis and property information reporting.

attributes.name: lot_depth_ft
attributes.description: Depth of the parcel lot measured in feet as recorded by the county assessor or plat map. Used in legal description verification and encroachment analysis.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number assigned to the parcel within its recorded subdivision plat. Core component of the platted legal description used in title commitments and policies.

attributes.name: lot_width_ft
attributes.description: Width of the parcel lot measured in feet as recorded by the county assessor or plat map. Used in legal description verification and encroachment analysis.

attributes.name: mers_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Mortgage Identification Number (MIN)
attributes.description: 18-digit MERS Mortgage Identification Number associated with the parcel's registered mortgage. Used to identify and track mortgage assignments in the MERS registry during title search.

tag_set.value: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Mortgage Identification Number (MIN)

attributes.name: parcel_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the parcel as maintained by the county assessor. Reflects whether the parcel is active, has been merged into another parcel, split, or retired.

attributes.name: parcel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parcel by land use type as determined by the county assessor. Drives underwriting risk segmentation and policy coverage analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|agricultural|vacant|mixed_use|exempt — promote

attributes.name: pin
attributes.description: Parcel Identification Number as assigned by the county recorder or jurisdiction. May differ from APN in jurisdictions that maintain separate assessor and recorder numbering systems.

attributes.name: plat_book
attributes.description: Plat book number in which the subdivision map for this parcel is recorded at the county recorder's office. Used to locate the recorded plat for legal description verification.

attributes.name: plat_page
attributes.description: Page number within the plat book where the subdivision map for this parcel is recorded. Used with plat_book to locate the recorded plat instrument.

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Range designation within the PLSS grid (e.g., R5E). Used with township and section to form the PLSS legal description for rural and unplatted parcels.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the parcel record was first created in the title insurance platform. Supports audit trail and data provenance requirements per ALTA Best Practices and SOC 2.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the parcel record was last modified in the title insurance platform. Used for change detection, data refresh tracking, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: section_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Land Survey System (PLSS) Section Number
attributes.description: Section number within the Public Land Survey System (PLSS) township/range grid. Used for metes-and-bounds and PLSS legal descriptions in non-platted rural parcels.

tag_set.value: Public Land Survey System (PLSS) Section Number

attributes.name: situs_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the parcel's physical location (situs address) as recorded by the county assessor. Distinct from mailing address; used for property identification.

attributes.name: situs_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line for the parcel's physical location (unit, suite, building number). Supplements situs_address_line1 for multi-unit or complex properties.

attributes.name: situs_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the parcel's physical situs address as recorded by the county assessor. Used for jurisdictional routing and property information reporting.

attributes.name: situs_zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or ZIP+4 postal code of the parcel's physical situs address. Used for property information, tax routing, and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: source_system_parcel_key
attributes.description: Native parcel identifier from the originating Property Information and County Data System (e.g., DataTrace, TitlePoint). Used for lineage tracing and data refresh reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the parcel is located. Used for jurisdictional routing and state department of insurance reporting.

attributes.name: subdivision_name
attributes.description: Name of the recorded plat subdivision or development in which the parcel is located. Used in legal description assembly and chain-of-title analysis.

attributes.name: tax_account_number
attributes.description: Tax account number assigned by the county tax collector or treasurer for billing and collection of real property taxes associated with this parcel.

attributes.name: tax_delinquent_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of delinquent property taxes, penalties, and interest outstanding on the parcel. Populated when tax_delinquent_flag is true; drives title requirement and curative action.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector / ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_delinquent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parcel has delinquent property taxes as of the last data refresh. A true value triggers a title requirement for tax payoff prior to closing.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector / ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_exemption_type
attributes.description: Type of property tax exemption applied to the parcel by the county assessor (e.g., homestead, senior, veteran). Affects tax proration in settlement and underwriting analysis.

attributes.name: township
attributes.description: Township designation within the PLSS grid (e.g., T2N). Used with range and section to form the PLSS legal description for rural and unplatted parcels.

attributes.name: zoning_code
attributes.description: Municipal or county zoning designation for the parcel (e.g., R-1, C-2, M-1). Used in title examination to identify zoning encumbrances and compliance with permitted use.
attributes.references: Municipal Zoning Ordinance / ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: plss_township

attributes.name: superseded_date

products.name: ownership_interest
products.description: Effective-dated ownership interest record representing a vested ownership stake in a property held by a party (individual, trust, entity, or co-owner). Implements VREQ-005: ownership is modeled as a set of time-bounded interest records supported by
products.reference: COT (Chain of Title); O&E Report; Grantor/Grantee Index; ALTA Schedule A vesting

attributes.name: ownership_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an effective-dated ownership interest record representing a vested ownership stake in a property held by a party. Primary key per VREQ-005.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Each ownership interest is vested according to specific legal description. Critical for gap analysis when legal descriptions change (lot splits, consolidations).

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parcel entity that this ownership interest encumbers. Links the interest to the authoritative parcel record in the property domain.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (individual, trust, entity, or co-owner) holding this ownership interest. Supports VREQ-006 multi-role party modeling.

attributes.name: prior_interest_ownership_interest_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding ownership interest record in the chain of title. Enables linked-list traversal of the full ownership history.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent property entity. Provides the top-level real-property context for this ownership interest record.

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Nature of the transaction by which this ownership interest was acquired (e.g., purchase, gift, inheritance, foreclosure). Informs underwriting risk classification and chain-of-title analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; MISMO Real Estate Data Dictionary

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Deed book or volume number assigned by the county recorder where the instrument is indexed. Used in conjunction with page_number for traditional county plant lookups.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: chain_of_title_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential position of this ownership interest record within the chain of title (COT) for the parcel. Enables ordered traversal of ownership history and detection of chain-of-title breaks.

attributes.name: cloud_on_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the presence of a cloud on title — an outstanding claim, encumbrance, or defect that impairs the owner's ability to convey clear title. Triggers curative processing.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Purchase price or consideration stated on the conveying instrument in USD. Used for transfer tax calculation, underwriting risk assessment, and LTV analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; IRS; State Transfer Tax Regulations

attributes.name: consideration_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the consideration amount. Defaults to USD for domestic US transactions.

attributes.name: cot_break_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the nature of the chain-of-title break or gap identified at this interest record. Used by examiners to document curative requirements.

attributes.name: cot_break_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a break or gap exists in the chain of title at this interest record (e.g., missing link between grantor and prior grantee). Triggers curative action in the examination workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership interest record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and provenance tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ownership interest became legally effective, typically the recording date of the conveying instrument. Start of the effective-dated ownership period per VREQ-005.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the party holding this ownership interest (e.g., individual, LLC, corporation, trust). Drives authority and capacity verification requirements.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; MISMO Real Estate Data Dictionary

attributes.name: title_evidence_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recorded instrument or document that evidences this ownership interest (e.g., warranty deed, quit claim deed). Supports VREQ-005 evidence-backed ownership.

attributes.name: examiner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the title examiner regarding this ownership interest record, including observations about vesting, authority, or chain-of-title issues.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the conveying instrument (deed) was signed by the grantor. Distinct from effective and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ownership interest ended or was superseded by a subsequent conveyance. Null for currently active interests. Closes the effective-dated period per VREQ-005.

attributes.name: gap_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest record falls within a gap period (GAP) between the effective search date and the recording of the current transaction. Triggers gap coverage underwriting review.

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party receiving the interest (grantee) as it appears on the recorded instrument. Supports grantor/grantee index and chain-of-title assembly.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; GLBA; CCPA/CPRA

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party conveying the interest (grantor) as it appears on the recorded instrument. Supports grantor/grantee index and chain-of-title assembly.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; GLBA; CCPA/CPRA

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Official document or instrument number assigned by the county recorder at the time of recording. Used to retrieve the recorded instrument from the county index.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of recorded instrument conveying this ownership interest (e.g., Warranty Deed (WD), Quit Claim Deed (QCD), Special Warranty Deed (SWD)). Affects title insurance risk assessment.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; MISMO Real Estate Data Dictionary

attributes.name: insurable_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the title associated with this ownership interest is insurable by the underwriter, even if not fully marketable. Distinct from marketable title determination.

attributes.name: interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this ownership interest record. Active indicates current vested ownership; superseded indicates a prior record replaced by a subsequent conveyance.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the estate or interest held (e.g., fee simple, life estate, leasehold). Determines the nature and scope of the ownership right conveyed.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; MISMO Real Estate Data Dictionary

attributes.name: marketable_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the title associated with this ownership interest has been determined to be marketable (free from reasonable doubt as to validity). Set by the title examiner.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; State Marketable Title Acts

attributes.name: mers_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associated mortgage or deed of trust is registered with MERS (Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems), affecting lien holder identification in the chain of title.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Fractional ownership share held by this party expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.0000 for an equal co-owner). Must sum to 100 across all active interests for a parcel.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; MISMO Real Estate Data Dictionary

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Page number within the deed book where the instrument is recorded. Used with book_number for traditional county plant and title plant index lookups.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: prior_classification

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: servient_estate_description

attributes.name: width_ft

products.name: tax_assessment

attributes.name: tax_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax assessment record in the title insurance property domain. Primary key for the tax_assessment product.

attributes.name: parcel_id

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: annual_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total annual property tax levy billed for the parcel for the tax year, computed from net taxable value and tax rate. Used in settlement statement (CD/HUD-1) proration calculations.

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number assigned by the county assessor to uniquely identify the taxable parcel. Also known as PIN (Parcel Identification Number) in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: County Assessor; FIPS county parcel index; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: appeal_adjusted_value
attributes.description: Revised total assessed value as determined by the county appeals board following a successful appeal. Replaces total_assessed_value for billing if appeal is resolved.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assessment appeal was filed with the county appeals board. Populated only when appeal_flag is true.

attributes.name: appeal_flag

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assessment appeal was resolved by the county appeals board. Null if appeal is still pending.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the county assessor established the assessed value for this tax year. Represents the principal real-world event date for this assessment record.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assessment record: preliminary (not yet certified), certified (official), appealed (under formal appeal), adjusted (post-appeal change), or final.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment: annual (regular cycle), supplemental (triggered by ownership change or improvement), corrected, escaped (omitted prior year), or special district levy.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State Department of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: certified_date
attributes.description: Date the county assessor officially certified the assessment roll for this parcel and tax year. Marks transition from preliminary to certified status.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: data_as_of_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the assessment data was retrieved or last refreshed from the county assessor or property information system. Indicates data currency for title examination.
attributes.references: Property Information and County Data System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: delinquent_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding delinquent tax balance including penalties and interest as of the most recent update. A non-zero value triggers a title requirement for payoff at closing.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices; State tax code

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this assessment record is operative for billing and lien purposes. Distinct from assessment_date (valuation date) and lien_date (lien attachment date).

attributes.name: exemption_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of assessed value exempted from taxation (e.g., homestead, veteran, senior, or nonprofit exemptions). Reduces the net taxable value.
attributes.references: County Assessor; IRS; State tax code

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exemption applied to this assessment: homestead, veteran, senior, nonprofit, agricultural, or none. Affects net taxable value and lien exposure.
attributes.references: County Assessor; State tax code; IRS

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the state and county of the taxing jurisdiction. Used for jurisdictional routing and regulatory reporting.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: first_installment_amount
attributes.description: Amount due for the first installment of the annual property tax bill. Relevant for escrow proration and closing disclosure preparation.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; RESPA; CFPB; TRID

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the first installment of the property tax bill. Used to determine delinquency status and escrow disbursement timing.

attributes.name: improvement_assessed_value
attributes.description: County assessor's assessed value allocated to structures and improvements on the parcel, exclusive of land. Supports LTV and coverage analysis.
attributes.references: County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices; USPAP

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest charges accrued on delinquent taxes as assessed by the county tax collector. Included in payoff demand for title clearance.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; State tax code

attributes.name: land_assessed_value
attributes.description: County assessor's assessed value allocated to the land component of the parcel, exclusive of improvements. Used in underwriting and title risk analysis.
attributes.references: County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices; USPAP

attributes.name: lien_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property tax lien attaches to the parcel by operation of law. Critical for title examination to determine priority of tax liens relative to other encumbrances.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State tax code; County Assessor

attributes.name: net_taxable_value
attributes.description: Assessed value after deducting all applicable exemptions. This is the base upon which the tax levy is calculated by the taxing authority.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount paid against this tax assessment to date. Supports partial payment tracking and delinquency calculation.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property tax was paid in full or the most recent installment was paid. Used to confirm tax clearance at closing.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the tax bill: paid, unpaid, partial, delinquent, or in_redemption (tax sale redemption period). Drives title clearance and lien exception decisions.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices; State tax code

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty charges accrued on delinquent taxes as assessed by the county tax collector. Included in payoff demand for title clearance.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; State tax code

attributes.name: prior_year_assessed_value
attributes.description: Total assessed value from the immediately preceding tax year. Supports year-over-year valuation trend analysis and appeal basis determination.
attributes.references: County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices; USPAP

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax assessment record was first created in the title insurance data platform. Audit field for data lineage and provenance tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax assessment record was most recently updated in the title insurance data platform. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: redemption_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date by which the prior owner must redeem the parcel after a tax sale. After this date, the tax deed purchaser obtains clear title. Critical for title examination.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; State tax code; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: second_installment_amount
attributes.description: Amount due for the second installment of the annual property tax bill. Relevant for escrow proration and closing disclosure preparation.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; RESPA; CFPB; TRID

attributes.name: second_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the second installment of the property tax bill. Used to determine delinquency status and escrow disbursement timing.

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating county assessor or property information system (e.g., DataTrace, TitlePoint) from which this record was sourced.
attributes.references: Property Information and County Data System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: special_assessment_amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount of special assessments levied against the parcel (e.g., Mello-Roos CFD, local improvement district). Disclosed on the closing disclosure.

attributes.name: special_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a special assessment (e.g., Mello-Roos, improvement district, HOA assessment lien) is levied against the parcel in addition to general property taxes.
attributes.references: County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices; State tax code

attributes.name: tax_bill_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned tax bill or statement number issued by the county tax collector for this assessment year. Used for payment tracking and lien verification.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_district_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax rate area or tax district within the county that governs the composite mill rate applied to this parcel.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Composite tax rate (mill rate) applied to the net taxable value to compute the annual tax levy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.012500 = 1.25%). Includes all overlapping taxing districts.

attributes.name: tax_sale_date
attributes.description: Date of the tax sale at which the parcel was or is scheduled to be sold for delinquent taxes. Populated only when tax_sale_flag is true.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices; State tax code

attributes.name: tax_sale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parcel has been sold or is scheduled for sale at a tax sale due to delinquency. A true value is a critical title defect requiring curative action.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices; State tax code

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal year for which this tax assessment applies. Supports year-by-year valuation and payment history tracking per the SSOT mandate.
attributes.references: IRS; County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: taxing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary taxing authority (county tax collector or treasurer) responsible for billing and collecting property taxes for this parcel.
attributes.references: County Tax Collector; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: total_assessed_value
attributes.description: Sum of land and improvement assessed values as certified by the county assessor for the tax year. Authoritative valuation figure for tax billing and title underwriting.
attributes.references: County Assessor; ALTA Best Practices; USPAP

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing material lifecycle transitions and reclassifications for a property, parcel, or ownership interest per VREQ-007. Event types include: property type reclassification, parcel split/merge, legal description amendment, vesting
products.reference: COT lifecycle; Cloud on Title; Marketable Title; Insurable Title

attributes.name: lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each property lifecycle event record in the Property Information and County Data System.

attributes.name: easement_restriction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.easement_restriction. Business justification: Lifecycle events track easement and restriction changes (grants, releases, modifications).

attributes.name: encumbrance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.encumbrance. Business justification: Lifecycle events track lien recordings, releases, and encumbrance status changes. Direct FK to specific encumbrance record needed for complete lifecycle tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal_description entity affected by this event. Populated when the event involves a legal description amendment or replacement.

attributes.name: ownership_interest_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ownership_interest record created or superseded by this lifecycle event. Supports effective-dated ownership chain per VREQ-005.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parcel entity affected by this lifecycle event. Populated when the event is parcel-specific (e.g., parcel split/merge, APN reassignment).

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property entity that is the subject of this lifecycle event. Establishes the authoritative property context for the event.

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.recording_submission. Business justification: Lifecycle events track recording submission outcomes (acceptance, rejection, gap periods)—operational workflow for monitoring recording status, gap coverage periods, and policy

attributes.name: superseded_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the prior lifecycle event that this record supersedes or amends. Null for original events. Preserves revision history and prior classifications per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: tax_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.tax_assessment. Business justification: Tax assessment changes (supplemental assessments, appeals, tax lien filings) are material lifecycle events.

attributes.name: title_evidence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.title_evidence. Business justification: Lifecycle events are triggered by or documented through title evidence. Links the event to its source evidence document for provenance per VREQ-009 evidence and provenance

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order in the Title Production System (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest) that triggered or is associated with this lifecycle event. Supports end-to-end title workflow traceability.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the county recorder formally accepted the instrument for recording. Per VREQ-008, distinct from submission_date and recording_date. Null if not yet accepted or rejected.

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number assigned by the county assessor at the time of this lifecycle event. Captures the APN as it existed at event time, supporting parcel split/merge history.

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Official deed book or volume number assigned by the county recorder where the instrument is indexed. Used in conjunction with page_number for traditional county recording references.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event introduces or resolves a break in the chain of title. True signals a COT defect requiring curative action or underwriting review.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of consideration stated in the instrument evidencing this lifecycle event (e.g., purchase price on a deed). Used for transfer tax calculation and underwriting risk assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Audit field distinct from event_timestamp (the real-world event time).

attributes.name: curative_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event requires curative processing to clear a defect, lien, or encumbrance before title can be insured. Drives curative workflow initiation.

attributes.name: curative_status
attributes.description: Current status of curative processing for this lifecycle event. Tracks progress from identification through clearance or waiver. Null when curative_required is false.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the lifecycle change becomes legally effective for title and ownership purposes. Per VREQ-008, distinct from execution_date, recording_date, and other document date fields.

attributes.name: encumbrance_type
attributes.description: Type of encumbrance, easement, or restriction associated with this lifecycle event. Populated for encumbrance_attachment and encumbrance_release event types.

attributes.name: erecording_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the instrument associated with this lifecycle event was submitted and recorded electronically via an eRecording gateway (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; URPERA (Uniform Real Property Electronic Recording Act)

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for examiner or processor notes describing the nature, context, or significance of this lifecycle event. Supports curative and underwriting review workflows.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this lifecycle event (e.g., LE-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability and audit references.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of this lifecycle event record. Superseded indicates a later event has replaced this one; voided indicates the event was recorded in error.

attributes.name: event_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within an event_type (e.g., within vesting_change: joint_tenancy_to_tenancy_in_common, addition_of_co_owner). Free-form or controlled per event_type.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time the real-world lifecycle transition occurred or was legally effective. This is the principal business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the kind of material lifecycle transition captured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE

attributes.name: evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the supporting evidence document in the Document Management and Imaging System (e.g., scanned deed, recorded instrument image). Supports evidence provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the underlying instrument or document evidencing this lifecycle event was signed/executed by the parties. Per VREQ-008, distinct from effective_date and recording_date.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code identifying the jurisdiction where this lifecycle event was recorded. Supports county-level reporting and routing to the correct recorder office.

attributes.name: grantor_name

attributes.name: instrument_number

attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: lien_amount
