attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this lifecycle event record. Starts at 1 for the original event; increments with each amendment. Supports lifecycle history tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this lifecycle event record was revised or superseded (e.g., corrective deed recorded, APN reassigned by assessor). Required when revision_number > 1.

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this lifecycle event in the originating operational system (e.g., DataTrace event ID, Simplifile submission ID). Supports cross-system reconciliation and provenance.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument was submitted to the county recorder for recording. Per VREQ-008, distinct from acceptance_date and recording_date. Supports recording rejection and resubmission tracking.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Documentary transfer tax or deed stamp tax assessed on this lifecycle event by the county or state. Relevant for deed-type events; null for non-transfer events.
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change data capture, audit trails, and incremental processing.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: grantor_grantee_index
products.description: Index record linking a grantor party and a grantee party to a recorded instrument affecting a parcel or property, supporting grantor/grantee name-index searches as performed against the title plant and county recorder indices.

attributes.name: grantor_grantee_index_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each grantor-grantee index record linking a grantor and grantee party to a recorded instrument affecting a parcel or property.

attributes.name: grantor_grantee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the grantee (transferee, mortgagee, lienholder) named in the recorded instrument.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Each grantor/grantee index entry references specific legal description (property being conveyed).

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parcel record affected by the recorded instrument captured in this grantor-grantee index entry.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; FIPS county parcel standards

attributes.name: primary_grantor_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the grantor (transferor, mortgagor, lienor) named in the recorded instrument.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: prior_index_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding grantor-grantee index entry in the chain of title for this parcel, enabling linked-list traversal of ownership history.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property record associated with this grantor-grantee index entry, providing the authoritative property context for the instrument.

attributes.name: recorded_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recorded instrument (deed, mortgage, release, lien, etc.) that this grantor-grantee index entry indexes.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number as it appears on the recorded instrument or in the county index, used to link the index entry to the parcel record and support property-specific chain-of-title searches.
attributes.references: County Assessor standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Official deed book or volume number assigned by the county recorder where the instrument is physically or digitally recorded, used for traditional book-and-page citation.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: chain_of_title_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this index entry within the chain of title for the parcel, enabling ordered traversal of ownership history from earliest to most recent conveyance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of consideration stated in the instrument (e.g., purchase price on a deed). May be nominal ($1.00) or actual; used for transfer tax calculation and market value analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State transfer tax statutes; IRS Form 1099-S

attributes.name: consideration_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the consideration amount stated in the instrument. Typically USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: cot_break_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the nature of the chain-of-title break detected at this index entry, used by examiners to document the defect and initiate curative processing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: cot_break_flag
attributes.description: Indicates a detected break or gap in the chain of title at this index entry (e.g., grantor does not match prior grantee), triggering curative action or underwriting referral.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Chain of Title (COT) standards

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county or recording jurisdiction where the instrument was recorded, complementing the FIPS code for human-readable identification of the recording authority.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grantor-grantee index record was first created in the system of record, used for audit trail and data provenance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument becomes legally effective, which may differ from execution or recording date. Distinct from execution_date, recording_date, submission_date, and acceptance_date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: estate_type
attributes.description: Type of estate or interest conveyed by the instrument (e.g., fee simple, life estate, leasehold, easement), used to classify the nature of the ownership interest transferred.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State property law

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument was signed/executed by the grantor. Distinct from recording date, effective date, and acceptance date per VREQ-008 date separation requirements.

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code identifying the county where the instrument was recorded, used to route searches to the correct county recorder index and title plant.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: grantee_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grantee as an individual person or legal entity type, used to assess vesting capacity and taking title. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|trust|partnership|government|estate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State property law

attributes.name: grantee_name_as_indexed
attributes.description: Full name of the grantee exactly as it appears in the county recorder or title plant grantor-grantee index, preserving original spelling for chain-of-title search accuracy.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder name-index standards

attributes.name: grantee_name_standardized
attributes.description: Normalized/standardized form of the grantee name used for fuzzy matching and chain-of-title continuity analysis across index entries with spelling variations.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace/TitlePoint)

attributes.name: grantor_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grantor as an individual person or legal entity type, used to assess vesting capacity and authority to convey. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|trust|partnership|government|estate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State property law

attributes.name: grantor_name_as_indexed
attributes.description: Full name of the grantor exactly as it appears in the county recorder or title plant grantor-grantee index, preserving original spelling for chain-of-title search accuracy.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder name-index standards

attributes.name: grantor_name_standardized
attributes.description: Normalized/standardized form of the grantor name used for fuzzy matching and chain-of-title continuity analysis across index entries with spelling variations.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace/TitlePoint)

attributes.name: index_entry_date
attributes.description: Date this grantor-grantee index record was entered into the title plant or internal system, which may differ from the county recording date for plant-lag tracking.
attributes.references: Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace/TitlePoint); ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: index_source
attributes.description: Source system or authority from which this grantor-grantee index entry was obtained (e.g., county recorder direct, DataTrace title plant, TitlePoint). Supports evidence provenance tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant / Search Automation System (DataTrace/TitlePoint)

attributes.name: index_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this grantor-grantee index record. 'Superseded' indicates a corrected or amended instrument has replaced this entry in the chain of title.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant standards

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Official instrument number or document number assigned by the county recorder or register of deeds at the time of recording, used as the primary external reference for the recorded instrument.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of recorded instrument captured by this index entry (e.g., Warranty Deed (WD), Quit Claim Deed (QCD), Deed of Trust (DOT), mortgage, release, lien). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder instrument classification

attributes.name: lien_position
attributes.description: Priority position of the lien or encumbrance created by the instrument (1 = first lien, 2 = second lien, etc.), determined by recording date and any subordination agreements.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State lien priority statutes

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Original principal loan amount secured by the instrument (applicable to deeds of trust, mortgages, HELOCs). Used for lien priority analysis and Loan-to-Value (LTV) assessment.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; TRID; RESPA; MISMO

attributes.name: nominal_consideration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stated consideration is nominal (e.g., $1.00 or 'love and affection') rather than the actual market value, signaling a non-arm's-length transfer for underwriting review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State transfer tax statutes

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary's commission at the time of acknowledgment, used to verify the notary was duly commissioned when the instrument was executed.
attributes.references: State notary statutes; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Name of the notary public who acknowledged the grantor's signature on the instrument, as recorded in the acknowledgment clause. Used to verify proper execution.
attributes.references: State notary statutes; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Official page number within the deed book or volume where the instrument is recorded, completing the book-and-page citation used in chain-of-title references.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument was officially recorded by the county recorder or register of deeds. Distinct from execution date and effective date; establishes priority in the chain of title.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; VREQ-008; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: recording_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the instrument was stamped as recorded by the county recorder, used for priority determination when multiple instruments are recorded on the same date.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: release_instrument_number
attributes.description: Instrument number of the recorded release, reconveyance, or satisfaction that discharged the lien or encumbrance created by this instrument, if applicable.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: release_recording_date
attributes.description: Date the release, reconveyance, or satisfaction of the instrument was recorded, confirming the lien or encumbrance has been discharged from the chain of title.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the source system (county recorder, title plant, or eRecording gateway) for this index entry, used for reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Title Plant / Search Automation System; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile/CSC)

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state where the instrument was recorded, used for jurisdiction routing and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Documentary transfer tax or deed stamp tax amount paid at recording, as noted on the instrument face. Used for consideration verification and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State transfer tax statutes; IRS; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grantor-grantee index record was last modified in the system of record, supporting change tracking and lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: SOC 2; SOX; ALTA Best Practices; VREQ-007

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title vesting by which the grantee takes ownership (e.g., joint tenancy, tenancy in common, community property), critical for ownership interest modeling and survivorship analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State property law; MISMO

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

domains.name: underwriting
domains.description: Owns the title underwriting risk and policy lifecycle as legally distinct entities: title_finding, title_requirement (Schedule B-I), policy_exception (Schedule B-II), curative actions (CPM/GAPcure), underwriting referrals (UWR) and underwriting decisions
domains.references: ALTA Policy Forms / State DOI filing requirements

products.name: title_finding
products.description: Authoritative SSOT for every defect, encumbrance, lien, cloud, or anomaly discovered during title examination. Each record captures the finding type (tax lien, judgment lien, mechanics lien, LP, UCC, easement, encroachment, chain-of-title break, vesting
products.reference: ALTA Schedule B / Title Examination Finding

attributes.name: title_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each title finding record. Globally unique identifier assigned by the Title Production System upon discovery of a defect, encumbrance, lien, or anomaly during title examination.

attributes.name: operations_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the title examination session during which this finding was identified. Preserves provenance of the examiner review that produced the finding.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parcel record affected by this finding. Links the finding to the specific parcel (APN/PIN) in the Property Information and County Data System. Supports property-level defect and lien analysis.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title examiner (party) who identified and documented this finding during the examination. Supports examiner productivity and quality metrics. Maps to the party entity per VREQ-006.

attributes.name: title_evidence_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supporting document or recorded instrument in the Document Management and Imaging System that is the evidentiary basis for this finding. Supports evidence completeness and provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent title order under which this finding was discovered. Links the finding to the originating order intake record for end-to-end lifecycle traceability.

attributes.name: title_search_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the title search that surfaced the underlying instrument or record giving rise to this finding. Maintains evidence provenance from search through examination.

attributes.name: affects_full_parcel
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this finding affects the entire parcel or only a portion of it. When false, the partial_area_description field provides the specific affected area. Relevant for easements, encroachments, and partial liens.

attributes.name: book_volume
attributes.description: Book or volume number in the county recorder index where the instrument is recorded. Part of the official recording reference used to locate the instrument in the title plant or county records.

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the finding was resolved and cleared through curative action, payoff, release, or satisfaction. Null if finding remains open. Used to calculate curative cycle time and clearance effectiveness metrics.

attributes.name: cot_break_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this finding represents a break or gap in the chain of title (COT). A true value triggers mandatory underwriting review and curative action before commitment issuance. Key metric per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this title finding record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage and ingestion audit purposes.

attributes.name: curative_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this finding requires a curative action (CPM/GAPcure) to clear the defect before the title commitment or policy can be issued. Drives curative aging and effectiveness metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: curative_deadline_date
attributes.description: Target date by which curative action must be completed to meet the closing schedule. Used to identify aging and at-risk findings that may delay closing readiness. Supports closing readiness metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: curative_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting curative actions taken, outstanding items, and resolution steps for this finding. Maintained by the curative processor throughout the clearance lifecycle.

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Date the finding was identified during title examination. Represents the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Used to calculate curative aging and open-requirement aging metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: County recorder-assigned document or instrument number for the recorded instrument. Primary reference used in eRecording and title plant lookups (DataTrace/TitlePoint). May substitute or supplement book/page.

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the title defect, encumbrance, lien, cloud, or anomaly as documented by the examiner. Captures the specific nature of the issue including parties, amounts, and legal basis.

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the finding, typically assigned by the Title Production System (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest). Used in examiner notes, curative memos, and commitment schedules for cross-reference.

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the title finding. Drives open/aging requirement metrics and curative action tracking. Transitions from open through curative processing to cleared, excepted on Schedule B-II, or waived.

attributes.name: finding_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the title defect or encumbrance discovered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tax_lien|judgment_lien|mechanics_lien|lis_pendens|ucc_filing|easement|encroachment|cot_break|vesting_defect|hoa_lien|deed_of_trust|mortgage|cc_and_r|row|other —
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: gap_period_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this finding falls within the gap period between the effective date of the title search and the recording of the insured instrument. Triggers gap coverage (GAPcure) analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantee, creditor, or beneficiary on the instrument giving rise to this finding. Used in chain-of-title assembly and lien holder identification.

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor, debtor, or obligor on the instrument giving rise to this finding. Used in chain-of-title analysis and vesting verification. Not a direct personal identifier in the context of recorded public instruments.

attributes.name: instrument_date
attributes.description: Date the underlying instrument giving rise to this finding was executed or created. Distinct from recording date; used in chain-of-title analysis and lien priority determination.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of recorded or filed instrument that is the source of the finding (e.g., Deed of Trust, Warranty Deed, Quit Claim Deed, Judgment, Tax Certificate, UCC-1, Lis Pendens, Mechanics Lien).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the current active version of the finding record. Supports soft-delete and record versioning patterns in the Silver layer. False indicates the record has been superseded or logically deleted.

attributes.name: lien_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the lien, judgment, or monetary encumbrance associated with this finding. Applicable for tax liens, judgment liens, mechanics liens, HOA assessments, and mortgage/DOT balances. Null for non-monetary findings.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: lien_amount_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the lien_amount. Defaults to USD for domestic US title transactions. Included for completeness and potential commercial cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: lien_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank of the lien or encumbrance relative to other encumbrances on the property. Lower number indicates higher priority. Used in underwriting analysis and payoff sequencing at settlement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Page number in the county recorder index where the instrument is recorded. Combined with book_volume forms the complete recording reference for the source instrument.

attributes.name: partial_area_description
attributes.description: Legal or narrative description of the portion of the parcel affected by this finding when affects_full_parcel is false. Used for easements, encroachments, rights-of-way, and partial lien coverage analysis.

attributes.name: prior_classification
attributes.description: Previous finding_type or risk_classification value before the most recent reclassification. Preserves material prior classifications per VREQ-007 to support lifecycle history and audit trail without a separate history table.

attributes.name: reclassification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the finding was reclassified from its prior_classification to the current finding_type or risk_classification. Null if no reclassification has occurred. Supports lifecycle revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: reclassification_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for reclassifying this finding from its prior classification. Documents the examiner or underwriter rationale for the change to support audit and provenance requirements per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument was recorded or filed with the county recorder or register of deeds. Establishes constructive notice and lien priority in the chain of title. Distinct from instrument_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder; RESPA

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Underwriting determination of whether the finding renders title insurable, marketable, or requires curative action or referral. Supports insurable/marketable-title determination metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: schedule_b_disposition
attributes.description: Disposition of this finding on the title commitment Schedule B. A value of 'requirement' places it on Schedule B-I; 'exception' places it on Schedule B-II. Legally distinct per VREQ-002 and VREQ-017.
attributes.references: ALTA Commitment Form; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Underwriter-assigned severity level indicating the risk impact of the finding on insurability or marketability of title. Critical findings typically require curative action or underwriting referral before commitment issuance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this finding originated (e.g., SoftPro Select, RamQuest Horizon, Qualia, DataTrace, TitlePoint). Supports data lineage and SoR traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_finding_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier or reference number assigned to this finding by the originating operational system of record (e.g., SoftPro finding ID, RamQuest defect code). Enables reconciliation back to the SoR.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this title finding record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Used to detect stale records and track curative progress over time.

attributes.name: uw_referral_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this finding requires escalation to an underwriting referral (UWR) for senior underwriter review and approval before the commitment can be issued. Supports UW referral rate metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: title_requirement
products.description: SSOT for Schedule B-I requirements — the curative actions that must be satisfied before a title commitment can be issued or a policy can be written. Each record links to the originating title_finding, specifies the required action (payoff, release
products.reference: ALTA Commitment Schedule B-I

attributes.name: title_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the title requirement record (Schedule B-I item). Globally unique across all requirement records in the title production system.

attributes.name: operations_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title examination session during which this requirement was identified. Supports provenance tracing from examination to curative action.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Requirements often apply to specific parcels (tax liens, easements, boundary issues). Parcel-level tracking enables curative action targeting, Schedule B exception mapping by parcel

attributes.name: prior_requirement_title_requirement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing link to the previous version of this requirement record when a material revision occurred. Preserves lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title commitment on which this requirement appears as a Schedule B-I item. Null if requirement predates commitment issuance.

attributes.name: title_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific title finding (defect, lien, encumbrance, or cloud on title) that necessitated this Schedule B-I requirement. Core provenance link.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the originating title order that generated this Schedule B-I requirement. Links the requirement to its parent transaction context.

attributes.name: title_search_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.title_search. Business justification: Requirements often cite specific search findings (instrument references, recording dates).

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting referral record if this requirement triggered a formal UWR. Null when is_underwriter_referral is False.

attributes.name: added_to_commitment_date
attributes.description: Date this requirement was formally added to the title commitment as a Schedule B-I item. May differ from identified_date if added during a commitment revision.

attributes.name: applies_to_policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement applies to the owner policy (OTP), lender policy (LTP), or both. Supports owner-versus-lender coverage analysis per VREQ-010.
attributes.references: ALTA Commitment Form (2021); ALTA Owner and Loan Policy Forms

attributes.name: assigned_curative_processor
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal curative processor or title officer assigned to manage resolution of this requirement. Supports workload and aging analysis.

attributes.name: commitment_schedule_section
attributes.description: Identifies the commitment schedule section where this item appears. Title requirements appear in Schedule B-I (requirements to be satisfied before policy issuance).

attributes.name: confirmed_payoff_amount
attributes.description: Confirmed dollar amount from the payoff demand letter or lien release documentation. Supersedes estimated_payoff_amount once verified. Used for final settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: RESPA; CFPB TRID; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this title requirement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and curative aging baseline calculations.

attributes.name: curative_action_type
attributes.description: Specific curative action being taken to resolve this requirement (e.g., obtain payoff, order release, record document). Aligns with CPM/GAPcure workflow steps. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]

attributes.name: curative_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the Curative Processing Memo (CPM) associated with the resolution effort for this requirement. Links to document management system.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which this requirement must be satisfied to support the scheduled closing date. Used for curative aging and closing readiness dashboards.

attributes.name: estimated_payoff_amount
attributes.description: Estimated dollar amount required to satisfy this requirement (e.g., mortgage payoff, tax lien amount, judgment amount). Used for settlement statement preparation and escrow funding.
attributes.references: RESPA; CFPB TRID; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference (document ID or URL) for the evidence supporting satisfaction of this requirement (e.g., recorded release, payoff confirmation letter).

attributes.name: gap_coverage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage is required for this requirement, meaning the curative action must address the gap period between search date and recording date (GAPcure).

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantee on the instrument underlying this requirement. Used for chain-of-title verification and vesting confirmation.

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor on the instrument underlying this requirement (e.g., lender to be paid off, judgment creditor). Used for lien identification and payoff demand.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this requirement was first identified during title examination. Start point for curative aging calculations and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: instrument_reference
attributes.description: Recording reference (book/page, document number, or instrument number) of the recorded instrument underlying this requirement. Supports chain-of-title tracing.

attributes.name: is_active_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the current active version of the requirement. False for superseded versions retained for lifecycle history. Supports bi-temporal querying.

attributes.name: is_closing_condition

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage (GAP) is provided under this policy, insuring against defects arising in the gap period between commitment and recording.

attributes.name: insurable_title_flag

attributes.name: insured_name

attributes.name: insured_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insured party: individual person, legal entity (LLC/Corp), trust, estate, or government body. Drives vesting and coverage analysis.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the title policy was formally issued by the underwriter or issuing agent. Principal business event date for policy issuance lag metrics.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the lender/mortgagee insured under an LTP policy as shown on Schedule A. Null for OTP policies.

attributes.name: liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of coverage (face amount) for which the underwriter is liable under this policy. For OTP equals purchase price; for LTP equals loan amount.

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount secured by the insured mortgage, applicable to LTP policies only. Equals the LTP liability amount and is used for LTV and coverage analysis.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Lender-assigned loan number for the mortgage insured under an LTP policy. Used to cross-reference with lender systems and MERS registration.

attributes.name: marketable_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriter determined title to be marketable at the time of policy issuance. Supports insurable vs. marketable title determination tracking.

attributes.name: net_premium_amount

attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Rate Filings; NAIC

attributes.name: policy_exception_count
attributes.description: Number of Schedule B-II exceptions (policy_exception records) carried on this policy at issuance. Supports unresolved defect and exception rate metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: policy_form_code
attributes.description: ALTA or state-specific policy form identifier (e.g., ALTA 2021 Owner's Policy, ALTA 2021 Loan Policy, ALTA Homeowner's Policy 2013). Governs coverage terms.

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the recording_date of the insured instrument and the policy issue_date. Key metric for policy issuance lag after recording per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique policy number assigned by the underwriter or title production system (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest). Used for claims, endorsements, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the title policy. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, and captures cancellations or reissuances for revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Discriminates between Owner's Title Policy (OTP) and Lender's/Loan Title Policy (LTP). Owner and lender policies are stored as separate records with separate policy_type values per VREQ-010.

attributes.name: premium_amount

attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Rate Filings; RESPA

attributes.name: prior_policy_date
attributes.description: Issue date of the prior title policy referenced for reissue credit calculation. Required by state rate filings to validate reissue credit eligibility.

attributes.name: prior_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of a previously issued title policy on the same property, used to establish reissue credit eligibility and chain-of-coverage continuity.

attributes.name: production_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the policy was produced: direct branch, centralized lender channel, or independent title agent. Drives remittance, oversight, and performance metrics.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date the insured instrument (deed or mortgage) was recorded at the county recorder/register of deeds. Anchors the gap period and effective date. Distinct per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: reissue_credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar credit applied to the premium when a prior policy exists on the same property and a reissue rate is applicable. Reduces net premium charged.

attributes.name: reissue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy was issued at a reissue rate based on a prior policy. Triggers reissue credit calculation and prior policy validation.

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: Actual date the underwriter's premium share was remitted by the agent. Null if not yet remitted. Used to calculate remittance lag.

attributes.name: remittance_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the agent must remit the underwriter's share of the premium per the agency agreement. Used for remittance timeliness tracking.

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the underwriter premium remittance for this policy. Supports agency remittance timeliness metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: simultaneous_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy was issued simultaneously with a companion OTP or LTP policy on the same transaction, qualifying for a simultaneous issue rate discount.

attributes.name: source_system_policy_ref
attributes.description: Native policy identifier from the originating title production system (e.g., SoftPro Select, RamQuest Horizon, Qualia). Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the insured property is located. Governs applicable rate filings, policy forms, and regulatory reporting jurisdiction.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real estate transaction underlying the policy (purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction, home equity, commercial). Drives rate, form, and coverage selection.

attributes.name: underwriter_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the title underwriter (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) that backs this policy. Required for regulatory reporting and loss ratio analysis.

attributes.name: underwriter_premium_split_amount
attributes.description: Dollar portion of the net premium remitted to the underwriter per the agency agreement split schedule. Drives remittance timeliness metrics.

attributes.name: underwriting_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy required an underwriting referral (UWR) to the underwriter's home office or senior underwriter prior to issuance. Drives UWR rate metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: changed_by

attributes.name: valid_from

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)
