attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why this underwriting decision was revised from the prior version. Required when revision_number > 1 to preserve material lifecycle transitions per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Risk tier assigned by the underwriter based on defect severity, lien exposure, chain-of-title integrity, and other risk factors identified during examination.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this underwriting decision record originated (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest, Qualia). Supports data lineage and SoR traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_decision_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier of this underwriting decision in the originating source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and the title production or UW risk system.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the state in which the subject property is located. Determines applicable state insurance regulations and underwriting guidelines.
attributes.references: USPS State Codes; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real estate transaction for which the underwriting decision was rendered. Drives applicable risk standards and policy form selection.

attributes.name: underwriter_notes
attributes.description: Supplemental free-text notes entered by the underwriter, distinct from the formal decision rationale. May include internal guidance, caveats, or follow-up instructions.

attributes.name: uw_authority_level
attributes.description: Authority tier at which this decision was rendered. Tracks escalation path and ensures decisions are within the underwriter's delegated authority limits.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

domains.name: settlement
domains.description: Revenue-adjacent, customer-facing domain owning the closing and settlement lifecycle with settlement_statement and escrow_ledger kept as distinct, separate entities.
domains.references: CFPB TRID / ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 & 3

products.name: closing_order
products.description: Master record for a closing/settlement engagement, representing the scheduling and coordination of a closing event tied to a title order. Tracks closing type (purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction), closing method (wet-sign, RON, IPEN, hybrid)
products.reference: ALTA Closing/Settlement Coordination Record

attributes.name: closing_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the closing order record. Primary key for the settlement domain closing engagement entity.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agreement. Business justification: Closing orders produced under agency agreements require agreement reference for authority limit validation, geographic scope enforcement, transaction type authorization verification, and

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Closing orders produced by agents require agent identification for authority verification, CPL issuance validation, escrow authority enforcement, oversight review sampling, and

attributes.name: closing_escrow_officer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the escrow officer (EOT) responsible for managing trust funds and coordinating the closing. Supports IOLTA accountability.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules

attributes.name: closing_lender_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the lending institution funding this transaction. Drives lender-specific closing instructions, wire instructions, and CPL requirements.

attributes.name: cpl_issuance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CPL issuance record in the agency management system. Links closing order to the specific CPL issued for lender protection.

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow trust ledger associated with this closing order. Supports receipt-to-disbursement reconciliation and three-way trust accounting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; RESPA 12 CFR 1024

attributes.name: primary_closing_agent_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the closing agent or settlement agent conducting the closing. May differ from escrow officer in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Closing order is executed for a specific property. Currently closing_order links to title_order which links to parcel, but adding direct property_id FK strengthens the model by providing

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) prepared for this closing. Kept as a distinct entity per VREQ-003.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title commitment issued for this transaction. Drives closing-readiness validation against Schedule B-I requirements.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title order that initiated this closing engagement. Links the closing event to the upstream title production workflow.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_policy. Business justification: Closing orders track which policies were issued at closing for CPL coverage determination, gap coverage validation, post-closing audit trails, and agency remittance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_closing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the closing was actually executed (all documents signed). Distinct from scheduled time; used to measure closing cycle time and SLA adherence.

attributes.name: all_requirements_cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether all Schedule B-I title requirements have been satisfied and cleared prior to closing. Key closing-readiness gate control.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the closing order was cancelled. Used for pipeline fallout reporting and earnest money deposit disposition tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of the closing order. Populated only when closing_status is cancelled. Supports fallout analysis and pipeline reporting.

attributes.name: cash_to_close_amount
attributes.description: Net amount of funds the buyer must bring to closing after credits, deposits, and loan proceeds. Key figure on the Closing Disclosure under TRID.

attributes.name: cd_acknowledged_date
attributes.description: Date the borrower acknowledged receipt of the Closing Disclosure. Starts the mandatory 3-business-day waiting period under TRID.

attributes.name: cd_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date the Closing Disclosure (CD) was delivered to the borrower. TRID requires delivery at least 3 business days before consummation.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Production channel through which this closing order was originated. Determines agency remittance rules, CPL issuance authority, and premium split schedules.

attributes.name: closing_location_type
attributes.description: Type of physical or virtual location where the closing is conducted. Supports operational capacity planning and RON/IPEN compliance tracking.

attributes.name: closing_method
attributes.description: Execution method for document signing at closing. Wet-sign is traditional in-person; RON (Remote Online Notarization) and IPEN (In-Person Electronic Notarization) are electronic alternatives.
attributes.references: MISMO RON Standards; State Notary Laws

attributes.name: closing_readiness_status
attributes.description: Operational readiness state indicating whether all title requirements, funding conditions, and document preparation steps are satisfied for closing to proceed.

attributes.name: closing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the closing order. Drives closing-readiness dashboards and workflow routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|closed|cancelled|on_hold|pending_funding — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpl_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) was issued for this closing engagement. CPL protects the lender against escrow officer fraud or failure.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the closing order record was first created in the title production system. Audit trail anchor for lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this closing order. Defaults to USD for domestic US transactions.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which escrow funds were disbursed to payees (seller, lienholders, service providers). Must follow funding and recording per state good-funds laws.
attributes.references: State Good Funds Laws; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: earnest_money_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the earnest money deposit (EMD) held in escrow trust. Applied as a credit to the buyer at closing on the settlement statement.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The contractual effective date of the transaction (e.g., purchase agreement effective date). Distinct from execution, recording, and disbursement dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which closing documents were executed (signed) by all parties. Distinct from effective, recording, and disbursement dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: funding_date
attributes.description: Date on which loan proceeds were disbursed by the lender into the escrow trust account. Critical for disbursement authorization and gap coverage period calculation.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: gap_coverage_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the gap coverage period, typically the date of recording. Marks the close of the insured gap window.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage is required for the period between closing and recording. Relevant in states where simultaneous recording is not guaranteed.
attributes.references: ALTA Gap Coverage; State Title Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: gap_coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the gap coverage period, typically the date of closing/execution. Marks the beginning of the insured gap between closing and recording.

attributes.name: iolta_account_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the escrow trust account for this closing is an IOLTA account. Relevant for attorney-agent states with IOLTA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: IOLTA Program Rules; State Bar Regulations

tag_set.value: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Flag

attributes.name: lender_closing_instructions_date
attributes.description: Date on which lender closing instructions were received by the settlement agent. Used to measure lead time and closing preparation cycle.

attributes.name: lender_closing_instructions_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether lender closing instructions have been received and acknowledged by the settlement agent. A prerequisite for closing readiness.

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount being funded at closing. Used for LTV calculation, lender policy premium computation, and settlement statement line items.

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value ratio computed as loan amount divided by purchase price or appraised value. Used for underwriting risk assessment and lender policy coverage determination.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier for the closing engagement, used in lender, agent, and consumer communications. Sourced from the title production system (SoftPro/Qualia).

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether positive pay files were submitted to the escrow trust bank for check disbursements at closing. Supports ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5 reconciliation controls.

attributes.name: purchase_price_amount
attributes.description: Gross purchase price of the real property as stated in the purchase agreement. Base amount for premium calculation, transfer tax, and settlement statement preparation.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date the deed and/or deed of trust were recorded with the county recorder/register of deeds. Distinct from execution, funding, and disbursement dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: scheduled_closing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the closing event is scheduled to occur. Used for closing-readiness tracking and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: scheduled_closing_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time the closing appointment is scheduled, including timezone offset. Supports RON/IPEN session coordination and notary scheduling.

attributes.name: settlement_form_type
attributes.description: Type of settlement statement form required for this closing. CD (Closing Disclosure) applies under TRID; HUD-1 applies to pre-TRID or exempt transactions; ALTA Settlement Statement for cash/commercial.

attributes.name: three_way_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way escrow trust account reconciliation (bank balance vs. book balance vs. trial balance). Required under ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State Trust Accounting Rules

attributes.name: title_premium_lender_amount
attributes.description: Premium charged for the lender's title insurance policy (LTP). Separately tracked from owner premium per VREQ-010 and TRID disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: title_premium_owner_amount
attributes.description: Premium charged for the owner's title insurance policy (OTP). Feeds premium remittance calculation and agency split schedule.
attributes.references: State Rate Filings; ALTA Rate Rules

attributes.name: total_settlement_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total closing costs and settlement charges as reflected on the settlement statement. Supports TRID tolerance monitoring and consumer disclosure compliance.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real-estate transaction driving this closing. Determines applicable regulatory disclosures (TRID/RESPA) and settlement statement form (CD vs HUD-1 vs ALTA).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the closing order record. Supports change detection, incremental ETL, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: wire_instructions_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether wire instructions for disbursement have been independently verified per ALTA Best Practices fraud prevention controls. Actual wire details stored in NPPI Vault.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN Wire Fraud Guidance

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

products.name: settlement_statement
products.description: Legally and operationally distinct settlement statement record capturing the final financial accounting of a real estate closing. Stores statement form type (CD/Closing Disclosure, HUD-1, ALTA Settlement Statement), statement version and revision number
products.reference: ALTA/TRID Closing Disclosure (CD) / HUD-1 / ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the settlement statement record. Primary key for the settlement_statement entity in the Silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Settlement statements reference the legal description for property identification on HUD-1/CD forms and Schedule A consistency verification before closing; ensures settlement agent

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Settlement statements require specific parcel APN for property tax proration calculations, legal description Schedule A accuracy verification, recording jurisdiction determination, and

attributes.name: prior_statement_settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding version of this settlement statement. Enables full revision chain traversal and prior classification preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title commitment that underpins the closing. Ties the settlement statement to the underwriting commitment in force at closing.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order that initiated this closing transaction. Links the settlement statement to the originating order intake record.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_policy. Business justification: Settlement statements must reference the issued owner and/or lender policy for premium reconciliation, IRS 1099-S reporting, regulatory compliance, and post-closing audit trails.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement statement was accepted or approved by the lender or counterparty. Distinct field per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: cash_to_close
attributes.description: Net cash amount the borrower must bring to closing (or receive back) after all credits and debits are applied. Key closing-readiness metric. Positive = cash due from borrower; negative = cash back to borrower.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the real estate closing and settlement occurred. Principal business event date for the settlement transaction. Distinct from execution, effective, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: closing_location
attributes.description: Physical address or description of the location where the closing was conducted (e.g., branch office address, attorney office, remote/RON). Supports audit and notarization compliance.
attributes.references: ALTA; State notary laws; RON statutes

attributes.name: closing_method
attributes.description: Method by which the closing documents were executed. wet_sign = traditional in-person wet signature; ron = Remote Online Notarization; ipen = In-Person Electronic Notarization; mail_away = documents mailed for signature.

attributes.name: cpl_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) was issued for this closing. CPL protects the lender against settlement agent fraud or failure to follow closing instructions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement statement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting SOX and SOC 2 compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this settlement statement. Defaults to USD for domestic U.S. real estate transactions.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which escrow funds were disbursed to all payees following closing. May differ from closing date in refinance transactions due to rescission period. Distinct from closing_date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: earnest_money_deposit
attributes.description: Earnest money deposit amount credited to the borrower/buyer on the settlement statement. Reflects funds held in escrow prior to closing and applied at settlement.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Line 201; TRID 12 CFR 1026.38(j)(2); ALTA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement statement terms become legally effective. May differ from execution date in certain transaction types. Distinct field per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement statement was signed/executed by the parties. Distinct from effective, submission, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: gross_amount_due_borrower
attributes.description: Total gross amount due from the borrower at closing before credits and adjustments. Corresponds to Section 100 of HUD-1 or borrower-side summary on CD/ALTA statement.

attributes.name: hoa_dues_prorated
attributes.description: Prorated HOA dues credited or debited between buyer and seller at closing. Reflects the HOA assessment allocation through the closing date.
attributes.references: RESPA; ALTA Settlement Statement; HOA lien statutes

attributes.name: irs_1099s_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1099-S reporting is required for this real estate transaction. Driven by sales price threshold and seller exemption status.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-S; IRC Section 6045; IRS Publication 523

attributes.name: lender_title_premium
attributes.description: Premium charged for the lender's title insurance policy (LTP) as shown on the settlement statement. Supports premium revenue recognition and owner-vs-lender policy coverage metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR 1026.37(f)(2); ALTA LTP; State DOI rate filings

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount being funded at closing as stated on the settlement statement. Used for LTV calculation, premium computation, and lender policy coverage amount.

attributes.name: owner_title_premium
attributes.description: Premium charged for the owner's title insurance policy (OTP) as shown on the settlement statement. Supports premium revenue recognition and owner-vs-lender policy coverage metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR 1026.37(f)(2); ALTA OTP; State DOI rate filings

attributes.name: payoff_first_mortgage
attributes.description: Payoff amount for the existing first mortgage or deed of trust (DOT) being satisfied at closing. Includes principal, accrued interest, and per diem through disbursement date.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Section 500; ALTA Settlement Statement; MERS

attributes.name: payoff_second_mortgage
attributes.description: Payoff amount for any existing second mortgage or home equity line of credit (HELOC) being satisfied at closing. Null if no second lien exists.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Section 500; ALTA Settlement Statement; HELOC

attributes.name: production_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the title order and closing were produced. Drives agency remittance, premium split, and CPL applicability. direct_branch, centralized_lender, or independent_agent.
attributes.references: ALTA Agency Agreement; State DOI; RESPA

attributes.name: prorated_taxes
attributes.description: Property tax proration amount credited or debited between buyer and seller based on the closing date within the tax year. Disclosed on the settlement statement.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Section 400/500; ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS

attributes.name: real_estate_commission
attributes.description: Total real estate brokerage commission paid at closing, typically from seller proceeds. Disclosed on the settlement statement. Null for refinance transactions.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Line 700; ALTA Settlement Statement; NAR

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date on which the associated deed and/or mortgage instruments were recorded with the county recorder. Distinct field per VREQ-008. Supports policy issuance lag metric.

attributes.name: recording_fees
attributes.description: Total fees paid to the county recorder for recording the deed, mortgage/deed of trust, and any other instruments at closing. Disclosed as a zero-tolerance item under TRID.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR 1026.37(g)(1); RESPA; County Recorder fee schedules

attributes.name: rescission_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the borrower's right of rescission expires for refinance transactions under TILA. Disbursement is held until this date. Null for purchase transactions.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer revision counter for this settlement statement. Increments with each material change. Supports lifecycle history per VREQ-007 and TRID tolerance cure tracking.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the most recent revision to this settlement statement (e.g., changed loan terms, corrected fee, tolerance cure). Preserves material lifecycle transitions per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: sales_price
attributes.description: Contract purchase price of the real property as stated on the settlement statement. Applicable to purchase transactions. Null for refinance. Reported on Schedule A and IRS Form 1099-S.

attributes.name: seller_net_proceeds
attributes.description: Net amount disbursed to the seller after payoff of existing liens, commissions, and closing costs. Applicable to purchase transactions. Null for refinance.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1 Section 600; ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS Form 1099-S

attributes.name: settlement_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the settlement agent or escrow officer responsible for conducting the closing and preparing the settlement statement. Disclosed on the CD/HUD-1/ALTA statement.

attributes.name: settlement_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the settlement agent or escrow officer for conducting the closing. Disclosed on the settlement statement as a title service fee under TRID Section B or C.

attributes.name: statement_form_type
attributes.description: Regulatory form type used for this settlement statement. CD = Closing Disclosure (TRID/TILA-RESPA), HUD-1 = legacy RESPA settlement statement, ALTA = ALTA Settlement Statement for non-TRID transactions.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR 1026.38; RESPA 12 CFR 1024.8; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this settlement statement by the title production or escrow system (e.g., SoftPro file number suffix). Used for audit and regulatory reference.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the settlement statement. Tracks progression from draft preparation through final execution and any post-closing void or correction.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement statement was submitted to the lender or relevant party for review or approval. Distinct field per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: three_day_waiting_period_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandatory three-business-day waiting period between CD delivery and consummation was satisfied under TRID. Critical compliance flag for CFPB examination.

attributes.name: tolerance_cure_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any tolerance cure credit applied to the borrower due to TRID fee tolerance violations. Disclosed on the final CD. Zero if no cure was required.

attributes.name: total_closing_costs_borrower
attributes.description: Total closing costs charged to the borrower as summarized on the settlement statement. Includes origination charges, title fees, recording fees, prepaid items, and escrow reserves.

attributes.name: total_closing_costs_seller
attributes.description: Total closing costs charged to the seller as summarized on the settlement statement. Includes real estate commissions, seller-paid title fees, and payoff amounts. Null for refinance.
attributes.references: RESPA HUD-1; ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS Form 1099-S

attributes.name: total_credits_borrower
attributes.description: Total credits applied to the borrower's side of the settlement statement including earnest money deposit (EMD), seller credits, and loan proceeds. Corresponds to Section 200 of HUD-1.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the real estate transaction type. Drives applicable regulatory form requirements and settlement line-item structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|refinance|home_equity|construction|commercial — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and/or county real estate transfer tax or documentary stamp tax charged at closing. Allocated between buyer and seller per local custom and disclosed on the settlement statement.
attributes.references: RESPA; ALTA; State revenue codes; IRS Form 1099-S

attributes.name: trid_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether TRID disclosure rules apply to this transaction. True for most consumer mortgage transactions; False for cash, commercial, or exempt transactions requiring HUD-1 or ALTA form.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement statement record was most recently modified. Supports change detection, audit trail, and revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: wire_amount_borrower
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the wire transfer received from or sent to the borrower at closing. Sensitive financial data per VREQ-012. Reconciled against escrow ledger receipts.
attributes.references: VREQ-012; GLBA; FinCEN; ALTA trust accounting

attributes.name: wire_amount_lender
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the loan proceeds wire received from the lender at closing. Sensitive financial data per VREQ-012. Reconciled against escrow ledger receipts.
attributes.references: VREQ-012; GLBA; FinCEN; RESPA; ALTA trust accounting

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: escrow_ledger
products.description: Legally and operationally distinct escrow trust account ledger tracking every receipt and disbursement within the IOLTA/trust account for a specific closing.
products.reference: IOLTA / Escrow Trust Accounting Ledger (SoftPro Trust / RamQuest)

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the escrow trust account ledger record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Escrow ledgers managed by agents require agent identification for escrow authority verification, IOLTA compliance validation, three-way reconciliation oversight, trust account audit, and

attributes.name: cpl_issuance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CPL issuance record in the agency domain. Links the escrow ledger to the specific CPL protecting this closing.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow officer or trust officer responsible for managing this ledger and authorizing disbursements.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Escrow Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Escrow ledgers track funds for specific property transactions; essential for three-way reconciliation, trust accounting regulatory audits, and property-level escrow balance reporting

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA). Distinct from the escrow ledger per VREQ-003; linked for reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order that initiated this escrow ledger. Links the escrow trust account to the originating transaction.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_policy. Business justification: Escrow ledgers track premium collection and disbursement tied to specific policies for three-way reconciliation, agency remittance reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: actual_closing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the closing actually occurred and disbursements were authorized. May differ from scheduled_closing_date.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Reference to the direct branch, centralized lender channel, or independent agent office responsible for this escrow ledger.

attributes.name: buyer_funds_amount
attributes.description: Total cash-to-close funds received from the buyer/borrower into escrow, net of any earnest money deposit already credited.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: cpl_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Closing Protection Letter (CPL/Insured Closing Letter) was issued for this closing, protecting the lender against escrow officer fraud or misapplication of funds.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this escrow ledger record was first created in the system of record. Audit trail for record provenance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this ledger. Typically USD for US title transactions.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current book balance of the escrow trust account ledger (total receipts minus total disbursements). Should equal zero at ledger close.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules

attributes.name: disbursement_authorization_method
attributes.description: Method required to authorize disbursements from this escrow ledger (e.g., dual signature, single signature, electronic approval). Controls disbursement risk.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Escrow Regulations

attributes.name: emd_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the earnest money deposit received into escrow. Key component of the receipt-to-disbursement reconciliation for purchase transactions.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: emd_received_date
attributes.description: Date the earnest money deposit was received into the escrow trust account. Key milestone for purchase transactions.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: escrow_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the settlement/escrow agent for closing services, collected through escrow and disbursed to the title company.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this escrow ledger maps in the ERP/GL system for premium revenue recognition and financial reporting.

attributes.name: holdback_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld in escrow post-closing for a specific purpose (e.g., repair holdback, construction draw, or curative holdback). Released upon condition satisfaction.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; Lender Holdback Requirements

attributes.name: holdback_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the escrow holdback amount was or is scheduled to be released upon satisfaction of the holdback condition.

attributes.name: iolta_account_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trust account holding these escrow funds is an IOLTA account. Relevant for interest remittance to state bar foundation.

tag_set.value: Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA) Flag

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this escrow ledger record was most recently modified. Supports change detection and audit trail.

attributes.name: ledger_close_date
attributes.description: Date the escrow ledger was formally closed after all disbursements, reconciliation, and any holdback releases were completed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules

attributes.name: ledger_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this escrow trust account ledger, assigned by the escrow/trust accounting system (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting).

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the escrow ledger. Tracks progression from open through reconciliation and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|pending_close|closed|reconciled|voided|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the escrow ledger by transaction type: purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction, commercial, or home equity. Drives workflow and disbursement rules.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: loan_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: Amount of lender loan proceeds wired into the escrow trust account for disbursement at closing.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date the escrow trust account ledger was opened and funds were first authorized to be received for this closing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: out_of_balance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar variance identified during three-way reconciliation between the bank statement balance, book balance, and individual ledger balances. Zero when balanced.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Escrow Audit Requirements

attributes.name: out_of_balance_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for any out-of-balance condition identified during three-way reconciliation. Required for audit and remediation tracking.

attributes.name: payoff_amount
attributes.description: Total amount disbursed from escrow to satisfy existing mortgage(s), deed(s) of trust, or other liens on the property at closing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: positive_pay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this escrow trust account is enrolled in the bank's positive pay fraud prevention program for check disbursements.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; FinCEN Anti-Fraud Controls

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total recording fees collected through escrow for submission of deed, deed of trust, and other instruments to the county recorder.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; County Recorder Fee Schedules

attributes.name: scheduled_closing_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date on which the closing and final disbursement of escrow funds is expected to occur.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: seller_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds disbursed to the seller from escrow after payoff of existing liens, prorations, and closing costs.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: source_system_ledger_ref
attributes.description: Native ledger or file number assigned by the escrow/trust accounting system of record (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting, RamQuest). Supports SoR traceability.

attributes.name: three_way_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent three-way reconciliation was performed: bank statement balance vs. book balance vs. individual ledger balances.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Escrow Audit Requirements

attributes.name: three_way_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent three-way reconciliation. Indicates whether the bank statement, book balance, and individual ledger balances are in agreement.

attributes.name: title_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total title insurance premium collected through escrow for owner and/or lender policies, to be remitted to the underwriter per the premium split schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: total_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative gross amount of all funds disbursed from the escrow trust account for this ledger, including payoffs, proceeds, and fees.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: total_receipts_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative gross amount of all funds received into the escrow trust account for this ledger, including EMD, loan proceeds, and buyer funds.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and/or county transfer tax or documentary stamp tax collected through escrow and disbursed to the taxing authority at closing.
attributes.references: State Revenue Codes; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: trust_account_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the IOLTA/escrow trust account for this closing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules

attributes.name: trust_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number of the IOLTA/escrow trust account holding funds for this closing. Restricted per VREQ-012 and GLBA as sensitive financial account data.
attributes.references: GLBA; IOLTA Rules; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: trust_account_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing/transit number for the IOLTA/escrow trust account bank. Restricted per VREQ-012 as sensitive wire/bank instruction data.

attributes.name: wire_instruction_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether outgoing wire instructions for this escrow ledger have been independently verified per ALTA Best Practices wire fraud prevention procedures.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; FinCEN Wire Fraud Guidance

attributes.name: wire_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify outgoing wire instructions (e.g., phone callback to known number, secure portal confirmation, in-person). Supports wire fraud prevention audit.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; FinCEN Wire Fraud Guidance

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: disbursement
products.description: Individual disbursement record representing a single outgoing payment from the escrow trust account at or after closing. Captures disbursement type (payoff/reconveyance, seller proceeds, commission, recording fee, title premium, HOA assessment, tax
products.reference: ALTA Disbursement / Escrow Disbursement Record

attributes.name: disbursement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a single outgoing payment from the escrow trust account. Primary key for the disbursement record.

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow trust account ledger from which this disbursement is drawn. Links the disbursement to its parent escrow ledger for three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: payee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the disbursement recipient. Links to the party master for role-based access and NPPI protection of payee details.

attributes.name: payee_party_role_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.party_role. Business justification: Disbursements require role context (seller proceeds, lender payoff, vendor payment) for settlement statement line-item mapping, 1099-S reporting, and role-specific disbursement rules.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Disbursements are property-specific for 1099-S reporting, transfer tax jurisdiction determination, recording fee calculation by county, and settlement statement line-item validation against

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) that authorizes and documents this disbursement. Links disbursement to the closing disclosure line item.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order associated with this disbursement, enabling traceability from disbursement back to the originating transaction order.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_policy. Business justification: Disbursements for policy-related costs (endorsement fees, curative actions paid by underwriter, premium refunds) must link to the policy for cost allocation, loss ratio analysis

attributes.name: aba_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number for the receiving bank. Required for wire and ACH disbursements. Classified confidential as a partial banking identifier.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation J; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any post-issuance adjustment applied to the disbursement (e.g., correction, proration true-up, fee revision). Negative values indicate reductions. Zero if no adjustment.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the outgoing payment in the transaction currency. Represents the face value of the check or wire before any adjustments. Core monetary field for escrow reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA (12 CFR 1024)

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the disbursement was formally authorized by the escrow officer or closing manager. Distinct from the issued date; captures the approval event for audit trail.

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the escrow officer or authorized signatory who approved this disbursement. Required for dual-control and audit compliance under ALTA Best Practices.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: bank_account_ref
attributes.description: Vault reference token for the destination bank account used for ACH or wire disbursements, stored in the NPPI Vault. Actual account number is never stored in this table per VREQ-012.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; GLBA; PCI DSS

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the receiving financial institution for wire or ACH disbursements. Non-sensitive identifier used for routing verification and audit trail without exposing account details.

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the disbursement was confirmed as cleared by the bank (check presented and paid, or wire confirmed received). Used for three-way reconciliation and positive-pay matching.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; OCC Trust Account Guidance

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or branch code responsible for this disbursement. Used for branch-level P&L reporting and operational cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the disbursement record was first created in the escrow trust accounting system. Audit field for record provenance and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the disbursement amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency escrow accounts in commercial transactions.

attributes.name: disbursement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disbursement: pending (authorized but not yet issued), issued (sent), cleared (confirmed by bank), voided, returned, or stopped. Drives reconciliation and exception workflows.

attributes.name: disbursement_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the disbursement purpose (e.g., payoff/reconveyance, seller proceeds, commission, recording fee, title premium, HOA assessment).

attributes.name: escrow_trust_account_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific IOLTA or escrow trust bank account from which the disbursement is drawn. Supports multi-account escrow operations and three-way reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA Rules; State Bar/Insurance Dept Regulations

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which this disbursement is posted in the ERP/finance system. Supports premium revenue recognition, agent settlement, and AP/AR reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_gap_period_disbursement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement was issued during the gap period between closing and recording. True flags disbursements subject to gap coverage risk per title commitment terms.
attributes.references: ALTA Gap Coverage; Title Commitment Schedule B-I

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: Actual date the check was printed or the wire/ACH was initiated from the escrow trust account. May differ from scheduled date due to funding delays or corrections.

attributes.name: loan_payoff_amount
attributes.description: For payoff disbursements, the per-diem-adjusted loan payoff amount as confirmed by the lender's payoff statement. Null for non-payoff disbursements. Supports lien clearance verification.

attributes.name: memo
attributes.description: Free-text memo or description printed on the check or included in the wire/ACH addenda record. Describes the purpose of the disbursement for payee and audit reference.

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount disbursed after applying any adjustments to the gross disbursement amount. Used for final reconciliation against the escrow ledger balance.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable check or wire reference number assigned by the escrow trust accounting system (e.g., check number, wire sequence number). Used for positive-pay and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; OCC Guidance on Trust Accounts

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity receiving the disbursement as it appears on the check or wire instruction. Required for positive-pay and 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-S; GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: payee_tax_id_ref
attributes.description: Vault reference token for the payee's Tax Identification Number (TIN/SSN/EIN) stored in the NPPI Vault. Used for IRS 1099-S reporting. Actual TIN is never stored in this table.

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payee role in the transaction (e.g., seller, lender payoff, borrower, real estate agent/broker, HOA, taxing authority). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seller|lender|borrower|agent|broker|attorney|hoa|taxing_authority|title_company|other —

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to execute the disbursement: check, wire transfer, ACH, internal ledger transfer, or cashier's check. Drives positive-pay and bank reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; FinCEN BSA

attributes.name: payoff_good_through_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the lender's payoff statement through which the loan_payoff_amount is valid. Disbursement must be received by lender on or before this date to satisfy the lien.

attributes.name: positive_pay_exception
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank flagged this disbursement as a positive-pay exception (mismatch between issued check details and presented check). True triggers manual review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; OCC Fraud Prevention Guidance

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement has been submitted to the bank's positive-pay fraud prevention system. True if submitted; False if not yet submitted or not applicable (e.g., wire).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; OCC Fraud Prevention Guidance

attributes.name: recording_fee_jurisdiction
attributes.description: County or jurisdiction name to which a recording fee disbursement is directed. Null for non-recording-fee disbursements. Supports recording submission reconciliation.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: remittance_type
attributes.description: For premium-related disbursements, classifies the remittance category (e.g., title premium, agent split, underwriter split, CPL fee). Null for non-premium disbursements. Supports agency remittance reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Agency Agreement Standards; State DOI Remittance Rules

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date a returned check or ACH return was received by the escrow trust account. Null if not returned. Triggers re-issuance workflow and ledger reversal.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: NACHA ACH return reason code or bank-issued check return reason (e.g., R01 insufficient funds, R02 account closed). Null for non-returned disbursements.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: scheduled_disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the disbursement is authorized and scheduled to be issued from the escrow trust account, typically the closing date or a specified post-closing date.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA (12 CFR 1024.14)

attributes.name: settlement_statement_line_ref
attributes.description: Line item reference number or code on the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) that authorizes this disbursement (e.g., line 103, line 504). Enables traceability from disbursement to closing disclosure.
attributes.references: RESPA (12 CFR 1024); TRID (12 CFR 1026.38); ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this disbursement record in the originating escrow trust accounting system (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting, RamQuest). Enables lineage tracing and SoR reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this disbursement record was ingested (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest, Qualia). Supports multi-system lakehouse lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the disbursement record was last modified in the source system or lakehouse silver layer. Supports change detection and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date the disbursement was voided, if applicable. Null if not voided. A voided disbursement requires a corresponding reversal entry in the escrow ledger.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the disbursement was voided (e.g., stale check, incorrect amount, wire rejected). Required when disbursement_status is voided for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Bank-issued IMAD/OMAD or confirmation reference number for wire transfer disbursements. Null for check or ACH disbursements. Used to confirm wire receipt with receiving bank.
attributes.references: Fedwire Funds Service; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: wire_instruction_ref
attributes.description: Vault reference token pointing to the encrypted wire instruction record (bank name, ABA routing, account number) in the NPPI Vault. Actual banking details are never stored in this table per VREQ-012.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; FinCEN BSA; GLBA

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: wire_instruction
products.description: Master record for wire transfer instructions associated with a closing party (seller, borrower, lender, payoff lender, HOA, commission recipient). Captures beneficiary name, bank name, ABA routing number, account number (encrypted/tokenized per NPPI
products.reference: Wire Transfer / Disbursement Authorization (ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2)

attributes.name: wire_instruction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a wire transfer instruction record within the escrow and settlement system.

attributes.name: closing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order or closing file to which this wire instruction is associated, linking disbursement instructions to the settlement transaction.

attributes.name: disbursement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow ledger disbursement record that consumed this wire instruction when the wire was actually sent. Links instruction to execution.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (seller, borrower, lender, payoff lender, HOA, commission recipient) for whom this wire instruction is on file.

attributes.name: prior_instruction_wire_instruction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the previous wire instruction record that this record supersedes. Preserves the revision history and chain of custody for audit purposes.

attributes.name: aba_routing_number_token
attributes.description: Tokenized or encrypted ABA/routing transit number (9-digit) of the receiving bank. Stored as a token referencing the NPPI Vault; never stored in plaintext per GLBA and ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3.
attributes.references: GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN

attributes.name: account_number_token
attributes.description: Tokenized or encrypted beneficiary bank account number. Stored as a reference token to the NPPI Vault; never stored in plaintext per GLBA and ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3.
attributes.references: GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account to which the wire is directed (e.g., checking, savings). Required by some receiving banks for proper routing.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the escrow officer or supervisor who approved the wire instruction for disbursement.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wire instruction was formally approved for disbursement by an authorized escrow officer or supervisor.

attributes.name: bank_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the receiving bank branch. Required for domestic wire instructions and correspondent bank identification.

attributes.name: bank_city
attributes.description: City of the receiving bank branch used for wire routing verification and correspondent bank identification.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the receiving bank. Distinguishes domestic (USA) from international wire instructions.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the receiving financial institution where the beneficiary account is held. Used for wire routing verification.

attributes.name: bank_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the receiving bank branch per USPS/FIPS standards.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the wire beneficiary as it must appear on the outgoing wire transfer. Required for bank matching and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: GLBA; FinCEN; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason documented for changing or replacing a previously verified wire instruction (e.g., bank account change, payoff amount update). Required when is_change_request is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wire instruction record was first created in the escrow and trust accounting system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the wire amount. Defaults to USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the wire instruction was received from the party. Secure portal and encrypted email are preferred per ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2.

attributes.name: expected_wire_amount
attributes.description: Expected gross USD amount to be wired per the settlement statement or payoff demand. Used for pre-wire verification and positive-pay controls.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the wire instruction is no longer valid and must be re-verified before use. Supports fraud prevention and stale-instruction controls.

attributes.name: fraud_alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fraud alert or suspicious activity flag has been raised against this wire instruction (e.g., BEC/business email compromise indicators). Triggers enhanced review.
attributes.references: FinCEN; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; GLBA

attributes.name: fraud_alert_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of the fraud alert or suspicious activity associated with this wire instruction. Populated when fraud_alert_flag is true.

attributes.name: further_credit_account_token
attributes.description: Tokenized further-credit (FFC) sub-account number at the receiving bank. Stored as a token referencing the NPPI Vault.

attributes.name: further_credit_name
attributes.description: Name on the further-credit (FFC) sub-account when the wire must be credited to a sub-account at the receiving bank (common for lender payoffs and HOA accounts).

attributes.name: instruction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible reference number assigned to this wire instruction record by the escrow or trust accounting system (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting).

attributes.name: instruction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wire instruction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_verification|verified|approved|used|cancelled|expired — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: intermediary_aba_token
attributes.description: Tokenized ABA routing number of the intermediary (correspondent) bank. Stored as a token referencing the NPPI Vault.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the intermediary (correspondent) bank required when the receiving bank cannot accept wires directly. Used for complex domestic or international routing.

attributes.name: is_change_request
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wire instruction record represents a change or update to a previously verified instruction. Change requests require re-verification per ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 fraud controls.

attributes.name: nppi_vault_ref
attributes.description: Token or reference key pointing to the encrypted NPPI Vault record that holds the plaintext ABA routing number and account number for this wire instruction per GLBA and ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3.
attributes.references: GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; CCPA/CPRA

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Role of the party in the closing transaction for whom this wire instruction applies (e.g., seller proceeds, borrower refund, payoff lender). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seller|borrower|lender|payoff_lender|hoa|commission_recipient|other — promote to reference

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wire instruction has been submitted to the bank positive-pay or wire-confirmation system prior to disbursement. Supports escrow trust account controls.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wire instruction was first received from the party (via secure email, portal, or in-person). Establishes the start of the verification workflow.

attributes.name: source_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system link to the original wire instruction document (e.g., signed wire authorization form, secure portal submission record) stored in the Document Management and Imaging System.

attributes.name: swift_bic_code
attributes.description: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for international wire transfers. Required when bank_country_code is not USA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wire instruction record was last modified. Supports audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to independently verify the wire instructions prior to disbursement (e.g., callback to known number, secure portal submission). Supports ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 fraud controls.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wire instruction was independently verified by the escrow officer per ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 callback or secure-channel protocol.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the escrow officer or staff member who completed the independent verification of the wire instructions.

attributes.name: wire_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose of the wire disbursement as it relates to the closing (e.g., seller proceeds, mortgage payoff, EMD). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seller_proceeds|payoff|earnest_money|commission|tax_proration|hoa_dues|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wire_reference_memo
attributes.description: Free-text reference or memo line to be included on the outgoing wire (e.g., loan number, file number, property address). Assists receiving bank in applying the funds.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
