products.name: premium_charge
products.description: Transactional record capturing the title insurance premium and related fee charges calculated and assessed at closing for a specific transaction. Tracks charge type (OTP owner title premium, LTP lender title premium, endorsement fee, search fee, exam fee
products.reference: ALTA Premium / Title Insurance Rate Schedule

attributes.name: premium_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a premium charge record within the title insurance settlement system.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Premium charges require agent identification for premium split calculation, agent remittance reconciliation, and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: endorsement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ALTA endorsement for which this charge is assessed. Populated only when charge_type is endorsement fee.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Premium rate schedules vary by county FIPS code and tax district; parcel_id provides jurisdiction for accurate rate application, simultaneous issue determination, and county-specific

attributes.name: premium_split_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.premium_split_schedule. Business justification: Premium charges must reference the applicable split schedule to determine agent versus underwriter premium shares.

attributes.name: prior_version_charge_premium_charge_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous version of this charge record when a revision or adjustment has been made, preserving the full revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Premium rate schedules vary by property transaction type, jurisdiction, and assessed value; required for accurate rate application, reissue credit calculation, and revenue recognition by

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) on which this charge appears, linking the charge to the closing disclosure.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order for which this premium or fee charge is assessed, linking the charge to the originating transaction.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title policy (owner or lender) for which this premium charge is assessed. Null for non-policy charges such as search or exam fees.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustment applied to the base premium, including simultaneous issue discounts, reissue credits, or regulatory adjustments. Negative values represent credits.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: agent_premium_split_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the net charge allocated to the independent title agent per the applicable agency agreement premium split schedule.

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the underwriter or branch authority who approved a waiver, adjustment, or exception to the standard filed rate for this charge.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: base_premium_amount
attributes.description: Gross base premium amount calculated from the applicable rate schedule before any adjustments, discounts, or simultaneous issue credits.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance filed rates

attributes.name: cd_line_item_code
attributes.description: TRID Closing Disclosure (CD) line item code identifying where this charge appears on the CD form (e.g., Section B, C, or H line reference).

attributes.name: charge_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the premium charge was assessed or calculated, typically the closing date or commitment date.

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this premium charge record, assigned by the title production system (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest charge line reference).

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the premium charge: calculated (computed but not yet assessed), assessed, invoiced, collected, waived, adjusted, or voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: calculated|assessed|invoiced|collected|waived|adjusted|voided — 7 candidates

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge: OTP (Owner's Title Policy) premium, LTP (Lender's Title Policy) premium, endorsement fee, search fee, exam fee, or settlement fee.

attributes.name: collected_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium charge was collected from the responsible party at or after closing. Null if not yet collected.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) county code for the property location, used for rate jurisdiction and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this premium charge record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this charge record. Typically USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: endorsement_type_code
attributes.description: ALTA endorsement form number or code (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22) when charge_type is endorsement_fee. Null for non-endorsement charges.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code to which this premium charge is posted for revenue recognition and financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: hud1_line_number
attributes.description: HUD-1 Settlement Statement line number where this charge appears, applicable for transactions governed by legacy RESPA HUD-1 disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: liability_amount
attributes.description: The insured amount or coverage liability used as the basis for premium calculation (e.g., purchase price for OTP, loan amount for LTP).
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: Final assessed charge amount after all adjustments (base_premium_amount + adjustment_amount). This is the amount appearing on the settlement statement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the settlement officer regarding special circumstances, rate justifications, or instructions for this charge.

attributes.name: paid_by_party
attributes.description: Identifies which transaction party is responsible for paying this charge: buyer, seller, lender, or split between parties.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charge relates to an Owner's Title Policy (OTP), Lender's Title Policy (LTP), both (simultaneous issue), or is not applicable for non-policy charges.

attributes.name: prior_policy_amount
attributes.description: Liability amount of the prior existing title policy used as the basis for calculating a reissue credit. Populated only when reissue_credit_flag is true.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: prior_policy_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the prior title policy used for reissue credit eligibility determination. Must fall within the state-mandated lookback period.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Rate Manual

attributes.name: production_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the title order was produced: direct branch, centralized lender, or independent agent. Drives premium split and remittance calculations.

attributes.name: rate_per_thousand
attributes.description: The filed premium rate expressed as a dollar amount per $1,000 of liability amount, sourced from the applicable state-filed rate schedule.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance filed rates

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the filed rate schedule or rate table used to calculate the base premium, as maintained in the underwriting rate management system.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance filed rates; ALTA Rate Manual

attributes.name: reissue_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a reissue credit was applied to this charge based on a prior existing title policy covering the same property.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: remittance_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the agent's underwriter premium split must be remitted to the underwriter per the agency agreement remittance schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the underwriter premium remittance for this charge: pending, remitted, overdue, or waived.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium charge is recognized as earned revenue in the general ledger, per applicable accounting standards.

attributes.name: simultaneous_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge benefits from a simultaneous issue discount, applicable when both an OTP and LTP are issued for the same transaction at the same time.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: source_system_charge_ref
attributes.description: Native charge or fee line identifier from the originating title production system (SoftPro Select, RamQuest Horizon, or Qualia) for traceability.

attributes.name: split_percentage
attributes.description: Agent's percentage share of the net premium charge as defined in the premium split schedule. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 70.00 for 70%).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the insured property is located, determining the applicable filed rate schedule and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real estate transaction for which the charge is assessed: purchase, refinance (REFI), home equity line of credit (HELOC), construction, or commercial.

attributes.name: underwriter_premium_split_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the net charge retained by or remitted to the underwriter per the applicable agency agreement premium split schedule.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this premium charge record, supporting audit trail and change detection.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version counter for this charge record, supporting lifecycle revision tracking per VREQ-007 when charges are recalculated or adjusted.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving or reducing this charge. Populated only when charge_status is waived or adjustment_amount is negative.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: closing_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each closing document record in the settlement domain. Primary key for the closing_document entity.

attributes.name: closing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the closing event or closing session during which this document was executed or collected. Supports grouping all documents from a single closing table.

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Recorded instruments must incorporate the approved Schedule A legal description; critical for deed preparation, mortgage legal sufficiency, title policy accuracy, and ensuring

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Recording documents require exact parcel identification (APN/PIN) for county recorder indexing, grantor-grantee index accuracy, and automated recording system validation; critical for

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Closing documents convey or encumber specific properties; fundamental for recording package assembly, legal description consistency checks, deed preparation, and mortgage legal sufficiency

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording) for the electronic submission of this document. Supports rejection and resubmission tracking.
attributes.references: eRecording (Electronic Recording) standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) associated with this closing document, where applicable. Maintains the distinct settlement_statement entity per VREQ-003.

attributes.name: superseded_by_closing_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the closing_document record that supersedes this version, if applicable. Preserves prior document versions in the lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order under which this closing document was collected or executed. Links the document to the originating order lifecycle.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_policy. Business justification: Recorded deeds and mortgages must link to the policy that insured them for claims investigation, coverage determination, and chain-of-title validation.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the county recorder or filing authority formally accepted the document for recording. Distinct per VREQ-008 from submission and recording dates.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of consideration stated in the deed or transfer instrument. Used for transfer tax calculation, 1099-S reporting, and transaction value analytics.
attributes.references: IRS (1099-S); State Departments of Insurance; RESPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this closing document record was first created in the title production system. Supports audit trail and closing-readiness cycle time metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this document (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for commercial transactions.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier assigned to this closing document by the title production system (e.g., SoftPro Select / Qualia). Used for tracking and reference in correspondence.

attributes.name: document_page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the closing document. Used for recording fee calculation (many jurisdictions charge per page) and document completeness verification.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: document_source
attributes.description: Originating party or system that provided or prepared this closing document (e.g., lender loan package, title company, borrower-provided identity document).

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the closing document within the settlement workflow. Drives closing-readiness assessment and document completeness tracking.

attributes.name: document_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within a document type (e.g., within affidavit: title affidavit, gap affidavit, name affidavit, marital status affidavit). Supports detailed reporting.

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the document as it appears on the face of the instrument (e.g., 'Warranty Deed', 'Closing Disclosure', 'Affidavit of Title').

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the closing document by legal or operational category. Drives routing, execution requirements, and retention rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version number of this document, incremented when a document is revised or superseded during the closing lifecycle. Supports lifecycle revision tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document becomes legally operative or binding, which may differ from execution date. Distinct per VREQ-008 (e.g., deed effective date vs. signing date).

attributes.name: erecording_status
attributes.description: Current status of the document within the eRecording gateway workflow. Drives recording rejection and resubmission rate metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: eRecording (Electronic Recording) standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the document was signed or executed by the required parties at closing. Distinct from effective, submission, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: execution_method
attributes.description: Method by which the document was executed: wet signature, Remote Online Notarization (RON), In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN), or full eClose. Supports RON/IPEN compliance tracking.
attributes.references: MISMO; State Departments of Insurance; RON (Remote Online Notarization) standards

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county of recording jurisdiction. Used for geographic routing, regulatory reporting, and county-level analytics.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantee (buyer/transferee) as it appears on the face of the instrument. Required for vesting, chain-of-title (COT) integrity, and policy issuance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor (seller/transferor) as it appears on the face of the instrument. Required for chain-of-title (COT) integrity and recording index matching.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: imaging_document_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or URI referencing the scanned or electronic image of this document in the Document Management and Imaging System. Supports evidence and provenance capture per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Document Management and Imaging System

attributes.name: irs_1099s_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 1099-S form has been filed with the IRS for this closing document. Supports tax compliance audit and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount associated with loan documents executed at closing. Used for lender policy coverage verification and TRID/RESPA compliance.

attributes.name: notarization_date
attributes.description: Date the document was notarized. Relevant for deeds, affidavits, and other instruments requiring notarial acknowledgment. Supports gap period and recording readiness analysis.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: notarization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires notarization as a condition of validity or recordability. Drives closing coordination and notary scheduling.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary's state commission. Used to validate that the notary was active at the time of notarization, preventing recording rejections.

attributes.name: notary_commission_number
attributes.description: State-issued commission number of the notary public. Required for recording compliance verification and notary credential audit.

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the notary public who acknowledged or witnessed execution of this document. Required for recording compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: poa_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the power of attorney document used in execution, if applicable. Links to the POA instrument in the document management system.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Document Management and Imaging System

attributes.name: power_of_attorney_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a power of attorney was used in the execution of this document. Triggers additional underwriting review and POA document collection requirements.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date the document was officially recorded in the public record by the county recorder. Distinct per VREQ-008 from execution, effective, submission, and acceptance dates.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the county recorder for recording this document. Included in the settlement statement and escrow disbursement. Supports escrow reconciliation.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; RESPA

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the county or jurisdiction where the document is to be or was recorded (e.g., 'Cook County, IL'). Drives eRecording gateway routing and FIPS code assignment.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards)

attributes.name: recording_rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description provided by the county recorder when a document submission is rejected. Supports root-cause analysis of recording rejection rates per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: requires_1099s
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document triggers a 1099-S real estate proceeds reporting obligation to the IRS. Drives tax reporting workflow and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: requires_recording
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document must be submitted to the county recorder as part of the closing process (e.g., deeds, deeds of trust). Drives recording workflow initiation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: Number of times this document has been resubmitted to the county recorder after an initial rejection. Supports recording rejection and resubmission rate metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the document was submitted to the county recorder or relevant authority for recording or filing. Distinct per VREQ-008 from execution, effective, acceptance, and recording dates.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording (Electronic Recording) standards

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: State or county transfer tax assessed on the conveyance as reflected in the transfer tax declaration. Supports settlement statement reconciliation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this closing document record was last modified in the title production system. Supports change tracking and lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title vesting for the grantee as stated in the deed or closing document (e.g., joint tenancy, tenancy in common, community property). Drives ownership interest modeling per VREQ-005.

products.name: escrow_reconciliation
products.description: Periodic three-way reconciliation record for the escrow trust account, comparing the escrow ledger balance against the bank statement balance and the aggregate of open file balances.
products.reference: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 / Trust Account Three-Way Reconciliation

attributes.name: escrow_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the escrow trust account three-way reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_supervisor_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervising manager or compliance officer who reviewed and approved this reconciliation record per ALTA dual-control requirements.

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow trust account (IOLTA or dedicated trust account) being reconciled in this record.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow officer or trust accounting staff member who performed and submitted this reconciliation for supervisory review.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the escrow trust account being reconciled. IOLTA accounts hold client funds earning interest for legal aid; dedicated trust accounts are file-specific.
attributes.references: IOLTA regulations; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: adjusted_bank_balance
attributes.description: Bank statement balance plus outstanding deposits minus outstanding checks. Represents the reconciled bank-side balance for comparison to the escrow ledger balance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supervising manager or compliance officer formally approved this reconciliation record as complete and accurate.

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the approving supervisor at the time of reconciliation approval, documenting any conditions, exceptions, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: bank_account_number_masked
attributes.description: Masked bank account number showing only the last four digits, used for display and audit purposes. Full account number stored in the Identity and NPPI Vault per GLBA.
attributes.references: GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; PCI DSS

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the escrow trust account being reconciled (e.g., Wells Fargo, JPMorgan Chase).

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number of the financial institution holding the escrow trust account. Used to identify the bank for reconciliation and wire verification purposes.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; Federal Reserve

attributes.name: bank_statement_balance
attributes.description: Ending balance per the bank statement for the reconciliation period. First leg of the three-way reconciliation. Denominated in USD.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The statement date of the bank statement used as the primary source for the bank-side leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_to_ledger_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the adjusted bank balance and the escrow ledger balance. A non-zero value indicates a discrepancy requiring investigation and resolution.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Reference to the direct branch or closing office responsible for the escrow trust account being reconciled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this escrow reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation record. Typically USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: days_to_reconcile
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the reconciliation period end date and the date the reconciliation was completed. Supports cycle-time analytics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_balance
attributes.description: Total balance per the escrow trust accounting ledger as of the reconciliation period end date. Second leg of the three-way reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Indicates whether all three legs of the reconciliation (bank, ledger, open files) agree within the defined tolerance threshold. True when fully balanced.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record or its variance must be reported to a state Department of Insurance or other regulatory body per applicable state requirements.

attributes.name: ledger_to_file_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the escrow ledger balance and the aggregate of open file balances. A non-zero value indicates unallocated funds or file balance errors.

attributes.name: open_file_balance_aggregate
attributes.description: Sum of all individual open escrow file (order) balances as of the reconciliation period end date. Third leg of the three-way reconciliation per ALTA Best Practices.

attributes.name: open_file_count
attributes.description: Number of individual escrow files (title orders) with open balances included in the open file balance aggregate for this reconciliation period.

attributes.name: outstanding_check_count
attributes.description: Number of individual checks or disbursement items issued but not yet cleared the bank as of the reconciliation date.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_amount
attributes.description: Total of checks or wire disbursements issued but not yet cleared the bank as of the reconciliation date. Adjusts bank balance downward.

attributes.name: outstanding_deposits_amount
attributes.description: Total of deposits recorded in the escrow ledger but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the reconciliation date. Adjusts bank balance upward.

attributes.name: positive_pay_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the positive pay file was submitted to the bank for the reconciliation period. Null if positive pay was not submitted.

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a positive pay file was submitted to the bank for this reconciliation period to prevent check fraud on the escrow trust account.

attributes.name: prior_period_variance_amount
attributes.description: Unresolved variance amount carried forward from the immediately preceding reconciliation period. Non-zero values indicate aging discrepancies requiring escalation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the three-way reconciliation was performed by the escrow officer or trust accounting staff.

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reconciliation run, typically formatted as RECON-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used for audit trail and operational reference.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record, typically the last day of the statement month.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record, typically the first day of the statement month.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reconciliation record. Balanced indicates all three legs agree within tolerance; out_of_balance triggers investigation workflow.

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation procedure performed. Three-way compares bank statement, escrow ledger, and open file balances simultaneously per ALTA Best Practices.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reconciliation or its associated variance was reported to the applicable state regulatory authority. Null if not yet reported or not required.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the escrow and trust accounting system of record from which this reconciliation data was extracted (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting, RamQuest).

attributes.name: source_system_recon_ref
attributes.description: Native reconciliation record identifier from the originating escrow trust accounting system (SoftPro, RamQuest, etc.) for lineage and cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: stale_check_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of outstanding checks that have exceeded the stale-date threshold and are subject to escheatment or reissuance review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State unclaimed property laws

attributes.name: stale_check_count
attributes.description: Number of outstanding checks that have exceeded the stale-date threshold (typically 90–180 days) and require escheatment review or reissuance action.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State unclaimed property laws

attributes.name: tolerance_amount
attributes.description: Maximum allowable variance in USD between reconciliation legs before the record is flagged as out-of-balance. Typically set to $0.00 for trust accounts per ALTA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this escrow reconciliation record. Supports change detection and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the escrow officer or supervisor describing the cause of any out-of-balance condition and the planned resolution steps.

attributes.name: variance_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the investigation and resolution effort for any out-of-balance variance identified in this reconciliation record.

attributes.name: variance_resolved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the out-of-balance variance was fully resolved and the reconciliation was confirmed as balanced. Null if variance remains open.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

products.name: escrow_receipt
products.description: Individual incoming funds-received record representing a single deposit into the escrow/IOLTA trust account for a specific closing (EMD/earnest money receipt, loan proceeds wire-in, buyer cash-to-close, seller contribution, HOA/payoff overfund return).

attributes.name: escrow_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each escrow trust account receipt record. Primary key for the escrow_receipt entity.

attributes.name: escrow_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow/IOLTA trust ledger into which this receipt is posted. Links the receipt to the closing-level ledger balance.

attributes.name: escrow_officer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow officer (EOT) responsible for receiving and posting this receipt. Supports accountability, audit, and closing-readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State escrow licensing requirements

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (buyer, seller, lender, agent, HOA) who remitted the funds. Supports multi-role party model.

attributes.name: prior_receipt_escrow_receipt_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing link to the original receipt record when this record represents a correction, repost, or replacement. Preserves lifecycle history per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Receipts (earnest money deposits, buyer funds, loan proceeds) are collected for specific property transactions; needed for escrow accounting reconciliation, funds-to-property traceability

attributes.name: remitter_party_role_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.party_role. Business justification: Receipts from parties in specific roles (buyer earnest money, borrower down payment, lender loan proceeds) require role context for proper settlement statement allocation, TRID

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) to which this receipt is applied, supporting TRID/RESPA reconciliation.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order associated with this escrow receipt, enabling traceability from receipt to the originating transaction.

attributes.name: wire_instruction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the verified wire instruction record that authorized this incoming wire receipt. Supports fraud prevention and wire verification audit trail.

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: NACHA-assigned trace number for ACH credit entries received into the trust account. Populated only when funds_type is 'ach'; supports return and NOC processing.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment applied to the gross receipt amount (e.g., bank return fee, wire shortfall correction). Negative value indicates a deduction; zero if no adjustment.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Reference to the direct branch or centralized lender channel office where this receipt was processed. Supports channel-level reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number from the remitter's instrument when funds_type is check, cashiers_check, or certified_check. Used for positive-pay matching and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; UCC Article 3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this escrow receipt record was first created in the system of record (SoftPro Trust Accounting / RamQuest).
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the receipt amount (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency trust account compliance.

attributes.name: emd_contract_date
attributes.description: Date of the purchase contract requiring the EMD. Populated only when emd_flag is true; used to verify timely EMD receipt per contract terms.

attributes.name: emd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt represents an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD). True when receipt_type is 'emd'; drives EMD tracking and forfeiture/return workflows.
attributes.references: RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: expected_receipt_amount
attributes.description: Amount expected to be received per the settlement statement or wire instruction. Compared against receipt_amount to detect shortfalls or overages at closing.
attributes.references: TRID 12 CFR Part 1026; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: fraud_alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fraud alert has been raised on this receipt (e.g., suspicious wire origin, mismatched remitter, business email compromise indicator).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN AML; FBI BEC guidance

attributes.name: fraud_alert_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the fraud alert reason or investigation notes when fraud_alert_flag is true. Supports escrow officer review and SAR filing if required.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN SAR requirements

attributes.name: funds_type
attributes.description: Method by which the funds were remitted: wire transfer, personal check, ACH, cashier's check, certified check, cash, or electronic transfer. Governs availability and positive-pay rules.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; UCC Article 4A

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this receipt is mapped in the ERP/GL system for premium revenue recognition and trust account accounting.

attributes.name: iolta_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the receiving trust account is an Interest on Lawyers Trust Account (IOLTA). True when IOLTA rules apply to interest disposition.
attributes.references: IOLTA regulations; State Bar rules; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: memo
attributes.description: Free-text memo or description entered by the escrow officer at the time of receipt posting, capturing remitter instructions or special handling notes.

attributes.name: net_receipt_amount
attributes.description: Net funds credited to the escrow ledger after adjustments (receipt_amount + adjustment_amount). Used in three-way reconciliation and ledger balance calculations.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt was submitted to the bank's positive-pay system for check verification. Applicable when funds_type is check or cashiers_check.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; bank positive-pay controls

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the receipt was posted to the escrow ledger in the trust accounting system, which may differ from received_timestamp due to processing lag.

attributes.name: receipt_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of funds received into the escrow trust account for this receipt record. Base monetary fact before any adjustments or reversals.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the funds were physically or electronically received into the escrow/IOLTA trust account. Principal business event date for this receipt.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable receipt number assigned by the escrow/trust accounting system (e.g., SoftPro Trust Accounting) for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receipt within the trust accounting workflow. Drives reconciliation and positive-pay processing.

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incoming funds: EMD (Earnest Money Deposit), loan proceeds wire-in, buyer cash-to-close, seller contribution, HOA/payoff overfund return, or other.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the funds were confirmed received into the trust account, including timezone offset. Used for same-day wire cutoff and positive-pay validation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; Fedwire/CHIPS settlement rules

attributes.name: remitter_account_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the remitter's bank account number stored in the NPPI/Identity Vault. Never stores raw account number; token resolves to vault record per GLBA.
attributes.references: GLBA 15 U.S.C. § 6801; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; PCI DSS

attributes.name: remitter_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution from which the funds originated. Used for fraud screening and wire verification per ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN AML requirements

attributes.name: remitter_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity remitting the funds. NPPI/PII — stored with restricted classification per GLBA and CFPB requirements.
attributes.references: GLBA 15 U.S.C. § 6801; CFPB TRID 12 CFR Part 1026

attributes.name: remitter_party_role
attributes.description: Role of the party remitting the funds at the time of this receipt (buyer, seller, lender, independent agent, HOA, third party). Contextual role per VREQ-006.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receipt reversal was processed. Populated only when reversal_flag is true; used to calculate net trust account balance impact.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt has been reversed (e.g., returned check, wire recall, ACH return). True triggers a corresponding reversal entry in the escrow ledger.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the reversal when reversal_flag is true: NSF, stop payment, wire recall, ACH return, duplicate posting, data entry error, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nsf|stop_payment|wire_recall|ach_return|duplicate|error|other — 7 candidates stripped
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; UCC Article 4; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: source_system_receipt_ref
attributes.description: Native receipt identifier from the originating escrow/trust accounting system (SoftPro Trust Accounting, RamQuest) for lineage and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: trust_account_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the escrow/IOLTA trust account. Required for three-way reconciliation and state insurance department reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; State Department of Insurance regulations

attributes.name: trust_account_number
attributes.description: Escrow/IOLTA trust bank account number into which the receipt was deposited. Restricted per GLBA and ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2 trust account segregation requirements.
attributes.references: GLBA 15 U.S.C. § 6801; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp of the most recent modification to this escrow receipt record, supporting change tracking and three-way reconciliation audit trails.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between receipt_amount and expected_receipt_amount (receipt_amount minus expected_receipt_amount). Non-zero values trigger escrow officer review and reconciliation action.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; RESPA 12 CFR Part 1024

attributes.name: wire_reference_number
attributes.description: Fedwire or CHIPS reference number assigned to the incoming wire transfer. Populated only when funds_type is 'wire'; used for bank reconciliation and fraud verification.

attributes.name: wire_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the incoming wire against the authorized instruction: callback, secure portal, verbal, written confirmation, or not applicable for non-wire receipts.

attributes.name: wire_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incoming wire was verified against the authorized wire instruction prior to posting. Required by ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3 fraud controls.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; FinCEN AML

products.name: recording_submission
products.description: Authoritative SSOT for each document recording submission sent to a county recorder or register of deeds via an eRecording gateway (Simplifile, CSC eRecording) or physical delivery.

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recording submission record. Primary key for the recording_submission entity in the title insurance recording domain.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Recording submissions prepared by independent agents must track the agent for oversight metrics (rejection rates, turnaround time), remittance reconciliation, and quality control.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.jurisdiction. Business justification: Recording submissions are sent to a specific county recorder/register of deeds office.

attributes.name: prior_submission_recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding submission record for this package, enabling full resubmission chain traceability per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) associated with the closing that produced the documents in this submission.

attributes.name: submitted_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (closing agent, escrow officer, title agent, or attorney) who submitted the recording package to the county recorder or eRecording gateway.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title commitment under which the documents in this submission were required. Supports commitment-to-recording traceability.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title order that originated this recording submission. Links the recording event back to the full title production lifecycle.

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting referral record created when a recording issue required underwriter review. Null if no referral was required.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the county recorder or eRecording gateway formally accepted the submission package for recording review. Distinct from submission_date and recording_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; county recorder workflow

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Official book number assigned by the county recorder for the recorded instrument (used in book/page recording reference systems). Null for jurisdictions using instrument numbers.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Production channel through which the title order was originated: direct branch, centralized lender, or independent agent. Supports channel-level recording performance metrics.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Purchase price or loan amount stated on the primary instrument, used for transfer tax calculation and underwriting risk assessment. Confidential financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this recording_submission record was first created in the system of record. Audit field supporting data lineage and provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this submission record. Defaults to USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual instruments included in this recording submission package. Supports fee calculation and completeness validation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the primary instrument in this submission takes legal effect, which may differ from execution or recording date. Distinct per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State recording statutes

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: eRecording gateway vendor used to transmit documents electronically to the county recorder (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording). Null or 'none' for physical submissions.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; Simplifile / CSC eRecording

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway (Simplifile, CSC) for this submission. Used for gateway-level status tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the primary instrument in this submission was signed/executed by the parties. Distinct from effective_date, submission_date, acceptance_date, and recording_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State recording statutes

attributes.name: gap_close_date
attributes.description: Date the gap coverage period closed, set to the confirmed recording_date. Null until recording is confirmed. Drives gap-period duration calculation.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag

attributes.name: gap_open_date
attributes.description: Date the gap coverage period opened, typically the closing/disbursement date. Marks the start of the unrecorded instrument risk window.

attributes.name: instrument_number

attributes.name: last_rejection_date

attributes.name: last_rejection_reason_code

attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; Simplifile rejection code taxonomy

attributes.name: last_rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the most recent rejection reason as returned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Supports curative action and resubmission workflow.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the closing agent or recording coordinator regarding special instructions, curative actions, or county-specific requirements for this submission.

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Official page number assigned by the county recorder for the recorded instrument (used in book/page recording reference systems). Null for jurisdictions using instrument numbers.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; county recorder standards

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days

attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; State DOI regulations

attributes.name: recording_reference_number

attributes.name: recorded_instrument_id

attributes.name: agent_profile_id

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id

attributes.name: operations_title_examination_id

attributes.name: parcel_id

attributes.name: recording_submission_id

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.title_claim. Business justification: Recorded instruments trigger claims when post-recording defects surface (forgery, fraud, prior liens).

attributes.name: title_finding_id

attributes.name: title_order_id

attributes.name: acceptance_date

attributes.name: apn

attributes.name: book_number

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recorded instrument record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage per SOC 2 and ALTA Best Practices.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: document_image_reference

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag

attributes.name: grantee_name

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the grantor (seller, trustor, mortgagor, or conveying party) as it appears on the recorded instrument. Critical for grantor/grantee index and chain-of-title assembly.
