attributes.name: instrument_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recorded instrument as confirmed by the county recorder. Accepted = stamped and indexed; Released = lien released; Superseded = replaced by corrective instrument; Voided = expunged by court order.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: instrument_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the instrument type (e.g., Warranty Deed (WD), Quit Claim Deed (QCD), Special Warranty Deed (SWD), Purchase Money Mortgage (PMM), HELOC, Deed of Trust). Refines title examination and underwriting analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Legal classification of the recorded instrument (e.g., deed, deed of trust, mortgage, release, reconveyance, assignment, lis pendens, easement, UCC). Drives chain-of-title analysis and defect identification.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds; UCC Article 9

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the property as it appears on the recorded instrument (metes and bounds, PLSS township/range/section, or plat/subdivision lot reference). Critical for chain-of-title and Schedule A verification.
attributes.references: ALTA; PLSS; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: lien_priority
attributes.description: Priority position of the lien instrument relative to other encumbrances on the property (first, second, subordinate). Determined by recording date and any subordination agreements. Critical for lender policy coverage analysis.

attributes.name: lien_type
attributes.description: Classification of the encumbrance type for lien instruments (e.g., mortgage, deed of trust, tax lien, mechanics lien, judgment lien, HOA lien, UCC). Null for conveyance instruments. Supports open-lien and aging-defect metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA; UCC Article 9; IRS; State Lien Laws

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the loan secured by a deed of trust or mortgage as stated on the instrument. Used for LTV/CLTV analysis and lender policy coverage verification.

attributes.name: mers_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Mortgage Identification Number (MIN)
attributes.description: 18-digit MERS Mortgage Identification Number assigned to a deed of trust or mortgage registered on the MERS system. Null for non-MERS instruments. Required for lender policy and assignment chain verification.

tag_set.value: Mortgage Electronic Registration Systems (MERS) Mortgage Identification Number (MIN)

attributes.name: notarization_type
attributes.description: Method of notarization used for this instrument: traditional in-person, Remote Online Notarization (RON), In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN), or Remote Ink Notarization (RIN). Affects recording acceptance in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Notary Laws; RON Legislation

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary's commission at the time of acknowledgment. Used to validate that the notarization was performed within an active commission period, preventing recording defects.
attributes.references: State Notary Laws; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the notary public who acknowledged the instrument. Required for recording validity verification and E&O compliance review.
attributes.references: State Notary Laws; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the recorded instrument as accepted by the county recorder. Used to calculate per-page recording fees and verify fee reconciliation.

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Official page number within the recording book where the instrument is indexed. Combined with book_number to form the complete book/page recording reference used in chain-of-title searches.

attributes.name: prior_instrument_number
attributes.description: Recording reference number of the instrument being released, reconveyed, assigned, or superseded by this instrument. Establishes the chain-of-title link between successive instruments for lien release and satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Official date the instrument was accepted and stamped by the county recorder or register of deeds. Distinct from execution_date, effective_date, submission_date, and acceptance_date. Anchors gap-period close and policy-issuance-lag calculation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; VREQ-008; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee paid to the county recorder for recording this instrument, including per-page fees and any indexing fees. Reconciled against the settlement statement disbursement.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; RESPA; CFPB

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the county recorder or register of deeds office where the instrument was recorded (e.g., 'Cook County Recorder of Deeds'). Complements county_fips_code for display and reporting.

attributes.name: recording_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the instrument was stamped by the county recorder, including time zone offset. Used for priority determination in same-day recording conflicts and gap-period close precision.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: release_satisfaction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this instrument is a release, satisfaction, or reconveyance that extinguishes a prior lien or encumbrance. Used to update open-lien status in the title examination and chain-of-title analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the instrument was recorded. Used for state-level regulatory reporting, transfer tax rate lookup, and jurisdiction routing.
attributes.references: USPS; NAIC; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the instrument package was submitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Distinct from execution_date, effective_date, acceptance_date, and recording_date per VREQ-008. Used in recording cycle-time analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; VREQ-008; Simplifile / CSC eRecording

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Documentary transfer tax or deed stamp tax collected at recording, calculated on the consideration amount per applicable state and county rates. Reconciled against settlement statement.
attributes.references: State Revenue Codes; County Recorder / Register of Deeds; IRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recorded instrument record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change tracking, lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title vesting under which the grantee takes ownership (e.g., joint tenancy, tenancy in common, community property, trust, entity). Drives ownership interest modeling and underwriting analysis.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

products.name: submission_document
products.description: Line-item entity representing each individual document within a recording_submission (e.g., a deed, deed of trust, release, and subordination agreement as separate documents), each with its own document type, page count, recording fee, execution date
products.reference: Recording Package Document — eRecording gateway line item

attributes.name: submission_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual document line item within a recording submission package. Primary key for the submission_document entity.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Individual documents within agent-originated submissions must track the preparing agent for document-level quality audits, notarization compliance reviews, and oversight sampling.

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway (e.g., Simplifile transaction ID) for this document submission. Used for gateway reconciliation and rejection tracking.
attributes.references: eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording); ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent recording_submission package that contains this document. Establishes the header-detail relationship for multi-document submissions.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating title order associated with this document, enabling traceability from recording back through the full title lifecycle.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the county recorder or eRecording gateway formally accepted this document for recording. Marks the start of the gap-period (GAP) closure window. Distinct per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Book number assigned by the county recorder as part of the book/page recording reference system. Used in jurisdictions that index by book and page rather than instrument number.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of consideration stated on the face of the conveyance instrument (e.g., purchase price on a deed). Used for transfer tax calculation and chain-of-title value analysis.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; IRS

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code identifying the county or county-equivalent jurisdiction where the document is recorded. Enables multi-jurisdiction reporting.
attributes.references: FIPS; NAIC; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

tag_set.value: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submission_document record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail and lifecycle tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: document_image_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI pointing to the scanned or electronic image of this document in the Document Management and Imaging System. Supports evidence and provenance requirements.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Document Management and Imaging System

attributes.name: document_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this document within the parent recording submission package. Determines recording priority order (e.g., deed records before deed of trust).

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this individual document within the recording workflow. Tracks progression from pending through recorded or rejected/resubmitted states.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: document_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the document type (e.g., Warranty Deed vs. Quit Claim Deed vs. Special Warranty Deed). Supports granular chain-of-title analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or caption of the legal instrument as it appears on the face of the document (e.g., 'Warranty Deed', 'Deed of Trust and Security Agreement').
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal instrument being submitted for recording (e.g., Warranty Deed, Deed of Trust, Release/Reconveyance, Subordination Agreement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the legal instrument becomes operative and binding between the parties. May differ from execution date and recording date. Distinct per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: Identifies the eRecording gateway or submission channel used to transmit this document to the county recorder (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording, direct paper). Supports gateway performance metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the document was signed/executed by the parties. Distinct from effective date, submission date, acceptance date, and recording date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: gap_close_date
attributes.description: Date the gap coverage period closed for this document, set equal to the confirmed recording_date. A null value indicates the gap period remains open and the document has not yet been confirmed recorded.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage (GAP) is in effect for this document, covering the period between closing/execution and confirmed recording. True when gap period is open and insured.

attributes.name: gap_open_date
attributes.description: Date the gap coverage period opened for this document, typically the closing/disbursement date. The gap period runs from this date until the recording_date is confirmed.

attributes.name: grantee_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantee (transferee/beneficiary/mortgagee) as it appears on the face of the document. Used for chain-of-title indexing and grantor-grantee index matching at the county recorder.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor (transferor/trustor/mortgagor) as it appears on the face of the document. Used for chain-of-title indexing and grantor-grantee index matching at the county recorder.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Sequential instrument number assigned by the county recorder in jurisdictions that use instrument-number indexing rather than book/page. Unique within a county and recording year.

attributes.name: is_erecording_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document type and jurisdiction combination supports electronic recording (eRecording). False indicates paper recording is required for this document.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal loan amount secured by a deed of trust or mortgage instrument as stated on the face of the document. Used for lender policy coverage verification and lien priority analysis.

attributes.name: notarization_type
attributes.description: Method by which the document was notarized: traditional in-person, Remote Online Notarization (RON), or In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN). Affects county recorder acceptance requirements.
attributes.references: ALTA; State Departments of Insurance; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary public's commission at the time of notarization. Validates that the notary was duly commissioned when the document was executed, preventing recording rejection.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the notary public who acknowledged or witnessed the execution of this document. Required for recording acceptance in most jurisdictions.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in this individual document as submitted for recording. Used to calculate per-page recording fees and verify completeness against the recorded instrument.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Page number assigned by the county recorder as part of the book/page recording reference system. Used alongside book_number in jurisdictions that index by book and page.

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the confirmed recording_date and the issuance of the associated title policy. Supports the policy-issuance-lag-after-recording metric per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: priority_recording_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this document requires expedited or priority recording to protect lien priority or close the gap period within a time-sensitive window (e.g., same-day recording required).

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Official date the document was recorded in the public record by the county recorder or register of deeds. Closes the GAP coverage window. Distinct per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the recording fee assessed by the county recorder for this individual document, typically calculated based on page count and document type per the jurisdiction fee schedule.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; RESPA; TRID

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Name of the county recorder, register of deeds, or other recording jurisdiction office where this document is submitted (e.g., 'Cook County Recorder of Deeds').

attributes.name: recording_reference_number
attributes.description: Official recording reference assigned by the county recorder upon recording (e.g., instrument number, document number). The primary public-record identifier for the recorded instrument.

attributes.name: recording_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the document was stamped as recorded by the county recorder, including time-of-day priority for same-day recordings. Critical for lien priority determination.
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this document has been rejected by the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Supports recording rejection and resubmission rate metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code returned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway explaining why this document was rejected (e.g., missing notary, incorrect fee, illegible). Drives resubmission workflow.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the rejection reason as provided by the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Supplements the rejection_reason_code with human-readable detail for curative action.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: resubmission_date
attributes.description: Date this document was most recently resubmitted to the county recorder following a prior rejection. Used to calculate resubmission turnaround time and recording rejection rate metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the document is recorded. Supports state-level regulatory reporting and recording fee schedules.
attributes.references: NAIC; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date this document was submitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway for recording. Distinct from execution, effective, acceptance, and recording dates per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC eRecording)

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Documentary transfer tax or deed tax assessed on this document at the time of recording, typically applicable to conveyance instruments. Reported on the Closing Disclosure (CD).
attributes.references: IRS; County Recorder / Register of Deeds; TRID; CFPB

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submission_document record was most recently modified in the system of record. Supports change tracking and lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: rejection_event
products.description: Transactional SSOT for each discrete rejection notice returned for a recording submission or an individual submission_document, carrying an explicit grain flag (submission-level vs document-level).
products.reference: Recording Rejection Notice — County Recorder / eRecording gateway

attributes.name: rejection_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each discrete rejection notice event returned by a county recorder or eRecording gateway for a recording submission or individual submission document.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Recording rejections on agent files must route curative actions to the responsible agent and track rejection rates by agent for oversight reviews, authority adjustments, and training

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: Transaction identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway (Simplifile or CSC) for the submission batch or document that was rejected, enabling reconciliation with gateway records.

attributes.name: operations_curative_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.operations_curative_action. Business justification: Recording rejections (missing notarization, signature defects, margin errors) trigger curative actions. Tracks curative action aging and effectiveness per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: rejection_recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent recording_submission record against which this rejection was issued. Establishes the submission-level context for the rejection event.

attributes.name: rejection_resubmission_submission_recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new recording_submission record created as a result of resubmitting the corrected document after this rejection, enabling chain-of-resubmission tracking.

attributes.name: submission_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific submission_document within the parent submission that triggered this rejection, when the rejection is document-level rather than submission-level. Null for submission-level rejections.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order associated with this rejection event, enabling cross-domain traceability from recording back to the originating order and lifecycle.

attributes.name: assigned_to_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the recording specialist or closer assigned to resolve this rejection event. Supports workload management and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: corrected_fee_amount
attributes.description: Corrected recording fee amount (in USD) required by the county recorder to accept the resubmission, when the rejection was due to an incorrect fee. Supports settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code uniquely identifying the county or jurisdiction of the recording office that issued the rejection.

tag_set.value: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county or jurisdiction whose recorder or register of deeds issued the rejection notice. Supports jurisdiction-level rejection rate analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rejection_event record was first captured in the system of record (eRecording gateway or title production system). Audit trail field.

attributes.name: curative_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific curative action required to resolve this rejection (e.g., re-execute deed, correct legal description, obtain notary re-acknowledgment, pay correct recording fee).

attributes.name: curative_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rejection requires a curative action (document correction, re-execution, or additional evidence) before resubmission can occur. Drives curative workflow routing.

attributes.name: days_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this rejection event has been in an open/unresolved state, calculated from received_timestamp to current date or resolution_timestamp. Supports aging and SLA reporting.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: The document-level tracking number or identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway or county recorder to the specific document that was rejected, for traceability.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of instrument or document that was rejected (e.g., Deed of Trust, Warranty Deed, Quit Claim Deed, Mortgage, Release, Assignment). Relevant for document-level rejections. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]

attributes.name: erecording_gateway_name
attributes.description: Name of the eRecording gateway or submission channel through which the document was submitted and rejected (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording, or direct county submission).

attributes.name: escalated_to_underwriting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rejection event was escalated to the underwriting team for risk assessment or exception handling, particularly when the rejection creates a title defect or cloud on title.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk Standards

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rejection event was escalated to underwriting or management for review. Null if not escalated. Supports escalation rate and aging metrics.

attributes.name: gap_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of gap coverage exposure attributable to this rejection event, measured from the original submission date to the resubmission or resolution date.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; GAP Coverage Standards

attributes.name: gap_period_impacted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rejection event extended or created a gap coverage period (GAP) between the closing date and confirmed recording date, triggering additional underwriting risk exposure.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; GAP Coverage Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the recording specialist regarding the rejection event, curative steps taken, communications with the county recorder, or other relevant context.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated business identifier for this rejection notice, as returned by the eRecording gateway (e.g., Simplifile or CSC) or county recorder office.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway Standards (Simplifile/CSC)

attributes.name: original_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the original recording submission was first submitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway, prior to this rejection. Used to calculate total recording cycle time.

attributes.name: policy_issuance_impacted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rejection event delayed or blocked the issuance of the owner or lender title policy, contributing to the policy-issuance-lag-after-recording metric.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rejection notice was received from the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Principal business event timestamp for this rejection event; anchors aging and SLA calculations.

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Recording fee amount (in USD) associated with the rejected submission or document, relevant when the rejection reason involves incorrect fee payment or fee recalculation.

attributes.name: rejection_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the rejection reason (e.g., legal_description_error, missing_signature, incorrect_fee, formatting_defect, vesting_mismatch, notarization_defect). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: rejection_grain
attributes.description: Explicit grain discriminator indicating whether this rejection applies to the entire recording submission (submission-level) or to a single document within the submission (document-level).

attributes.name: rejection_notice_date
attributes.description: Calendar date stated on the official rejection notice issued by the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Distinct from received_timestamp; reflects the official notice date for legal purposes.

attributes.name: rejection_notice_text
attributes.description: Full verbatim text of the rejection notice as received from the county recorder or eRecording gateway, preserved for evidence, provenance, and curative action guidance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; eRecording Gateway Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code assigned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway identifying the specific reason for rejection (e.g., county-specific error codes from Simplifile or CSC rejection notice).

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the rejection reason as returned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway, preserving the verbatim rejection notice language for curative reference.

attributes.name: rejection_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence of this rejection event within the parent recording submission, enabling tracking of repeated rejections (1st rejection, 2nd rejection, etc.) for resubmission rate metrics.

attributes.name: rejection_source
attributes.description: The authority or system that issued the rejection notice — county recorder, eRecording gateway (Simplifile/CSC), register of deeds, or state-level recording office.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; eRecording Gateway Standards

attributes.name: rejection_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of this rejection event. Drives recording rejection/resubmission rate metrics and aging analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|resolved|resubmitted|waived|escalated|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: Method by which this rejection was resolved: resubmission of corrected document, waiver granted by county, withdrawal of submission, escalation to underwriter, or county-initiated override.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rejection event was resolved (either by successful resubmission, waiver, or closure). Used to calculate rejection resolution cycle time.

attributes.name: resubmission_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the corrected document was resubmitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway following resolution of this rejection event.

attributes.name: resubmission_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the corrected document must be resubmitted to the county recorder to preserve GAP coverage and avoid policy issuance delays. Critical for gap-period risk management.

attributes.name: sla_breached

attributes.name: sla_target_days

attributes.name: source_system_rejection_code

attributes.name: state_code

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GAP coverage period record tracking the interval between closing/last search date and confirmed recording date for a title order.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agency.agent_profile. Business justification: Gap coverage authority is delegated to agents under specific limits. Tracking the agent managing each gap period is required for authority compliance monitoring, gap risk reporting, and

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recording submission that, upon acceptance, closes the GAP coverage window. Links to the eRecording gateway submission record.

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.title_claim. Business justification: Gap coverage periods generate claims when intervening liens or defects arise during the gap. Claims adjuster must reference the gap period to validate coverage and determine liability.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title commitment under which GAP coverage is extended. Identifies the commitment version in effect at closing.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order for which this GAP coverage period is being tracked. Links the GAP window to the originating order intake record.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title policy (owner or lender) that incorporates or is affected by this GAP coverage period. Populated after policy issuance.

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting referral record created when the GAP window exceeded allowed thresholds or required non-standard resolution. Null if no referral was required.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the county recorder formally accepted the submitted instruments for recording. Distinct from submission_date and recording_date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: The official book number assigned by the county recorder upon acceptance of the recorded instrument. Part of the recording reference (book/page) that closes the GAP window.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Production channel through which the title order was originated. Distinguishes direct branch, centralized lender, and independent agent channels for GAP performance analysis.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the real estate transaction closed and insured instruments were executed. Serves as the primary anchor for the GAP coverage start when later than last search date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GAP coverage period record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the gap coverage amount. Defaults to USD for domestic US title insurance transactions.

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: The eRecording gateway or submission method used to submit instruments to the county recorder. Identifies Simplifile, CSC eRecording, or direct county submission for operational tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; Simplifile / CSC eRecording

attributes.name: gap_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GAP coverage period was formally closed, either by confirmed recording, waiver, or expiration. Distinct from recording_date to accommodate non-recording closures.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of title insurance coverage extended during the GAP period. Typically equals the policy amount for the insured instruments pending recording.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: gap_cure_method
attributes.description: The method by which the GAP coverage period was resolved or cured. Recording confirmation is standard; affidavit, indemnity, waiver, or endorsement may be used in exceptional cases.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: gap_cure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the circumstances of GAP cure, including any non-standard resolution methods, underwriting exceptions, or curative actions taken to close the window.

attributes.name: gap_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between gap_start_date and gap_close_date (or current date if still open). Drives the policy-issuance-lag-after-recording and GAP aging metrics.

attributes.name: gap_escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the open GAP coverage period was escalated to underwriting or management review due to exceeding the maximum allowed duration or elevated risk classification.

attributes.name: gap_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated reference number uniquely identifying this GAP coverage period for operational tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gap_risk_flag
attributes.description: Underwriting risk classification assigned to this GAP period based on duration, jurisdiction, instrument type, and rejection history. Drives escalation and monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: gap_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GAP coverage window opens. Typically the closing date or the date of the last title search, whichever is later, per ALTA gap coverage standards.

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GAP coverage window. Open indicates recording not yet confirmed; closed indicates recording confirmed; expired indicates coverage lapsed without recording.

attributes.name: gap_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GAP coverage period by transaction type. Distinguishes standard purchase GAP from construction, HELOC, or refinance GAP windows with different risk profiles.

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: The unique instrument or document number assigned by the county recorder upon recording. Used as the primary recording reference in jurisdictions that do not use book/page.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: insured_instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of the primary instrument pending recording that is covered during the GAP period. Examples include Warranty Deed (WD), Deed of Trust (DOT), or mortgage.

attributes.name: is_gap_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GAP coverage window has exceeded the maximum allowed duration. True triggers underwriting escalation and potential coverage review per policy guidelines.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county or jurisdiction where recording is required. Drives jurisdiction-specific GAP duration rules and recording turnaround benchmarks.

tag_set.value: Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: last_rejection_reason
attributes.description: The most recent reason provided by the county recorder for rejecting the recording submission. Supports root-cause analysis of recording delays that extend the GAP window.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: last_search_date
attributes.description: The date through which the title search was last run prior to closing. Used to establish the beginning of the GAP period when it precedes the closing date.

attributes.name: max_allowed_gap_days
attributes.description: The maximum number of calendar days the GAP coverage window is permitted to remain open per underwriting guidelines or state regulatory requirements before escalation is required.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: The official page number assigned by the county recorder upon acceptance of the recorded instrument. Combined with book_number forms the complete recording reference.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds standards

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the confirmed recording_date and the date the title policy was issued. Directly supports the policy-issuance-lag-after-recording metric per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the title policy was issued following confirmed recording. Used to compute policy_issuance_lag_days and to confirm the GAP window is fully resolved.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GAP coverage applies to the Owner Title Policy (OTP), Lender Title Policy (LTP), or both. Drives separate owner-versus-lender coverage tracking per VREQ-010.

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this GAP coverage period record. Supports optimistic concurrency control and revision history tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: recording_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when recording confirmation was received from the eRecording gateway or county recorder, marking the official close of the GAP coverage window.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Simplifile / CSC eRecording standards

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insured instruments were officially recorded by the county recorder or register of deeds, closing the GAP coverage window. Null until recording is confirmed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder standards

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Number of times the recording submission was rejected by the county recorder prior to acceptance. Feeds the recording rejection and resubmission rate metric per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: resubmission_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent resubmission of instruments to the county recorder following a rejection. Null if no rejection has occurred.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this GAP coverage period record originated. Supports data lineage and provenance tracking across the title lifecycle.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the jurisdiction where the property is located and recording is performed. Used for state-level regulatory and underwriting rule application.
attributes.references: FIPS Publication 5-2; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insured instruments were submitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway. Distinct from closing_date, recording_date, and gap_start_date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying real estate transaction. Distinguishes purchase, refinance (REFI), HELOC, construction, and commercial transactions for GAP risk segmentation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GAP coverage period record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: uw_referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the extended GAP duration or non-standard cure method triggered an underwriting referral (UWR). True when gap_duration_days exceeds max_allowed_gap_days.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: fee
products.description: Reference master for county-level and instrument-type-level recording fee schedules maintained per jurisdiction (FIPS county code). Captures fee type (base recording fee, per-page fee, transfer tax, documentary stamp tax, mortgage tax, indexing fee), fee
products.reference: County Recording Fee Schedule — County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: fee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a recording fee schedule record. Primary key for the fee reference master.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.jurisdiction. Business justification: Fee schedules are jurisdiction-specific. The fee table currently has denormalized jurisdiction attributes (county_fips_code, state_code, recording_jurisdiction_name) that should be

attributes.name: prior_fee_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding fee schedule record that this version supersedes. Enables chain-of-version navigation for audit and historical fee reconstruction.

attributes.name: base_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat base fee charged per document submission regardless of page count, expressed in USD. Represents the minimum recording charge for the instrument type in this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: fee_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code assigned by the jurisdiction or the title production system (e.g., SoftPro/RamQuest) to uniquely identify this fee line within the county fee schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices / eRecording Gateway (Simplifile / CSC)

attributes.name: consideration_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum consideration amount above which transfer tax or documentary stamp tax applies. Transactions at or below this threshold may be exempt from the tax component.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage per ALTA Best Practices and SOC 2 requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary fee amounts in this record. Defaults to USD for domestic US recording jurisdictions.

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the fee, including statutory basis, applicability conditions, and any special instructions from the county recorder.

attributes.name: documentary_stamp_rate
attributes.description: Ad valorem rate applied to the consideration or loan amount to compute documentary stamp tax, expressed as a decimal. Common in Florida and other southeastern states.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule version becomes effective and must be applied to recording submissions. Supports lifecycle management and historical fee lookups.

attributes.name: enacted_date
attributes.description: Date the underlying statute, ordinance, or county resolution authorizing this fee schedule was enacted or signed into law. Supports regulatory audit and provenance.

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: Name of the eRecording gateway or submission channel accepted by this jurisdiction for electronic document submission (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording, direct county portal).

attributes.name: erecording_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recording jurisdiction accepts electronic recording (eRecording) submissions via gateways such as Simplifile or CSC eRecording for this instrument type.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule version expires and is superseded. Null indicates the record is open-ended and currently active. Supports bi-temporal fee lookups.

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this fee schedule record: active (currently in effect), inactive (no longer applicable), pending (approved but not yet effective), superseded (replaced by a newer version).

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee component: base_recording (flat per-document fee), per_page (per-page charge), transfer_tax (deed transfer tax), documentary_stamp (documentary stamp tax), mortgage_tax (mortgage recording tax), indexing (indexing/data-entry fee).

attributes.name: included_pages
attributes.description: Number of pages included in the base recording fee before per-page charges apply. A value of zero means per-page fees apply from the first page.

attributes.name: indexing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee charged by the county recorder for indexing the document in the grantor-grantee index, expressed in USD. May be per-name or per-document depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: indexing_fee_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the indexing fee is assessed: per_document (flat per submission), per_name (per grantor or grantee name indexed), or per_parcel (per APN/PIN indexed).

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Category of recorded instrument to which this fee applies (e.g., Deed of Trust, Warranty Deed, Mortgage, Release, Assignment, Lien). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule was last confirmed accurate against the official county recorder or state revenue department source. Supports data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: max_pages
attributes.description: Maximum number of pages accepted under this fee schedule tier. Null indicates no page cap. Used to determine if a document requires a higher fee tier or split submission.

attributes.name: mortgage_tax_rate
attributes.description: Ad valorem rate applied to the loan amount to compute mortgage recording tax, expressed as a decimal. Applicable in states such as New York, Florida, and Alabama.

attributes.name: fee_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fee as published by the recording jurisdiction or as labeled in the title production system (e.g., 'Deed Recording Fee', 'Per-Page Surcharge').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or known exceptions related to this fee schedule entry (e.g., 'Surcharge applies only to commercial deeds over $1M').

attributes.name: paper_recording_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction still accepts paper (physical) document submissions in addition to or instead of eRecording for this instrument type.

attributes.name: per_page_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fee charged per page of the recorded document beyond any included pages, expressed in USD. Used to calculate total recording fee based on page_count.

attributes.name: source_reference_url
attributes.description: URL of the official county recorder or state revenue department web page where this fee schedule is published. Supports provenance and verification of fee amounts.
attributes.references: County Recorder / State Department of Revenue

attributes.name: statutory_authority
attributes.description: Citation of the statute, code section, or county ordinance that authorizes this fee (e.g., 'Cal. Gov. Code § 27361', 'Fla. Stat. § 28.24'). Supports compliance and audit.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_exemption_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether statutory exemptions from transfer tax are available in this jurisdiction for qualifying transactions (e.g., inter-spousal transfers, government conveyances).

attributes.name: transfer_tax_exemption_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of jurisdiction-defined exemption codes that may be cited on the deed to claim transfer tax exemption (e.g., 'R11,R12' for California). Null if no exemptions apply.
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue / County Recorder

attributes.name: transfer_tax_per_unit_amount
attributes.description: Fixed transfer tax amount per unit of consideration (e.g., per $500 or per $1,000 of consideration), used in jurisdictions with tiered or per-unit transfer tax structures.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_rate
attributes.description: Ad valorem rate applied to the consideration amount to compute deed transfer tax, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.001100 = 0.11%). Null if transfer tax is not applicable for this fee type.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_unit_basis
attributes.description: The consideration increment (e.g., 500.00 or 1000.00 USD) used as the denominator for per-unit transfer tax calculations. Null if rate-based rather than per-unit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was last modified. Used to detect stale fee data and trigger re-verification workflows.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member, vendor, or automated process that last verified this fee schedule against the official source.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this fee schedule record within the same jurisdiction and instrument type. Increments each time the county updates its fee schedule, supporting history retention per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: jurisdiction
products.description: Master reference for every county recorder or register of deeds office that the business submits documents to. Captures FIPS county code, state, office name, recording office address, accepted submission channels (eRecording, mail, in-person), eRecording
products.reference: County Recorder / Register of Deeds — FIPS county code registry

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each county recorder or register of deeds jurisdiction record in the title insurance recording master reference.

attributes.name: erecording_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: The jurisdiction identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway (e.g., Simplifile county code) used to route electronic submissions. Distinct from the FIPS code; required for gateway API calls.

attributes.name: accepted_document_types
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of document types accepted for recording by this jurisdiction (e.g., deed, deed_of_trust, mortgage, release, assignment, lien). Used for submission validation and routing.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: avg_recording_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Typical number of business days from submission to acceptance/recording confirmation for this jurisdiction. Used to estimate gap-period duration and policy issuance lag after recording.

attributes.name: base_recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard base recording fee charged by this jurisdiction per document submission, in USD. Used for settlement statement (CD/HUD-1/ALTA) fee estimation and escrow disbursement calculation.

attributes.name: common_rejection_reasons
attributes.description: Free-text or comma-delimited list of the most frequent rejection reasons observed for this jurisdiction (e.g., missing notary seal, incorrect fee, margin violation). Used for submission quality improvement.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Official name of the county or county-equivalent (e.g., parish, borough, independent city) as designated by the state government. Used for display, reporting, and document preparation.

attributes.name: cover_sheet_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction requires a standardized cover sheet (e.g., ALTA or county-specific) to be attached to each document submission. Drives document preparation workflow.

attributes.name: cover_sheet_template_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the cover sheet template required by this jurisdiction. Used by the document preparation system to auto-attach the correct cover sheet to recording submissions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and record provenance tracking per ALTA Best Practices data governance requirements.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source from which this jurisdiction record's details were obtained or last refreshed (e.g., Simplifile county list, CSC eRecording, county website, PRIA directory, manual entry). Supports data lineage.

attributes.name: erecording_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction accepts electronic recording (eRecording) submissions via an approved gateway such as Simplifile or CSC eRecording. Drives submission channel routing logic.
attributes.references: PRIA eRecording Standards; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: Name of the eRecording gateway platform used to submit documents to this jurisdiction (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording). Drives API routing and submission tracking integration.

attributes.name: fee_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current recording fee schedule (base_recording_fee_amount, fee_per_page_amount, transfer_tax_rate) became effective for this jurisdiction. Supports fee schedule versioning.

attributes.name: fee_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current recording fee schedule expires or is superseded. Null indicates the fee schedule is open-ended. Used for fee schedule lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fee_per_page_amount
attributes.description: Additional recording fee charged per page beyond the base fee, in USD. Used to calculate total recording fees for multi-page instruments on the settlement statement.

attributes.name: fips_county_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code uniquely identifying the county or county-equivalent jurisdiction per NIST FIPS 6-4. Used as the primary geographic key for recording office lookup and eRecording gateway routing.

tag_set.value: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: font_size_minimum_pt
attributes.description: Minimum font size in points required for text in documents submitted to this jurisdiction. Enforced during document preparation to prevent rejection due to illegibility.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: gap_coverage_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether gap coverage (GAP) is applicable in this jurisdiction, covering the period between closing and confirmed recording. Drives gap-period risk monitoring and policy issuance lag tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Commitment; State Recording Law

attributes.name: in_person_submission_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction accepts in-person document submission at the recording office counter. Used for same-day recording needs and courier delivery.

attributes.name: ipen_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction accepts documents notarized via In-Person Electronic Notarization (IPEN). Used alongside ron_accepted to determine eligible closing modalities.
attributes.references: State Notary Law; MISMO eClosing Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale fee schedules, outdated submission channel flags, or changed office contact information.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the jurisdiction record details (fees, channels, contact info) were last verified against the official county recorder source. Supports data quality monitoring and stale-reference alerting.

attributes.name: mail_submission_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction accepts document submissions via postal mail. Used as a fallback channel when eRecording is unavailable or rejected.

attributes.name: margin_requirement_inches
attributes.description: Minimum margin size in inches required on all pages of documents submitted to this jurisdiction. Non-compliant margins are a common rejection cause; used in document preparation validation.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5

attributes.name: max_pages_base_fee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Pages Included in Base Fee
attributes.description: Number of pages included in the base recording fee before per-page charges apply. Used with fee_per_page_amount to compute total recording fees for documents exceeding the base page threshold.

tag_set.value: Maximum Pages Included in Base Fee

attributes.name: notarization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether notarization is required for documents submitted to this jurisdiction. Drives closing workflow requirements for notary scheduling and RON/IPEN eligibility.
attributes.references: State Notary Law; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: office_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the recording office, used for mail and in-person document submission. Required when eRecording is unavailable or rejected documents must be physically resubmitted.

attributes.name: office_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, room number) for the recording office. Supplements office_address_line1 for precise physical delivery of documents.

attributes.name: office_city
attributes.description: City in which the recording office is physically located. Used in conjunction with state_code and office_zip_code for mail submission addressing and courier routing.

attributes.name: office_email
attributes.description: Official email address for the recording office, used for submission inquiries, rejection notices, and correspondence regarding recorded instruments.

attributes.name: office_fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the recording office, used in jurisdictions that accept fax-based document submission or rejection notice delivery.

attributes.name: office_hours
attributes.description: Standard business hours of the recording office (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 CT'). Used to determine same-day recording eligibility and courier delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: office_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the recording office, used to resolve rejection inquiries, confirm receipt of mailed documents, and coordinate resubmission.

attributes.name: office_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the recording jurisdiction. Inactive or merged jurisdictions are retained for historical recording reference but blocked from new submission routing.

attributes.name: office_website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the recording office, providing access to fee schedules, accepted document formats, cover-sheet requirements, and online search portals.

attributes.name: office_zip_code
attributes.description: USPS ZIP or ZIP+4 code for the recording office mailing address. Used for mail submission routing and courier delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: plant_coverage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a title plant (DataTrace, TitlePoint, or county plant index) provides automated search coverage for this jurisdiction. Drives search channel selection in the title production system.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant Standards

attributes.name: plant_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the title plant or automated search provider covering this jurisdiction (e.g., DataTrace, TitlePoint). Used for search order routing and vendor management.

attributes.name: recording_act_type
attributes.description: Type of recording act governing priority of recorded instruments in this jurisdiction: race (first to record wins), notice (subsequent BFP without notice wins), or race_notice (both conditions required). Critical for chain-of-title analysis.
attributes.references: State Property Law; ALTA Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: recording_office_name
attributes.description: Official name of the county recorder, register of deeds, or equivalent recording authority (e.g., 'Travis County Clerk', 'Cook County Recorder of Deeds'). Used on cover sheets and submission routing.

attributes.name: recording_office_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recording authority type, which varies by state (e.g., county_recorder in CA, register_of_deeds in MI, county_clerk in TX). Drives cover-sheet template and fee schedule selection.

attributes.name: recording_reference_format
attributes.description: Format used by this jurisdiction to assign recording references to accepted instruments (e.g., book/page, instrument number, document number). Determines how recording_reference_number is parsed and stored.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: rejection_rate_pct
attributes.description: Observed percentage of document submissions rejected by this jurisdiction, based on historical submission data. Used for recording rejection/resubmission rate metrics and operational risk monitoring.

attributes.name: ron_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction accepts documents notarized via Remote Online Notarization (RON). Drives closing channel eligibility and notarization workflow routing.
attributes.references: State RON Statute; MISMO RON Standards

attributes.name: same_day_recording_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour) by which a document must be submitted to qualify for same-day recording in this jurisdiction. Critical for gap-period management and closing scheduling.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; County Recorder Policy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which this recording jurisdiction is located (e.g., TX, CA, FL). Used for state-level recording rule application and regulatory routing.

attributes.name: state_specific_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing jurisdiction-specific recording requirements, exceptions, or procedural notes not captured in structured fields (e.g., special deed tax stamps, unique cover sheet rules, holiday closures).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Recording Statute

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the recording office (e.g., 'America/Chicago'). Used to calculate same-day recording cutoff times and gap-period timestamps accurately.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_basis
attributes.description: Specifies the taxable basis for documentary transfer tax in this jurisdiction (e.g., full consideration, equity only, loan amount). Required for accurate transfer tax calculation on the settlement statement.

attributes.name: transfer_tax_rate
attributes.description: Documentary transfer tax rate applied to the consideration amount for deed recordings in this jurisdiction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.001100 for $1.10 per $1,000). Used for settlement fee calculation.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective
