products.name: submission_status_history
products.description: Immutable lifecycle history table preserving every status transition for a recording_submission — from initial submission through any rejections, curative corrections, resubmissions, and final acceptance or recording confirmation.
products.reference: Recording Submission Lifecycle Audit — eRecording gateway event log

attributes.name: submission_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable status transition record in the recording submission lifecycle history. Primary key of this append-only event log.

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: External transaction identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway for this specific status event or acknowledgment message, enabling reconciliation with gateway logs.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.party. Business justification: Tracks which party (closer, examiner, agent, underwriter) initiated each submission status transition. Operational accountability and audit trail for recording workflow.

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent recording_submission record whose lifecycle this history row documents. Every history row belongs to exactly one submission.

attributes.name: submission_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific submission_document record associated with this status transition, linking the history event to the individual instrument being tracked.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating title order that initiated the recording workflow, enabling end-to-end traceability from order intake through recording confirmation.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the county recorder or eRecording gateway formally accepted the submission for processing, distinct from the recording_date and submission_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO v3.4; VREQ-008

attributes.name: book_number
attributes.description: Official book number assigned by the county recorder at recording, part of the book/page reference used in traditional deed indexing systems. Populated only upon confirmed recording.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder indexing standards

attributes.name: county_acknowledgment_code
attributes.description: Acknowledgment or confirmation code returned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway for this status event, used for reconciliation and dispute resolution with the recording authority.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording gateway specifications; county recorder acknowledgment standards

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county recorder or register of deeds jurisdiction where this recording submission status event applies. Supports jurisdiction-level reporting.

tag_set.value: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this status history record was first written to the data store. Immutable audit field supporting append-only event log integrity and RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1

attributes.name: curative_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific corrective action taken or required to resolve the rejection and enable resubmission, supporting curative aging and effectiveness tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; title curative processing standards

attributes.name: curative_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rejection or status transition requires a curative action (document correction, fee adjustment, re-notarization) before resubmission can proceed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; title curative processing standards

attributes.name: curative_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the curative action addressing a rejection was completed, enabling measurement of curative cycle time between rejection and resubmission readiness.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; title curative processing standards

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the submission spent in status_from before transitioning to status_to. Supports title clearance cycle time and recording aging metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of instrument being tracked in this status history event (e.g., Deed of Trust, Warranty Deed, Release). Supports document-type-level rejection rate analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO v3.4 document type codes

attributes.name: erecording_gateway
attributes.description: The electronic recording gateway or channel through which this submission status event was transmitted or received (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording). Supports gateway-level rejection rate analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder eRecording standards

attributes.name: event_source
attributes.description: System or actor that triggered this status transition. Identifies whether the change originated from the eRecording gateway, county recorder response, internal workflow, or manual override. Core EVENT_SOURCE_REFERENCE.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone offset) when this status transition occurred, as recorded by the eRecording gateway or internal processing system. Core EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this log.
attributes.references: MISMO v3.4; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2

attributes.name: fee_correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recording fee correction was applied at this status transition, distinguishing fee-related rejections and corrections from other rejection types in root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: RESPA; CFPB TRID; county recorder fee schedules

attributes.name: gap_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GAP coverage period closed, typically upon confirmed recording. A null value indicates the gap remains open and the instrument is not yet confirmed recorded.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GAP coverage period (between closing and confirmed recording) is active at the time of this status event, supporting gap-period risk monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Gap Coverage endorsement standards; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: gap_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the GAP coverage period was open as of this status event, calculated from gap_open_date. Supports gap-period aging and policy-issuance-lag-after-recording metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; ALTA Gap Coverage endorsement standards

attributes.name: gap_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GAP coverage period opened (typically the closing/disbursement date), marking the start of the unrecorded instrument risk window for this submission.

attributes.name: initiated_by_role
attributes.description: Business role of the actor who triggered this status transition, distinguishing automated gateway events from manual escrow officer or recording specialist actions for workflow analysis.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1

attributes.name: initiated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or system account identifier of the person or automated process that triggered this status transition, supporting audit trail and accountability for manual overrides.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GLBA; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Sequential instrument number assigned by the county recorder upon recording, used as the primary public index reference in jurisdictions that use instrument-number indexing rather than book/page.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder indexing standards

attributes.name: is_resubmission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents a resubmission following a prior rejection, distinguishing initial submissions from corrective resubmissions in workflow analytics.

attributes.name: is_terminal_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether status_to represents a terminal (final) state in the submission lifecycle (RECORDED or CANCELLED), enabling efficient filtering for open versus closed submissions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recording specialist or system at the time of this status transition, capturing context not covered by structured fields (e.g., verbal county instructions).

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Official page number assigned by the county recorder at recording, completing the book/page reference. Populated only upon confirmed recording.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder indexing standards

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the confirmed recording_date and the date a title policy was issued, as captured at this status event. Supports the policy-issuance-lag-after-recording metric per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Official date on which the instrument was recorded by the county recorder, as confirmed at this status transition. Populated only when status_to = RECORDED. Distinct from submission_date and acceptance_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; RESPA; county recorder recording date standards

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Recording fee amount (USD) applicable at this status transition, which may differ from the original submission if a fee correction was required to resolve a rejection.
attributes.references: RESPA; CFPB TRID; county recorder fee schedules

attributes.name: recording_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the county recorder or register of deeds office (e.g., 'Cook County Recorder of Deeds') associated with this status event, complementing the FIPS code.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder office naming conventions

attributes.name: recording_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number assigned by the county recorder upon confirmed recording (e.g., instrument number, document number). Populated when status_to = RECORDED; null for pre-recording events.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder indexing standards

attributes.name: rejection_category
attributes.description: Normalized classification of the rejection cause, grouping raw rejection codes into analytical categories for rejection root-cause analysis and resubmission rate metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO v3.4 recording defect taxonomy

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code assigned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway identifying the specific reason for rejection at this transition (e.g., missing notary, incorrect fee, illegible document).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; county recorder rejection code standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the rejection reason as returned by the county recorder or eRecording gateway, providing human-readable context for curative action and resubmission.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CFPB TRID compliance

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time spent in the prior status exceeded the applicable SLA threshold for that status, supporting recording turnaround SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; lender SLA agreements

attributes.name: sla_threshold_days
attributes.description: The SLA threshold in calendar days applicable to the prior status at the time of this transition, against which days_in_prior_status is evaluated for breach determination.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; lender SLA agreements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the recording jurisdiction, supporting state-level regulatory reporting and recording rejection rate metrics.

attributes.name: status_from
attributes.description: The submission lifecycle status immediately before this transition. Enables full before/after audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|PENDING_REVIEW|REJECTED|CORRECTED|RESUBMITTED|ACCEPTED|RECORDED|CANCELLED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Simplifile / CSC eRecording gateway status codes

attributes.name: status_to
attributes.description: The submission lifecycle status entered as a result of this transition. Together with status_from, defines the complete state machine arc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|PENDING_REVIEW|REJECTED|CORRECTED|RESUBMITTED|ACCEPTED|RECORDED|CANCELLED —
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Simplifile / CSC eRecording gateway status codes

attributes.name: submission_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of the submission attempt associated with this status event (1 = initial, 2 = first resubmission, etc.). Supports recording rejection and resubmission rate metrics.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recording package was submitted to the county recorder or eRecording gateway for this attempt, distinct from acceptance_date and recording_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO v3.4; VREQ-008

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the nature of this status change, distinguishing initial submissions from rejections, corrections, resubmissions, and final recording confirmations for workflow analytics.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: gateway_transaction
products.description: Transactional SSOT for each eRecording gateway exchange (Simplifile, CSC eRecording, ePN) associated with a recording_submission. Captures the gateway package identifier, gateway vendor, outbound submission acknowledgment (ACK/NACK), gateway pre-screen

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eRecording gateway transaction exchange record. Primary key for the gateway_transaction entity.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the title company user or system account that initiated the gateway submission. Supports audit trail and accountability for recording submissions.

attributes.name: prior_gateway_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding gateway transaction for the same recording_submission. Enables chain-of-resubmission traceability and lifecycle history preservation.

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent recording_submission that initiated this gateway transaction. Links the gateway exchange back to the title lifecycle recording event.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_code
attributes.description: Gateway-issued acknowledgment code: ACK indicates the package was received and queued for county review; NACK indicates the package failed gateway pre-screen and was not forwarded.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the eRecording gateway issued an ACK (acknowledgment) or NACK (negative acknowledgment) confirming receipt of the submitted package.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: Date the real estate transaction closed, establishing the start of the GAP coverage window. Distinct from submission_timestamp and recording_date per VREQ-008.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CFPB TRID; VREQ-008

attributes.name: county_response_code
attributes.description: Machine-readable response code returned by the county recorder system indicating acceptance, rejection, or return status. Format varies by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; MISMO eRecording Standards

attributes.name: county_response_message
attributes.description: Free-text message returned by the county recorder describing the acceptance confirmation, rejection reason, or return instructions for this gateway transaction.

attributes.name: county_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the county recorder or register of deeds returned an acceptance, rejection, or return response to the gateway for this transaction.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; MISMO eRecording Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this gateway_transaction record was first created in the system of record. Audit timestamp distinct from the business event submission_timestamp.

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Number of individual documents included in the gateway submission package for this transaction. A single submission may contain a deed, deed of trust, and other instruments.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; MISMO eRecording Standards

attributes.name: document_type_codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of document type codes included in the submission package (e.g., WD, DOT, RECONVEYANCE, RELEASE). Supports instrument-level recording analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: erecording_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document was submitted electronically (eRecording), as a paper document, or via a hybrid method. Supports eRecording adoption tracking.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; MISMO eRecording Standards

attributes.name: fee_payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to remit the recording fee to the county recorder via the gateway (e.g., ACH, credit card, pre-funded gateway account, escrow account draw).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: fee_payment_reference
attributes.description: Transaction reference number or confirmation code for the recording fee payment submitted with this gateway transaction. Used for fee reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: gap_coverage_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the closing date and the confirmed recording_date, representing the GAP coverage exposure window. Computed at recording confirmation; null while gap_period_open is true.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Insurance GAP Coverage

attributes.name: gap_period_open
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GAP coverage period (between closing and confirmed recording) remains open for this transaction. True until recording_date is confirmed and provenance fed back to the policy.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Insurance GAP Coverage

attributes.name: gateway_account_code
attributes.description: Account identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway vendor to the submitting organization. Used for gateway billing, fee reconciliation, and access control.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: gateway_api_version
attributes.description: Version of the eRecording gateway API used for this transaction. Tracks API compatibility and supports troubleshooting of format or protocol changes.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: gateway_package_code
attributes.description: Externally assigned package identifier issued by the eRecording gateway vendor (e.g., Simplifile package ID, CSC eRecording package number) for this submission bundle.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: gateway_session_code
attributes.description: Session or connection identifier assigned by the eRecording gateway for the API or portal session during which this transaction was submitted. Supports gateway audit and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: gateway_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the eRecording gateway vendor used to transmit documents to the county recorder or register of deeds (e.g., Simplifile, CSC eRecording, ePN).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3 — Electronic Recording

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gateway transaction was flagged for expedited or priority recording processing at the county recorder. Used to track SLA performance for rush recordings.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county or jurisdiction to which the document package was submitted for recording. Enables jurisdiction-level recording performance analysis.

tag_set.value: Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the county recorder or register of deeds office receiving the submission (e.g., 'Cook County Recorder of Deeds'). Complements the FIPS code for display and reporting.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Title production system order number associated with this gateway transaction. Provides cross-reference to the originating title order for end-to-end lifecycle traceability.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System (SoftPro / RamQuest / Qualia)

attributes.name: package_page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages across all documents in the gateway submission package. Used for recording fee calculation and county intake validation.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: policy_issuance_lag_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Policy Issuance Lag Days After Recording
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the confirmed recording_date and the date the title policy was issued. Key metric per VREQ-016 for policy issuance lag after recording.

tag_set.value: Policy Issuance Lag Days After Recording

attributes.name: prescreen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason the gateway pre-screen failed, as returned by the gateway vendor. Null when prescreen_status is PASSED or BYPASSED.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: prescreen_status
attributes.description: Result of the gateway vendor pre-screen validation applied before forwarding to the county recorder. FAILED indicates a format, fee, or completeness error caught at the gateway level.
attributes.references: Simplifile / CSC eRecording Gateway API Specification

attributes.name: provenance_fed_back
attributes.description: Indicates whether the confirmed recording reference number and recording_date have been fed back to the title policy and title lifecycle records. Supports evidence completeness and provenance tracking.

attributes.name: provenance_feedback_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the recording reference number and recording_date were successfully fed back to the title production system and policy records. Null until provenance_fed_back is true.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Official date the document was recorded by the county recorder, as stamped on the recorded instrument. Distinct from submission_timestamp. Drives GAP coverage window closure and policy issuance lag metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; VREQ-008; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total recording fee amount submitted to the county recorder with this gateway transaction, in US dollars. Includes per-page and per-document fees as applicable by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; RESPA; CFPB TRID

attributes.name: recording_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the recording fee amount. Typically USD for domestic US title transactions.

attributes.name: recording_reference_number
attributes.description: Official recording reference number assigned by the county recorder upon acceptance, including book and page or instrument number. Null until county acceptance is confirmed.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recording_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the document was officially recorded by the county recorder, including time-of-day where available. Supports GAP period calculation at minute-level precision.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; County Recorder / Register of Deeds; MISMO eRecording Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for county rejection (e.g., insufficient fee, missing notary, incorrect legal description). Drives rejection root-cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the county rejection reason, supplementing the rejection_reason_code with narrative detail for curative action and resubmission planning.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: resubmission_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of resubmission attempts for the parent recording_submission. Value is 0 for the initial submission and increments by 1 for each subsequent resubmission. Supports resubmission rate metrics.

attributes.name: sla_actual_hours
attributes.description: Actual elapsed hours from submission_timestamp to county_response_timestamp for this transaction. Compared against sla_target_hours to assess recording cycle time performance.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Service level agreement target turnaround time in hours from submission to county acceptance for this transaction, based on jurisdiction and transaction type.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the jurisdiction where the document is being recorded. Used for state-level regulatory reporting and recording fee schedules.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the document package was transmitted outbound to the eRecording gateway. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used to measure recording cycle time.

attributes.name: submitter_organization

attributes.name: transaction_status

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the gateway exchange: initial submission, resubmission after rejection, withdrawal, status inquiry, or rejection response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote if values expand]

attributes.description: Date and time this gateway_transaction record was last modified, such as when a county response was received or provenance was fed back. Supports lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: agent_authority_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the effective-dated agent authority record. Primary key for the agent_authority product in the Agency Management and Remittance System.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id

attributes.name: agent_profile_id

attributes.name: prior_authority_id

attributes.name: approval_status

products.name: agreement
products.description: Formal agency agreement between the title underwriter and an independent title agent or direct branch, governing the scope of authority, geographic territory, transaction types, premium split schedule, remittance terms, and compliance obligations.
products.reference: ALTA Agency Agreement

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the agency agreement record in the title insurance system of record.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent or direct-branch party that is a signatory to this agency agreement.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title underwriter (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) that is the issuing underwriter party to this agency agreement.

attributes.name: prior_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predecessor agency agreement record that this agreement supersedes or renews. Null for initial agreements. Preserves chain-of-agreement history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: agent_premium_split_pct
attributes.description: Contractual percentage of gross title premium retained by the agent (e.g., 0.8000 = 80%). The underwriter retains the remainder. Drives remittance calculation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; State Department of Insurance premium-split rules

attributes.name: aggregate_liability_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate insured liability (in USD) the agent may carry in a rolling 12-month period before mandatory underwriter review. Supports risk-exposure monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the agency agreement. Controls whether the agent may issue commitments and policies under this agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|suspended|terminated|expired|pending_renewal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agency relationship: independent agent, direct branch, centralized lender channel, or affiliated agency. Drives authority and remittance rules.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Running count of formal amendments executed against this agency agreement. Supports lifecycle revision tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractual frequency at which the underwriter is entitled to conduct an agency audit of the agent's books, records, and escrow accounts under this agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: Scope of underwriting authority granted to the agent: full authority to issue all products, limited to specific transaction types, conditional on referral, or suspended.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency agreement automatically renews at expiration unless either party provides notice of non-renewal within the notice period.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification for this agreement: direct branch, independent agent, or centralized lender channel. Aligns with order-routing and premium-reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CRM / Order Routing Platform

attributes.name: commercial_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to handle commercial real-estate transactions under this agreement. False restricts agent to residential transactions only.

attributes.name: cpl_authority_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Closing Protection Letter (CPL) Issuance Authority Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to issue Closing Protection Letters (CPLs) under this agreement. True = CPL authority granted.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CPL issuance guidelines

tag_set.value: Closing Protection Letter (CPL) Issuance Authority Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this agency agreement record was first created in the Agency Management and Remittance System. Audit trail for record provenance.

attributes.name: current_version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the current executed agreement document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented with each amendment. Supports revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: document_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the executed agreement document in the Document Management and Imaging System. Enables retrieval of the signed agreement for audit and legal review.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agency agreement becomes legally binding and the agent is authorized to issue title products. Distinct from execution date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: endorsement_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to issue ALTA endorsements (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22) without underwriter pre-approval under this agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; ALTA Endorsement guidelines

attributes.name: eo_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing the agent's E&O coverage. Used for underwriter oversight and ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3 audit.

attributes.name: eo_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Minimum required E&O coverage amount (in USD) as stipulated in the agency agreement. Verified at onboarding and each renewal cycle.

attributes.name: eo_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Expiration Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the agent's current E&O insurance policy. Agreement may be suspended if E&O lapses. Drives compliance-monitoring alerts.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Expiration Date

attributes.name: eo_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the agent's Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance policy required under the agency agreement. Supports ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3 compliance verification.

attributes.name: escrow_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to conduct escrow closings and hold trust funds under this agreement. Drives IOLTA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2; IOLTA rules

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties physically or electronically signed the agency agreement. Distinct from effective date per VREQ-008.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agency agreement is scheduled to expire unless renewed. Null for perpetual agreements. Used for renewal-pipeline and compliance-monitoring metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: fidelity_bond_amount
attributes.description: Face amount (in USD) of the fidelity/surety bond held by the agent. Null if no bond is required under this agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: fidelity_bond_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the agent's fidelity bond. Null if no bond is required. Monitored alongside E&O expiration for compliance continuity.

attributes.name: fidelity_bond_number
attributes.description: Bond number of the agent's fidelity/surety bond if required by the underwriter or state regulator as a condition of the agency agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: geographic_territory
attributes.description: Description or code of the geographic territory (state(s), county FIPS codes, or MSA) within which the agent is authorized to issue title products under this agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; FIPS county codes

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of this agency agreement.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed underwriter audit of this agent under this agreement. Used to calculate days-since-last-audit for oversight metrics.

attributes.name: max_liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount (in USD) the agent is authorized to issue on a single title policy without underwriter referral. Enforces per-transaction authority ceiling.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or calculated due date for the next underwriter audit of this agent. Derived from last_audit_date and audit_frequency but stored for operational scheduling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriter or compliance officer notes regarding special conditions, waivers, or observations associated with this agency agreement.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of written notice required by either party to terminate the agency agreement without cause, as specified in the agreement terms.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this agency agreement by the underwriter, used in remittance and compliance correspondence.

attributes.name: oversight_risk_tier
attributes.description: Underwriter-assigned risk tier for this agent based on volume, compliance history, and audit findings. Drives audit frequency and enhanced monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: remittance_due_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of the remittance period within which the agent must submit the remittance report and payment to the underwriter.

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Contractual frequency at which the agent must remit the underwriter's share of collected premiums. Drives remittance-timeliness metric and agency settlement schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 6; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agency agreement was most recently renewed. Null if never renewed. Supports renewal-cycle tracking and remittance-timeliness metrics.

attributes.name: state_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-letter US state codes in which the agent is licensed and authorized to issue title products under this agreement (e.g., 'TX,OK,NM').

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agency agreement was terminated prior to or at expiration. Null if agreement is still active or expired naturally.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for agreement termination. Supports agency oversight reporting and regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|non_renewal|compliance_violation|underwriter_action|license_lapse|eo_lapse|mutual_consent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1; State Department of Insurance

products.name: eo_coverage
products.description: Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance coverage record for an independent title agent, capturing carrier name, policy number, coverage effective date, expiration date, per-occurrence limit, aggregate limit, deductible, and verification status.
products.reference: E&O (Errors and Omissions) Insurance

attributes.name: eo_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an E&O insurance coverage record associated with an independent title agent. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency agreement under which this E&O coverage requirement applies. Links the coverage record to the specific contractual authority relationship between agent and underwriter.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent entity for whom this E&O coverage record is maintained. Links coverage to the agent profile in the Agency Management System.

attributes.name: additional_insured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Additional Insured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriter or title company is listed as an additional insured on the agent's E&O policy. Some underwriter agency agreements require additional insured status.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Additional Insured Flag

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total dollar amount the E&O policy will pay across all covered claims during the policy period. Used to assess overall coverage adequacy relative to agent transaction volume.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the E&O policy was cancelled by the carrier or agent, if applicable. Null for active or expired policies. Triggers immediate agent authority review and potential suspension.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for policy cancellation when coverage_status is cancelled. Used to assess whether cancellation was voluntary or involuntary and to inform agent risk classification.

attributes.name: carrier_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the E&O carrier. Enables regulatory lookup of carrier licensing, financial ratings, and admitted status by state.

tag_set.value: Carrier National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Code

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance carrier underwriting the E&O policy. Used to assess carrier financial strength and validate coverage acceptability per underwriter requirements.

attributes.name: certificate_holder_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Certificate Holder Name
attributes.description: Name of the certificate holder listed on the E&O certificate of insurance, typically the underwriter or title company requiring proof of coverage from the independent agent.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Certificate Holder Name

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Certificate of Insurance Number
attributes.description: Number from the ACORD certificate of insurance or equivalent document provided as evidence of E&O coverage. Used to cross-reference the physical or electronic certificate on file.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Certificate of Insurance Number

attributes.name: coverage_gap_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Gap Days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of lapsed E&O coverage between the prior policy expiration and the current policy effective date. Zero or null when no gap exists. Used for risk scoring.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Gap Days

attributes.name: coverage_gap_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Gap Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a gap in continuous E&O coverage exists between the prior policy expiration and the current policy effective date. A gap may expose the agent and underwriter to uninsured risk.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Gap Flag

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the E&O coverage record. Drives agent authority eligibility; an agent with non-active status may be suspended from issuing commitments or policies.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the E&O policy is written on a claims-made, occurrence, or claims-made-and-reported basis. Affects how claims are triggered and reported under the policy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this E&O coverage record was first created in the Agency Management and Remittance System. Supports audit trail and record provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary limit and deductible amounts on this E&O coverage record. Typically USD for domestic title agents.

attributes.name: days_until_expiration
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Days Until Expiration
attributes.description: Number of calendar days remaining until the E&O policy expires, calculated from the current date. Used for aging and expiration-risk dashboards in agency oversight reporting.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Days Until Expiration

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount the agent is responsible for paying per claim before E&O coverage applies. Relevant to underwriter risk assessment and agent financial responsibility evaluation.

attributes.name: document_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Document Reference ID
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the stored certificate of insurance or policy document in the Document Management and Imaging System. Enables retrieval of the source evidence for audit purposes.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Document Reference ID

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Effective Date
attributes.description: Date on which the E&O policy coverage begins. Used to determine whether coverage was in force at the time of a specific title transaction or claim event.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Effective Date

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date on which the E&O policy coverage expires. Triggers renewal workflow and agent authority suspension if not renewed prior to expiration.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Expiration Date

attributes.name: extended_reporting_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Extended Reporting Period End Date
attributes.description: End date of the extended reporting period (tail coverage) if applicable. Null when no ERP endorsement is in effect. Used to determine whether late-reported claims remain eligible.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Extended Reporting Period End Date

attributes.name: extended_reporting_period_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Extended Reporting Period (ERP) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an extended reporting period (tail coverage) endorsement is in effect, allowing claims to be reported after policy expiration for acts occurring during the policy period.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Extended Reporting Period (ERP) Flag

attributes.name: meets_minimum_requirements
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Meets Minimum Requirements Flag
attributes.description: Computed flag indicating whether the current E&O coverage meets all underwriter-mandated minimum requirements for per-occurrence limit, aggregate limit, and policy status. Drives authority eligibility.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Meets Minimum Requirements Flag

attributes.name: minimum_required_aggregate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Minimum Required Aggregate Limit
attributes.description: Underwriter-mandated minimum aggregate coverage limit required for this agent's authority level. Used to flag coverage deficiency when actual aggregate limit falls below threshold.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; Underwriting Agency Agreement

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Minimum Required Aggregate Limit

attributes.name: minimum_required_per_occurrence
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Minimum Required Per-Occurrence Limit
attributes.description: Underwriter-mandated minimum per-occurrence coverage limit required for this agent's authority level. Used to flag coverage deficiency when actual per-occurrence limit falls below threshold.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; Underwriting Agency Agreement

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Minimum Required Per-Occurrence Limit

attributes.name: named_insured
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity or individual listed as the named insured on the E&O policy. Must match the agent entity name on file to confirm coverage applies to the correct party.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agency oversight staff to record observations, exceptions, or follow-up actions related to this E&O coverage record. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the E&O policy will pay for a single covered claim or occurrence. Compared against underwriter minimum coverage thresholds for agent authority approval.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned policy number for the E&O insurance policy. Used as the primary external business identifier for the coverage record and referenced during agent oversight audits.

attributes.name: prior_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Number
attributes.description: Policy number of the immediately preceding E&O policy for this agent. Supports chain-of-coverage analysis and retroactive date continuity verification for claims-made policies.

tag_set.value: Prior Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Number

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Renewal Reminder Date
attributes.description: Date on which the renewal reminder notification was sent to the agent. Null if no reminder has been sent. Used to track compliance outreach timing relative to expiration date.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Renewal Reminder Date

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Renewal Reminder Sent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a renewal reminder notification has been sent to the agent prior to policy expiration. Supports proactive compliance management and prevents inadvertent coverage lapses.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Renewal Reminder Sent Flag

attributes.name: retroactive_date
attributes.description: For claims-made policies, the earliest date from which covered acts or omissions are eligible for coverage. Critical for determining whether prior title work is covered under the current policy.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this E&O coverage record in the originating source system. Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the upstream Agency Management System.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this E&O coverage record originated, such as the Agency Management and Remittance System or CRM. Supports data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the state in which the E&O policy is primarily applicable or where the agent is licensed. Some states impose minimum E&O requirements by regulation.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: state_minimum_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Minimum Errors and Omissions (E&O) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state in which the agent operates mandates a minimum E&O coverage level by regulation. Used to distinguish regulatory minimums from underwriter contractual minimums.

tag_set.value: State Minimum Errors and Omissions (E&O) Required Flag

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this E&O coverage record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale records and to sequence updates during incremental data loads to the Silver layer.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the E&O coverage was most recently verified as active and compliant by the agency oversight team. Used to track verification currency and schedule re-verification.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the E&O coverage, such as review of a certificate of insurance, direct carrier confirmation, or third-party database lookup. Affects verification reliability scoring.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the internal verification process confirming the E&O policy is valid, in force, and meets underwriter minimum requirements. Drives agent onboarding and ongoing compliance workflows.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member or automated process that performed the most recent E&O coverage verification. Supports audit trail for agency compliance oversight.

attributes.name: premium_split_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a premium split schedule record defining contractual agent/underwriter split rates for an agency agreement.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency agreement under which this premium split schedule is defined. Links the split schedule to the governing contractual relationship.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent or agency entity to which this split schedule applies. Supports agent-level remittance and oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title underwriter (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) that is the counterparty to the agent in this split arrangement.

attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_premium_split_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer premium_split_schedule record that replaced this one. Null if this is the current active schedule. Preserves revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: agent_split_rate
attributes.description: Contractual proportion of gross premium retained by the independent title agent, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.800000 = 80%). Core metric for remittance-timeliness analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this split schedule received final internal approval. Distinct from effective_date; a schedule may be approved before it becomes effective.

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the underwriter authority or compliance officer who approved this split schedule. Supports audit trail and SOX controls.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel to which this split schedule applies: independent agent, direct branch, or centralized lender channel. Supports channel-level remittance analytics.

attributes.name: cpl_fee_split_rate

attributes.description: Agent's contractual split rate applied to Closing Protection Letter (CPL) fees collected. Distinct from policy premium split rates.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance
