attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this premium split schedule record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and record provenance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this schedule. Typically USD for US domestic title operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this premium split schedule becomes contractually binding and applicable to new policy transactions. Supports effective-dated rate lookup.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: endorsement_split_rate
attributes.description: Agent's contractual split rate applied specifically to ALTA endorsement premiums (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22). May differ from base policy split rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this premium split schedule ceases to apply. Null indicates an open-ended schedule with no defined end date.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: is_tiered_schedule
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is one tier within a multi-tier split structure. True when premium_floor_amount and premium_ceiling_amount define a band.

attributes.name: minimum_agent_remittance_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount the agent must remit to the underwriter per remittance cycle, regardless of split calculation. Null if no minimum applies.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special conditions associated with this split schedule, such as volume incentive clauses or underwriter-specific exceptions.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this split schedule applies to the Owner's Title Policy (OTP), Lender's Title Policy (LTP), or both. Owner and lender policies carry distinct split rates per VREQ-010.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; VREQ-010

attributes.name: premium_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: Maximum gross premium threshold above which this split schedule no longer applies. Null indicates no upper bound. Supports tiered split structures.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: premium_floor_amount
attributes.description: Minimum gross premium threshold below which this split schedule applies. Supports tiered split structures where rates change at premium breakpoints.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: property_type_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether this split schedule applies to residential, commercial, or both property types. Commercial transactions may carry different negotiated split rates.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the split rates are derived from state-filed rates, individually negotiated contract terms, or a statutory minimum/maximum rate schedule.

attributes.name: reissue_credit_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether reissue/refinance credit discounts are factored into the premium base before applying the split rates under this schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: remittance_due_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of the remittance period by which the agent must submit payment to the underwriter. Used for timeliness monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Contractual frequency at which the agent must remit the underwriter's share of collected premiums. Drives remittance-timeliness metric calculations.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this split schedule within the agency agreement. Version 1 is the original; increments with each amendment. Supports lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why this split schedule was created or amended (e.g., state rate filing change, contract renegotiation, regulatory directive).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this split schedule (e.g., 'Residential Standard 80/20 — TX 2024'). Aids identification in the agency management system.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this split schedule, as referenced in the agency agreement and remittance system. Used for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the split schedule. 'superseded' indicates a newer schedule has replaced this one; 'terminated' indicates the agreement ended.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: simultaneous_issue_rate_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the simultaneous issue (owner + lender issued together) discounted premium rate applies as the basis for split calculation under this schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: Native primary key or record identifier from the originating source system. Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation back to the agency management system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this split schedule record was sourced (e.g., agency management and remittance system identifier).

attributes.name: split_basis
attributes.description: Defines the premium base on which the split rates are applied: gross collected premium, net premium after deductions, or the state-filed statutory rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state postal code identifying the jurisdiction in which this split schedule applies. Split rates are state-regulated and vary by state.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; NAIC; FIPS

attributes.name: supersedes_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior premium_split_schedule record that this schedule replaced. Null if this is the original schedule. Supports chain-of-revision traceability.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this split schedule was formally terminated, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date; termination may occur before the scheduled expiry.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of this split schedule (e.g., agency agreement cancelled, agent license revoked, underwriter withdrawal from state).
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this tier within a tiered split schedule (1 = lowest premium band). Null for non-tiered schedules. Used to apply the correct rate band.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Category of real estate transaction to which this split rate applies (e.g., residential purchase, REFI, HELOC, construction, commercial). Rates may differ by transaction type.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CFPB TRID; RESPA

attributes.name: underwriter_split_rate
attributes.description: Contractual proportion of gross premium remitted to the underwriter, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.200000 = 20%). Must sum to 1.0 with agent_split_rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State Department of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this premium split schedule record. Used for change detection and incremental data loading in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: cpl_issuance
products.description: Closing Protection Letter (CPL) issuance record representing a specific CPL issued by the underwriter on behalf of an independent title agent for a given transaction or lender.
products.reference: CPL (Closing Protection Letter) / ALTA CPL Form

attributes.name: cpl_issuance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a Closing Protection Letter (CPL) issuance record in the agency management system.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency agreement under which the independent agent is authorized to conduct closings covered by this CPL.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent on whose behalf the CPL is issued by the underwriter, as registered in the agency management system.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: cpl_insured_lender_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lender or institutional party named as the insured on this CPL, typically the mortgage lender funding the transaction.

attributes.name: cpl_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title underwriter entity (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) that issued and is liable under this CPL.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System; ALTA CPL Form

attributes.name: insured_ownership_interest_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.ownership_interest. Business justification: CPL is issued at closing when ownership interest transfers. Links CPL to the specific ownership interest being insured (buyer's new interest or lender's lien).

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: CPL documents must reference the legal description that defines the insured property. Legal description is the authoritative definition of what the CPL covers.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: CPL (Closing Protection Letter) is issued for a specific property parcel. Currently cpl_issuance has denormalized property address fields but no FK to the authoritative property.parcel.

attributes.name: superseded_by_cpl_cpl_issuance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the replacement CPL issuance record when this CPL has been superseded by a revised or corrected version.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; VREQ-007

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order for which this CPL was issued, linking the CPL to the underlying transaction in the title production system.
attributes.references: Title Production System (SoftPro Select / RamQuest Horizon / Qualia)

attributes.name: actual_closing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the real estate closing actually occurred under this CPL. Null if closing has not yet taken place.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Title Production System; TRID

attributes.name: agent_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued title insurance agent license number for the independent agent at time of CPL issuance, confirming active licensure.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: agent_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the independent title agent on whose behalf the CPL is issued, as it appears on the CPL document.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: agent_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the state in which the agent is licensed and appointed to issue this CPL.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CPL was cancelled prior to expiration, if applicable. Null when the CPL was not cancelled.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the CPL was cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transaction_cancelled|policy_issued|superseded|agent_request|underwriter_request|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: claim_made_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a claim has been made against this CPL by the insured lender, triggering claims administration workflow.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; ALTA CPL Form

attributes.name: closing_location
attributes.description: Address or description of the location where the closing is scheduled to occur, as referenced in the CPL.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: closing_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the closing or escrow officer at the agent office who will conduct the closing covered by this CPL.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: cpl_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for issuance of this CPL, as filed with the applicable state Department of Insurance. May be zero in states where CPLs are issued at no charge.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance rate filings; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: cpl_fee_collected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CPL issuance fee has been collected from the insured lender or applicable party at time of issuance.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: cpl_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the ALTA CPL form used for this issuance (e.g., ALTA 2016 CPL Form), ensuring regulatory and form-version traceability.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form (2016 edition); State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: cpl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this CPL by the underwriter or agency management system, used for tracking and reference across parties.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: cpl_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CPL issuance record: draft, issued, cancelled, expired, or superseded by a revised CPL.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: cpl_type
attributes.description: Classifies the CPL by the party protected: lender, buyer, seller, or combined lender and buyer, per ALTA CPL form options.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form (2016 edition); State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this CPL issuance record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and record provenance.

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_ref
attributes.description: Confirmation number, email message ID, or portal acknowledgment reference confirming successful delivery of the CPL to the insured lender.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the CPL was delivered to the insured lender: email, fax, mail, lender portal, or electronic transmission.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the CPL was transmitted or delivered to the insured lender, used for timeliness tracking and audit.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: document_image_ref
attributes.description: Reference key or URI to the signed CPL document image stored in the document management and imaging system for evidence and provenance.
attributes.references: Document Management and Imaging System; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 1

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which CPL coverage becomes effective, which may differ from the issue date. Governs the start of underwriter liability under the letter.

attributes.name: eo_coverage_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent's Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance coverage was verified as active and sufficient at the time of CPL issuance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: eo_policy_number
attributes.description: E&O insurance policy number for the independent agent at time of CPL issuance, confirming required coverage per ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CPL coverage expires if the closing has not occurred. Null indicates the CPL remains open until cancelled or superseded.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: insured_lender_address
attributes.description: Full mailing address of the insured lender as stated on the CPL, used for delivery and regulatory record-keeping.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; GLBA; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: insured_lender_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the lender or institutional party named as the insured on the CPL, as it appears on the issued CPL document.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the CPL was formally issued by the underwriter, representing the principal business event date for this record.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the mortgage loan associated with this CPL, used to establish the scope of underwriter liability. Denominated in USD.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; TRID; RESPA; CFPB

attributes.name: prior_cpl_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior CPL issuance record that this record supersedes, preserving the revision chain for lifecycle history per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; VREQ-007

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Contract purchase price of the subject property for purchase transactions, as stated on the CPL or associated sales contract. Null for refinance transactions.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer tracking the revision version of this CPL within the same transaction, starting at 1 for the original issuance.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; VREQ-007

attributes.name: scheduled_closing_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of the real estate closing for which this CPL provides protection, used for expiration and pipeline management.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Title Production System

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating record in the agency management or title production system (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest) for lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; Title Production System

attributes.name: state_specific_form_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a state-mandated or state-approved CPL form was used instead of the standard ALTA form, as required by certain state Departments of Insurance.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying real estate transaction type for which the CPL is issued: purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction, commercial, or home equity.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; MISMO v3.4; TRID/TILA-RESPA

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the title underwriter issuing the CPL (e.g., Fidelity National Title, Stewart Title Guaranty), as it appears on the CPL document.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Form; Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this CPL issuance record was most recently modified, supporting change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: oversight_review
products.description: Periodic compliance and performance oversight review record for an independent title agent, capturing review type (annual audit, random file review, E&O verification, licensing check, remittance audit), review date, reviewer identity, findings summary
products.reference: ALTA Best Practices / State DOI Agent Oversight

attributes.name: oversight_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the oversight review record. Primary key for the agency compliance and performance review entity.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency agreement under which the agent operates, providing contractual context for the review scope and authority.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent or agency entity that is the subject of this oversight review.

attributes.name: prior_review_oversight_review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding oversight review record for this agent, enabling review history chain and trend analysis.

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to operations.title_order. Business justification: Oversight reviews sample specific order files to audit agent compliance, title examination quality, escrow handling, and closing procedures.

attributes.name: authority_action_taken
attributes.description: Regulatory or contractual action taken against the agent's authority as a result of this review: none, warning, restriction, suspension, termination, or DOI referral.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all review activities, including agent response and finding resolution, were finalized and the review was closed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, SOC 2 CC7

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the agent must submit or complete the corrective action plan in response to findings from this review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: corrective_action_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agent's corrective action plan or response was received by the underwriter oversight team.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the review findings require the agent to submit a formal corrective action plan (CAP) to address identified deficiencies.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action plan: not_required, pending, received, accepted, rejected, or overdue. Tracks remediation lifecycle.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this oversight review record was first created in the agency management system. Supports audit trail and record provenance.

attributes.name: critical_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the review identified at least one critical finding requiring immediate escalation, remediation, or potential authority suspension.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary amounts in this review record. Typically USD for domestic US title operations.

attributes.name: document_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the document management system record containing the formal review report, supporting evidence, and agent correspondence.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, SOC 2 CC7

attributes.name: eo_coverage_status
attributes.description: Status of the agent's E&O coverage as determined during this review: current, expiring_soon, expired, below_minimum, or not_verified.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: eo_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent's E&O insurance coverage was verified as current and meeting minimum requirements during this review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 2, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: escrow_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review included an examination of the agent's escrow/trust account records for compliance with IOLTA and state trust accounting rules.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5, State DOI regulations, IOLTA

attributes.name: escrow_compliance_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the escrow/trust account audit component: compliant, shortfall, overage, reconciliation_gap, or not_audited if escrow was not in scope.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: files_sampled_count
attributes.description: Number of title order files or transaction records selected for review during a random file review or annual audit. Supports sampling methodology documentation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: files_with_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of sampled files in which one or more compliance findings or deficiencies were identified. Used to compute deficiency rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: finding_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of finding category codes identified (e.g., remittance_late, eo_lapsed, escrow_shortfall, licensing_gap, file_deficiency). Supports trend analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key findings identified during the review, including deficiencies, exceptions, and areas of non-compliance observed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, SOC 2 CC7

attributes.name: license_compliance_status
attributes.description: Licensing compliance determination from this review: compliant, deficient (missing states), expired, suspended, or not_verified.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: license_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent's title insurance license(s) were verified as active and in good standing in all applicable states during this review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations, NIPR

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date for the next oversight review of this agent, determined by risk tier, audit frequency in the agency agreement, and findings from this review.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Composite compliance and performance rating assigned at the conclusion of the review: satisfactory, needs_improvement, unsatisfactory, or critical.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the business activity period under review. Together with period_start_date defines the audit window.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the business activity period under review (e.g., the remittance period, file production period, or licensing period being audited).

attributes.name: regulatory_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory referral was submitted to the state DOI or other authority. Populated only when regulatory_referral_flag is true.
attributes.references: State DOI regulations, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: regulatory_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether findings from this review were referred to a state Department of Insurance or other regulatory body for further action.
attributes.references: State DOI regulations, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: remittance_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review included an audit of the agent's premium remittance records and timeliness against the agency agreement schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: remittance_compliance_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the remittance audit component: compliant, late_remittances, underpayment, overpayment, or not_audited if remittance was not in scope.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: remittance_variance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of identified remittance discrepancy (underpayment or overpayment) discovered during the remittance audit component of this review.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the oversight review was conducted or initiated. Principal business event date for scheduling, aging, and timeliness metrics.

attributes.name: review_method
attributes.description: Method by which the oversight review was conducted: on_site (at agent office), remote (virtual/electronic), desk_review (document submission only), or hybrid.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the reviewer capturing context, agent responses, mitigating circumstances, or follow-up actions not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to this oversight review. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: review_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope of the review, including which files, periods, processes, or compliance areas were examined.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the oversight review: scheduled, in_progress, pending_response (awaiting agent reply), completed, cancelled, or escalated to underwriter compliance.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the review: annual audit, random file review, E&O verification, licensing check, remittance audit, or for-cause review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, State DOI regulations

attributes.name: reviewer_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or unit responsible for conducting the review (e.g., Agency Compliance, Underwriting Oversight, Internal Audit).

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_code
attributes.description: Internal employee identifier of the reviewer conducting the oversight review. Links to HR/identity systems for access control and audit.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the underwriter compliance officer, auditor, or oversight analyst who conducted the review. Supports accountability and audit trail.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, SOC 2 CC7

attributes.name: risk_tier_after
attributes.description: Agent oversight risk tier classification assigned as a result of this review. Compared to risk_tier_before to track risk migration.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: risk_tier_before
attributes.description: Agent oversight risk tier classification assigned prior to this review. Used to measure risk tier migration resulting from review findings.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3, NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for the oversight review. Compared against review_date to measure scheduling adherence and overdue reviews.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the primary state jurisdiction under which this oversight review was conducted and findings apply.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this oversight review record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL, and audit trail.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: agent_remittance
products.description: Transactional header record for a periodic premium remittance submitted by (or billed to) an independent title agent to the underwriter, representing the agency-settlement cycle.

attributes.name: agent_remittance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the agent remittance header record. Primary key for the agency settlement cycle transaction.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing agency agreement under which this remittance is processed, establishing the contractual basis for the premium split.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent entity submitting or receiving this remittance. Links to the agent profile master record.

attributes.name: premium_split_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium split schedule that governs agent and underwriter share calculations applied to this remittance period.

attributes.name: prior_remittance_agent_remittance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous remittance record that this corrected or supplemental remittance supersedes. Supports lifecycle revision history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the underwriter formally accepted and validated the remittance submission. Distinct from submission_date per VREQ-008 date separation requirements.

attributes.name: agent_retained_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of gross premium retained by the agent per the applicable premium split schedule. Equals gross premium multiplied by the agent split rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: amount_received
attributes.description: Actual dollar amount received by the underwriter from the agent for this remittance. May differ from net_remittance_amount if partial payment or overpayment occurred.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the business was produced: independent agent, direct branch, or centralized lender channel. Supports channel-level remittance analytics.

attributes.name: cpl_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total Closing Protection Letter (CPL) fees collected by the agent during the remittance period, subject to the CPL fee split rate in the premium split schedule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this remittance record was first created in the agency management system. Supports audit trail and record provenance per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this remittance record. Typically USD for domestic US title insurance transactions.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the remittance submission or payment is past the contractual due_date. Used for agency remittance timeliness metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State DOI Market Conduct

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the agent must submit and fund this remittance per the agency agreement remittance schedule terms.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: endorsement_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium collected for ALTA endorsements (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22) issued during the remittance period, reported separately from base policy premium.
attributes.references: ALTA Endorsement Forms; State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this remittance has been flagged for manual review due to variance, missing policies, late submission, or other discrepancy requiring underwriter investigation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason this remittance was flagged as an exception, such as variance, missing policy detail, or suspected fraud indicator.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; FinCEN SAR

attributes.name: gl_batch_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the ERP/GL batch or journal entry number created when this remittance was posted to the general ledger for premium revenue recognition.

attributes.name: gross_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total gross title insurance premium collected by the agent for all policies in the remittance period before any splits, credits, or adjustments are applied.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX; State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: is_late
attributes.description: Indicates whether this remittance was submitted or funded after the contractual due date. True when submission_date or settlement_date exceeds due_date.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State DOI Market Conduct

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contractual late fee assessed against the agent for failure to remit by the due date, per the agency agreement penalty terms.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: ltp_count
attributes.description: Number of Lender's Title Policies (LTP) included in this remittance period. Supports owner-versus-lender policy coverage analytics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: net_remittance_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount due to the underwriter after applying all credits, adjustments, and split calculations. This is the amount the agent must fund to settle the remittance.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the underwriter or agency oversight team regarding this remittance, such as dispute details, follow-up actions, or audit observations.

attributes.name: otp_count
attributes.description: Number of Owner's Title Policies (OTP) included in this remittance period. Supports owner-versus-lender policy coverage analytics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the agent funded the remittance to the underwriter (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check). Relevant for reconciliation and fraud controls.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Bank or payment system reference number (wire confirmation, ACH trace number, check number) associated with the funds transfer for this remittance settlement.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the remittance reporting period. Defines the inclusive end of the policy issuance window covered by this remittance batch.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State DOI Remittance Rules

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the remittance reporting period. Defines the inclusive start of the policy issuance window covered by this remittance batch.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State DOI Remittance Rules

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Total number of title insurance policies (owner and lender combined) included in this remittance period. Used for frequency and volume analytics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the remittance was fully reconciled against the underwriter's policy registry and general ledger. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation state of the remittance against the underwriter's policy registry and GL. Drives escrow receipt-disbursement reconciliation metrics per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reissue_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total reissue credit adjustments applied to the gross premium in this remittance period, reducing the remittable premium where prior policies qualify for reissue rates.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Contractual frequency at which the agent is required to submit remittances per the agency agreement. Drives due-date calculation and timeliness monitoring.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: remittance_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to this remittance batch by the agency management system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the remittance record. Drives workflow routing and aging metrics for agency remittance timeliness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|accepted|rejected|settled|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: remittance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the remittance submission: periodic (scheduled cycle), supplemental (out-of-cycle), corrected (amendment to prior), final (contract close-out), or advance.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for corrected or amended remittance submissions. Version 1 is the original; increments with each correction per lifecycle history requirements.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for a corrected or amended remittance submission, such as policy count correction, premium recalculation, or split rate adjustment.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which funds were actually transferred and the remittance was financially settled between the agent and the underwriter.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: simultaneous_issue_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total simultaneous issue rate credits applied when owner and lender policies are issued concurrently, reducing the combined premium in this remittance period.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code identifying the primary state jurisdiction for this remittance. Determines applicable state DOI remittance rules and rate filings.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the agent formally submitted this remittance to the underwriter. Used to calculate remittance timeliness against contractual due dates.

attributes.name: transaction_type_scope
attributes.description: Primary real estate transaction type(s) covered by this remittance period (e.g., purchase, refinance, HELOC). Supports transaction-mix analytics and rate-filing compliance.

attributes.name: underwriter_code
attributes.description: Reference to the title underwriter entity receiving the remittance. Supports multi-underwriter agency relationships and underwriter-level remittance analytics.

attributes.name: underwriter_due_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of gross premium owed to the underwriter per the premium split schedule. Equals gross premium minus agent retained amount before adjustments.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this remittance record. Used for change detection, audit, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between net_remittance_amount and amount_received. Positive value indicates underpayment; negative indicates overpayment. Drives exception and follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

products.name: remittance_line
products.description: Line-level detail of an agent_remittance, one row per policy/transaction premium being remitted. Captures source policy or order reference, policy type (owner/lender), gross premium, applied premium_split_schedule rate, computed underwriter share

attributes.name: remittance_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single remittance line record within an agent premium remittance batch. Primary key for the remittance_line entity.

attributes.name: agency_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency agreement under which this remittance line is processed. Establishes the contractual authority for the agent/underwriter relationship.

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent submitting this remittance line. Supports agent-level remittance timeliness and split reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: agent_remittance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent agent_remittance header record. Links this line to the remittance batch submitted by the independent agent to the underwriter.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Remittance lines report premium on policies covering specific parcels. Parcel is the fundamental unit of title insurance; linking enables premium reconciliation by jurisdiction

attributes.name: premium_split_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium_split_schedule governing the agent/underwriter split rates applied to this line. Ensures split calculation is traceable to the approved schedule.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Remittance lines track premium by property transaction. Essential for reconciling premium to title orders, analyzing revenue by property type/transaction type, detecting duplicate

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title order associated with this remittance line. Enables traceability from premium remittance back to the originating title order.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued title policy (owner or lender) for which premium is being remitted. Core link for policy-level remittance reconciliation.

attributes.name: accepted_date
attributes.description: Date the underwriter formally accepted this remittance line as correct and complete. Marks the completion of the remittance reconciliation lifecycle for this line. Distinct from submission date.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any post-submission adjustment applied to this remittance line (e.g., correction for rate error, credit memo, or dispute resolution). Negative values indicate credits.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for any adjustment applied to this remittance line. Required when adjustment_amount is non-zero. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: agent_premium_share
attributes.description: Computed dollar amount retained by the agent: net_premium_amount multiplied by agent_split_rate. Represents the agent's earned commission on this policy line.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; IRS 1099 reporting

attributes.name: agent_split_rate
attributes.description: Decimal rate representing the agent's share of net premium per the applicable premium_split_schedule (e.g., 0.800000 = 80%). Captured at line level for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the underlying title order and policy were originated. Supports channel-level remittance analytics and split schedule applicability validation.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: Date the real estate transaction closed. Anchors the remittance timeliness calculation; remittance due date is typically computed relative to closing date per the agency agreement.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) county code for the property location. Supports county-level remittance analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: cpl_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for the Closing Protection Letter (CPL) associated with this transaction, if applicable. Subject to its own split rate per the premium_split_schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA CPL Forms; State rate filings

attributes.name: cpl_underwriter_share
attributes.description: Underwriter's share of the CPL fee computed using the CPL fee split rate from the premium_split_schedule. Included in total underwriter remittance for this line.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Defaults to USD for domestic US title transactions. Required for multi-currency compliance.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between remittance_due_date and remittance_submitted_date. Positive values indicate late remittance; zero or negative indicates on-time or early submission.

attributes.name: endorsement_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium charged for all ALTA endorsements attached to this policy (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22). Tracked separately from base policy premium for endorsement revenue analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Endorsement Forms; State rate filings

attributes.name: endorsement_underwriter_share
attributes.description: Underwriter's share of endorsement premium computed using the endorsement split rate from the premium_split_schedule. Included in total underwriter remittance for this line.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the underwriter premium share for this line is posted in the ERP/GL system. Supports premium revenue recognition and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: gross_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total gross title insurance premium charged to the insured for this policy before any reissue credit, simultaneous issue discount, or split allocation. Basis for split calculation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State rate filings

attributes.name: insured_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of insurance coverage provided by this policy (purchase price for OTP, loan amount for LTP). Used to validate premium calculation against filed rate tables.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State rate filings

attributes.name: is_late_remittance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this remittance line was submitted after the contractual remittance due date. True when remittance_submitted_date exceeds remittance_due_date. Drives timeliness compliance reporting.

attributes.name: is_reissue_credit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a reissue credit was applied to reduce the gross premium on this line. When true, reissue_credit_amount must be populated and greater than zero.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State rate filings

attributes.name: is_simultaneous_issue
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy line is part of a simultaneous owner/lender policy issuance on the same transaction. Affects premium calculation and split schedule applicability.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State rate filings

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent remittance batch, starting at 1. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of individual policy lines within a remittance.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this remittance line. Drives reconciliation workflow: pending=awaiting underwriter acceptance; accepted=confirmed; rejected=disputed; adjusted=corrected; reversed=backed out; voided=cancelled.

attributes.name: net_premium_amount
attributes.description: Net title insurance premium after deducting reissue credit and simultaneous issue credit from gross premium. This is the base amount to which the agent/underwriter split rates are applied.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; State rate filings

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the agent or underwriter regarding this remittance line. Used for exception documentation, dispute context, or manual override explanations.

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the title policy became effective (typically the closing/recording date). Used to determine the applicable rate filing period and remittance due date calculation.

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the title policy was formally issued by the agent. Distinct from effective date; used to measure policy issuance lag and remittance timeliness from issuance.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known title policy number (e.g., OTP or LTP policy number) for which premium is being remitted. Denormalized for reconciliation without requiring a policy join.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Type of title insurance policy or coverage instrument being remitted. OTP (Owner's Title Policy), LTP (Lender's Title Policy), CPL (Closing Protection Letter), or endorsement premium.

attributes.name: prior_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the prior title policy used as the basis for a reissue credit calculation. Required when is_reissue_credit_applied is true for audit and rate compliance verification.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State rate filings

attributes.name: rate_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the state-filed rate schedule used to calculate the gross premium for this line (e.g., state filing number or rate manual version). Supports regulatory audit and rate compliance.

attributes.name: reissue_credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of reissue credit applied to reduce the gross premium when a prior policy exists on the same property. Reduces the net premium base subject to split.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State rate filings

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the underwriter when this remittance line is rejected or disputed (e.g., incorrect split rate, missing policy number, rate calculation error). Populated when line_status is rejected.

attributes.name: remittance_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the underwriter share for this line must be remitted per the agency agreement remittance schedule. Key date for remittance timeliness metric calculation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: remittance_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date this remittance line was submitted to the underwriter as part of the agent remittance batch. Used to compute days-late for remittance timeliness reporting.

attributes.name: simultaneous_issue_credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar credit applied when owner and lender policies are issued simultaneously on the same transaction. Reduces the lesser policy premium per ALTA simultaneous issue rate rules.
attributes.references: ALTA Rate Manual; State rate filings

attributes.name: source_system_line_ref
attributes.description: Native line identifier from the Agency Management and Remittance System (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest) that originated this remittance line. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: split_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the agent/underwriter premium split is calculated for this line: net_premium (after credits), gross_premium (before credits), or flat_fee. Sourced from the premium_split_schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the property jurisdiction where the policy was issued. Determines applicable state rate filing, split schedule, and regulatory remittance requirements.

attributes.name: total_underwriter_remittance
attributes.description: Total amount due to the underwriter for this line: sum of underwriter_premium_share, endorsement_underwriter_share, and cpl_underwriter_share. The controlling remittance amount for this line.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Real estate transaction type underlying the policy being remitted. Supports segmentation of remittance analytics by transaction category (purchase, REFI, HELOC, construction, commercial).

attributes.name: underwriter_code
attributes.description: Reference to the title underwriter (e.g., FNF, FAF, STC, ORI) receiving the remittance for this line. Required for multi-underwriter agent scenarios and underwriter-level settlement reporting.

attributes.name: underwriter_premium_share
attributes.description: Computed dollar amount due to the underwriter: net_premium_amount multiplied by underwriter_split_rate. This is the amount being remitted to the underwriter for this line.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; NAIC; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: underwriter_split_rate
attributes.description: Decimal rate representing the underwriter's share of net premium per the applicable premium_split_schedule (e.g., 0.200000 = 20%). Must sum to 1.0 with agent_split_rate.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices Pillar 5; Agency Agreement

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date when this record version became effective

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: End date when this record version ceased to be effective (NULL if current)

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Administers the full title-insurance claims lifecycle: FNOL intake, investigation, coverage analysis, reserving (case and IBNR), loss payment, recovery/subrogation, and claim closure.

products.name: title_claim
products.description: Master record for every title-insurance claim filed against an issued OTP or LTP. Captures FNOL intake details, claim type (title defect, lien, encumbrance, encroachment, forgery, fraud, survey, access, etc.), coverage analysis outcome, policy linkage
products.reference: NAIC Title Insurance Claim Record; ALTA Claims Reporting

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each title insurance claim record. Primary key for the title_claim entity in the Claims Administration System.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Reporting

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent entity if the underlying policy was issued through an independent agent channel. Null for direct-branch or lender-channel policies.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Claims often hinge on legal description gaps, metes-and-bounds errors, or Schedule A variances.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property entity representing the real property subject to the insured title. Links the claim to the property information domain for location and parcel context.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Property Information and County Data System

attributes.name: title_assigned_counsel_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for outside or in-house legal counsel assigned to defend or prosecute matters related to this claim.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: title_claimant_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party entity representing the insured claimant (owner or lender) who filed the claim. Supports party-role contextual modeling.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_commitment. Business justification: Claims investigation and coverage analysis routinely retrieve the commitment to compare Schedule B exceptions, requirements, and insurable title determination against the

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating title order associated with the insured transaction. Enables traceability from claim back to the original title production workflow.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System (SoftPro/RamQuest)

attributes.name: title_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal party or employee record for the claims examiner assigned to investigate and manage this claim through resolution.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or Lender's Title Policy (LTP) against which this claim is filed. Links claim to the insuring policy.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: underwriting_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.underwriting_title_examination. Business justification: Claims investigation reviews the original examination to determine if the defect was missed, improperly cleared, or outside the examination scope.

attributes.name: case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Current actuarially-set case reserve representing the estimated ultimate indemnity liability for this specific open claim. Updated as investigation progresses.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SSAP No. 57; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim involves a break or gap in the chain of title (COT) as identified during examination or investigation. Key metric for title clearance quality analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant / Search Automation System

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the claim at FNOL intake. Used in all correspondence, regulatory reporting, and system-of-record references.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reporting; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the claim. Drives workflow routing, reserve management, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_investigation|reserved|settled|closed|denied|reopened — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the title risk cause giving rise to the claim (e.g., title defect, lien, encumbrance, encroachment, forgery, fraud, survey, access, CC&R).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Loss Cause Codes

attributes.name: claimed_loss_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount of loss asserted by the claimant at FNOL intake. May differ from the ultimately reserved or paid amount after investigation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was formally closed in the Claims Administration System. Reserves are released upon closure. Used for claim lifecycle duration and aging analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason the claim was closed, distinguishing between indemnity payment, curative resolution, coverage denial, claimant withdrawal, or no-coverage determination.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the county where the insured property is located. Used for geographic loss analysis and county recorder jurisdiction identification.

tag_set.value: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code

attributes.name: coverage_analysis_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the underwriter's coverage analysis determining whether the claimed loss falls within the policy's insuring provisions. Drives reserve setting and payment authorization.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: coverage_denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why coverage was denied or limited, referencing the specific policy exclusion, Schedule B exception, or condition. Populated when coverage_analysis_outcome is denied or partially_covered.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the claim record was first created in the Claims Administration System. Audit field for record provenance and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: curative_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative describing the curative steps taken to resolve the title defect or adverse matter underlying the claim (e.g., lien release, quiet title action, corrective deed).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System

attributes.name: curative_resolution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim was resolved through curative action (e.g., obtaining a release, reconveyance, or corrective deed) rather than monetary indemnity payment.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim record. Defaults to USD for domestic US title insurance transactions.

attributes.name: expense_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve set aside for allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE) including legal fees, curative costs, and investigation expenses associated with this claim.

attributes.name: fnol_date
attributes.description: Date the insured first notified the company of the claim event. The principal business event date for claim intake; distinct from investigation and payment dates.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reporting; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: fnol_received_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Notice of Loss (FNOL) Received Timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the FNOL was received and logged in the Claims Administration System. Used for SLA measurement and regulatory timeliness reporting.

tag_set.value: First Notice of Loss (FNOL) Received Timestamp

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim involves a loss arising during the gap period between the effective date of the commitment and the recording of the insured instrument.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: insured_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of insurance coverage under the policy at the time of the claim, representing the maximum indemnity exposure. Sourced from the policy's Schedule A.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: investigation_close_date
attributes.description: Date the claim investigation was formally concluded and findings documented. Marks transition to coverage determination and reserve finalization.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date the formal claim investigation was initiated by the assigned examiner. Used to measure investigation cycle time and regulatory timeliness compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current state of the claim investigation workflow. Tracks whether the examiner has begun, completed, or paused the factual and legal review of the claimed loss.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has resulted in or is subject to active litigation. Triggers legal hold requirements and escalated reserve review.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; SOX; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date the insured title loss or adverse claim event actually occurred or was discovered. May differ from FNOL date; used for IBNR analysis and loss cause dating.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: loss_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the title defect, lien, encumbrance, or other adverse matter giving rise to the claim. Captures the factual basis of the insured's loss.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Reporting

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim is filed against an Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or a Lender's/Loan Title Policy (LTP). Required for owner-versus-lender coverage analysis per VREQ-010.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: producing_channel
attributes.description: The business channel through which the underlying title order and policy were produced. Supports loss ratio and frequency analysis by channel (direct, lender, independent agent).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management System

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Total amounts recovered through subrogation, salvage, or other recovery actions against responsible third parties. Reduces net loss for loss ratio calculation.
