attributes.description: Classification of the payee role for this disbursement: claimant, lender (mortgagee), attorney, curative vendor, court, or insured. Supports loss-cause and payee-mix analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount disbursed in this loss payment transaction, expressed in the payment currency. Core monetary fact for claim severity and loss ratio analysis.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the loss payment was actually disbursed to the payee. Principal business event date for claim payment lag and loss ratio period assignment.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to disburse the loss payment: wire transfer, paper check, ACH electronic transfer, or escrow disbursement. Drives reconciliation and positive-pay controls.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text examiner notes documenting the basis for this payment, any conditions, partial payment rationale, or special handling instructions. Supports claims audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reporting; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this loss payment disbursement, assigned by the claims administration system (e.g., LP-2024-000123).
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reporting; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the bank, wire network, or check processor for this disbursement (e.g., wire confirmation number, check number, ACH trace ID).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loss payment: pending (awaiting approval), approved, issued (disbursed), cleared (bank confirmed), voided, or returned (funds recovered).

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disbursement purpose: indemnity (direct loss), curative_cost (title defect cure), defense_cost (legal defense), settlement (negotiated resolution), or court_ordered.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line 25; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: policy_liability_limit
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount under the linked title policy at the time of payment. Provides context for whether payment approaches or exhausts policy limits.
attributes.references: ALTA Owner's Policy; ALTA Loan Policy; NAIC

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Human-readable title policy number denormalized onto the payment record for regulatory loss reporting and policy-level loss ratio analysis without requiring a join.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Policy Type (Owner's Title Policy / Loan Title Policy)
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loss payment is made under an Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or a Loan/Lender's Title Policy (LTP). Supports owner-versus-lender coverage analysis per VREQ-010.
attributes.references: ALTA Owner's Policy; ALTA Loan Policy; NAIC

tag_set.value: Policy Type (Owner's Title Policy / Loan Title Policy)

attributes.name: reserve_release_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the case reserve released upon issuance of this payment. Used to reconcile reserve movements against actual loss payments for IBNR and loss ratio reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the property jurisdiction where the insured title risk is located. Required for state Department of Insurance regulatory loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI; USPS

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loss payment has an associated subrogation or recovery right that the insurer may pursue against a responsible third party after indemnifying the insured.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices; State DOI

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross payment for IRS backup withholding or other tax obligations. Relevant for payments to non-exempt payees. Supports 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the title defect or risk cause driving this loss payment (e.g., forged deed, undisclosed lien, survey error, chain-of-title break).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices; State DOI reporting

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific title defect, encumbrance, or chain-of-title issue that gave rise to this loss payment. Complements the structured risk cause code.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Real estate transaction type underlying the insured policy: purchase, refinance (REFI), home equity line of credit (HELOC), construction, or commercial. Supports loss frequency by transaction segment.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; CFPB TRID; MISMO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this loss payment record. Supports change detection, audit, and incremental lakehouse ingestion.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was voided, if applicable. Null for non-voided payments. Supports lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: wire_instruction_ref
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the wire instruction set used for this disbursement. Full wire details (routing, account, SWIFT) stored in the NPPI Vault per VREQ-012 and GLBA.
attributes.references: GLBA; FinCEN; ALTA Best Practices Pillar 3

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: recovery_receipt
products.description: Transactional record of each recovery or subrogation receipt collected on a title claim, capturing recovery type (subrogation, contribution, salvage, reinsurance recovery), recovery source party, recovery amount, currency, receipt date, recovery method
products.reference: ALTA Subrogation and Recovery; NAIC Schedule P Recovery

attributes.name: recovery_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recovery or subrogation receipt record within the claims administration system.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Reporting

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims examiner or adjuster responsible for managing the recovery action and recording this receipt in the claims administration system.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: recovery_counsel_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outside or staff counsel engaged to pursue subrogation litigation or negotiation on behalf of the title insurer for this recovery action.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: recovery_source_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party from whom the recovery proceeds were collected (e.g., prior owner, grantor, tortfeasor, reinsurer, co-insurer, or responsible third party).
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: reversed_receipt_recovery_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original recovery receipt record that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator = True. Preserves audit trail of corrections.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SOX; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title insurance claim against which this recovery receipt is applied. Links recovery proceeds to the originating loss event.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued owner or lender title policy (OTP/LTP) under which the underlying claim was made and recovery is being tracked.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: agent_recovery_share_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the recovery proceeds allocated to the independent title agent under the agency agreement premium split, when the underlying policy was issued through an agent channel.
attributes.references: ALTA Agency Agreement Standards; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: applied_to_loss_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the recovery receipt amount that has been applied to reduce the recorded claim loss or indemnity payment balance. May differ from recovery_amount if partial application.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned reference or wire confirmation number for the recovery funds receipt. Restricted due to financial transaction sensitivity. Used for bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: GLBA; FinCEN; PCI DSS; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number of the recovery payment instrument when recovery_method = check. Restricted financial data used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recovery receipt record was first created in the claims administration system. Used for audit trail and record provenance per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: SOX; ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the recovery amount (e.g., USD). Title insurance is predominantly USD; retained for multi-currency commercial transactions.

attributes.name: expected_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total recovery amount anticipated from this recovery action at the time of demand or suit filing. Used to track recovery realization rate versus expectation.

attributes.name: expense_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the recovery receipt allocated to recovery of claim-related loss adjustment expenses (LAE), such as legal fees and investigation costs, separate from indemnity loss recovery.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which the recovery receipt is posted in the ERP/financial system, enabling reconciliation between claims administration and financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SOX; ERP/GL System SoR

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery receipt was posted to the general ledger for financial reporting purposes. May differ from receipt_date due to accounting period cutoffs.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SOX; ERP/GL System SoR

attributes.name: is_final_receipt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final recovery receipt for the claim (True), signaling that no further recovery proceeds are expected and the recovery action is closed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: is_full_recovery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt represents full recovery of the total claim indemnity paid (True) or a partial recovery (False). Drives claim closure eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: naic_recovery_code
attributes.description: NAIC-defined code classifying the recovery type for statutory annual statement Schedule F and loss reporting purposes. Aligns with NAIC Title Insurance Annual Statement requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; NAIC Title Insurance Reporting

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Recovery amount net of recovery-related expenses (legal fees, collection costs) incurred to obtain the proceeds. Equals recovery_amount minus recovery expense deductions.

attributes.name: payor_tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN/EIN/SSN) of the party remitting the recovery payment. Required for IRS 1099 reporting on recoveries. Stored in NPPI Vault.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099; GLBA; NPPI Vault SoR

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underlying policy is an Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or Lender's/Loan Title Policy (LTP), supporting owner-versus-lender recovery analysis per VREQ-016.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the recovery funds were actually received by the title insurer or its claims administrator. Principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this recovery receipt by the claims administration system for tracking and correspondence.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the recovery or subrogation proceeds received in this receipt, expressed in the transaction currency. Used in loss ratio and recovery rate calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total costs incurred to pursue and collect this recovery (attorney fees, court costs, investigation expenses). Deducted from gross recovery to derive net recovery.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which recovery funds were collected: wire transfer, check, ACH, offset against amounts owed, court judgment enforcement, or negotiated settlement agreement.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; FinCEN; NAIC Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: recovery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the circumstances of the recovery, negotiation details, or special conditions associated with this receipt. Entered by the claims examiner.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original claim indemnity payment recovered through this receipt (recovery_amount / total indemnity paid). Supports recovery effectiveness analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_source_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity or individual from whom recovery proceeds were collected (e.g., prior grantor, judgment debtor, reinsurer name). Denormalized for reporting when party record is unavailable.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party from whom recovery was collected, supporting analysis of recovery patterns by source category (e.g., prior owner subrogation vs. reinsurer recovery).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recovery receipt: pending (expected but not yet received), received (funds in hand), applied (posted to claim reserve/loss), reversed, or written off.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recovery mechanism: subrogation (rights against third party), contribution (co-insurer share), salvage (asset recovery), reinsurance recovery, or indemnification from responsible party.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate under which a reinsurance recovery receipt was collected. Populated only when recovery_type = reinsurance_recovery.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: reserve_reduction_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which the claim case reserve was reduced upon application of this recovery receipt. Supports reserve adequacy and IBNR analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement; IBNR Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery receipt record represents a reversal of a previously posted receipt (True). Supports lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SOX; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: settlement_agreement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a settlement agreement was executed between the title insurer and the recovery source party, formalizing the recovery amount and terms.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating claims administration system (e.g., SoftPro, RamQuest) for lineage tracing and reconciliation with the system of record.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: state_of_recovery
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction in which the recovery action was pursued. Supports state-level regulatory loss reporting to Departments of Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State Departments of Insurance; FIPS

attributes.name: subrogation_demand_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal subrogation demand letter was issued to the responsible third party, initiating the recovery action. Used to measure recovery cycle time.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: subrogation_suit_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which a subrogation lawsuit was filed in court against the responsible party, if litigation was required to enforce recovery rights.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Subrogation Guidelines

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the title defect or risk category that gave rise to the underlying claim (e.g., forged deed, undisclosed lien, survey defect). Supports loss ratio by title-risk cause.
attributes.references: ALTA Claims Cause Codes; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of real estate transaction underlying the insured policy (purchase, refinance, HELOC, construction, commercial). Supports segmentation of recovery metrics by transaction type.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: underwriter_recovery_share_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the recovery proceeds retained by the title underwriter after deducting the agent share and recovery expenses. Used in underwriter loss ratio reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Agency Agreement Standards; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this recovery receipt record. Supports change tracking and lifecycle history preservation per VREQ-007.
attributes.references: SOX; ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System SoR

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: investigation
products.description: Master record for the investigation phase of a title claim, capturing investigation status (open, pending_docs, pending_legal, complete), assigned investigator, investigation start and completion dates, investigation findings narrative, documents
products.reference: ALTA Claims Investigation Best Practices; NAIC Claim Investigation

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the title claim investigation record. Primary key for the investigation entity within the Claims Administration System.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: agent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the independent title agent involved in the originating transaction, if applicable. Used for agency oversight, E&O review, and remittance impact analysis.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_counsel_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outside legal counsel or panel attorney assigned to support the investigation when litigation or curative legal action is required.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: investigation_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal staff member or external counsel assigned as lead investigator for this claim investigation. Supports workload management and investigator performance reporting.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: legal_description_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.legal_description. Business justification: Investigations validate legal descriptions against recorded instruments, prior commitments, and surveys.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Investigations require parcel-level legal description, recording jurisdiction, and APN for evidence retrieval, chain-of-title reconstruction, and curative action planning.

attributes.name: recorded_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.recorded_instrument. Business justification: Claim investigations examine the recorded instrument evidencing the defect (deed, mortgage, lien). Investigators pull instrument to analyze chain of title breaks and forgery.

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent title insurance claim record. Links the investigation to its originating First Notice of Loss (FNOL) claim intake record.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_commitment. Business justification: Investigators retrieve the commitment to compare Schedule B exceptions and requirements against the claimed defect, verify insurable title determination, and assess whether the

attributes.name: title_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating title order associated with the insured transaction. Enables traceability from claim investigation back to the original title production workflow.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or Lender's Title Policy (LTP) under which the claim is being investigated. Supports coverage analysis and policy-to-claim linkage.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Claim Reporting

attributes.name: underwriting_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.underwriting_title_examination. Business justification: Investigators review examination workpapers to assess whether the examiner identified the defect, whether the examination scope was adequate, and whether the

attributes.name: agency_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an independent title agent was involved in the originating transaction. Triggers agency oversight review and potential E&O coverage analysis.
attributes.references: Agency Management and Remittance System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Assessor's Parcel Number (APN) or Parcel Identification Number (PIN) assigned by the county assessor for the subject property. Supports property data linkage and county record research.
attributes.references: Property Information and County Data System; FIPS Standards

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation identified a break or gap in the chain of title (COT) as a contributing factor to the claim. Supports chain-of-title break metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Plant / Search Automation System

attributes.name: claimant_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party asserting the claim, which may differ from the named insured (e.g., successor, lender assignee). NPPI — handle per GLBA and CCPA/CPRA.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the investigation was formally concluded and findings were documented. Null if investigation is still open. Used to compute investigation duration.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Reporting; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code identifying the county in which the subject property is located. Used for jurisdictional routing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_analysis_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the underwriter or claims examiner's analysis of policy coverage applicability, including Schedule B exceptions and endorsement review.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Claim Reporting

attributes.name: coverage_determination
attributes.description: Outcome of the coverage analysis phase of the investigation. Indicates whether the claimed loss is within the scope of the issued title policy. Drives reserving and payment decisions.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigation record was first created in the Claims Administration System. Audit field supporting record provenance and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: curative_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation determined that curative processing (e.g., lien release, deed correction, quiet title action) is required to resolve the title defect underlying the claim.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System

attributes.name: curative_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of curative processing activities initiated as a result of the investigation findings. Supports curative action aging and effectiveness metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Title Production System

attributes.name: curative_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all curative actions required to resolve the title defect were completed. Null if curative action is not required or still in progress.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this investigation record. Defaults to USD for domestic US title insurance transactions.

attributes.name: document_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which all requested documents and evidence were received from the claimant or third parties, enabling the investigation to proceed from pending_docs status.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; State Department of Insurance Fair Claims Regulations

attributes.name: document_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigator issued a formal request for additional documents or evidence from the claimant or third parties. Supports pending_docs status tracking.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; State Department of Insurance Fair Claims Regulations

attributes.name: eo_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim may be covered under an Errors and Omissions (E&O) policy held by the agent or closing attorney, potentially reducing net loss to the underwriter.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Agency Management and Remittance System

attributes.name: estimated_loss_amount
attributes.description: Investigator's estimate of the total monetary loss exposure identified during the investigation, in USD. Used to inform initial reserve setting and severity analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Reporting; ALTA Best Practices; SOX

attributes.name: evidence_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required evidentiary documents (deeds, instruments, search results, affidavits) have been received and reviewed. Supports evidence completeness and provenance metrics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Document Management and Imaging System

attributes.name: findings_narrative
attributes.description: Detailed free-text narrative summarizing the investigation findings, including chain-of-title defects identified, evidence reviewed, and conclusions reached by the investigator.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: forgery_fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation identified forgery, fraud, or misrepresentation as a contributing cause of the title defect or loss. Triggers FinCEN SAR filing review.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Requirements; ALTA Best Practices; GLBA

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the insured party (owner or lender) under the title policy as of the investigation. Captured for claim correspondence and regulatory reporting. NPPI — handle per GLBA.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the investigation. Drives workflow routing and SLA tracking. Values: open, pending_docs, pending_legal, complete, closed.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation by title-risk cause category. Supports claim frequency and severity analysis by title-risk cause. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: title_defect|lien|encumbrance|forgery|fraud|boundary|access|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Rate Filing; NAIC Claim Cause Codes

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent documented activity or update on the investigation. Used to identify stale or aging investigations requiring follow-up.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim investigation has escalated to active litigation or legal proceedings. Triggers assignment of outside counsel and legal hold procedures.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to the investigation by the Claims Administration System. Used in correspondence, regulatory filings, and audit trails.
attributes.references: NAIC Uniform Claim Reporting; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: policy_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of insurance stated in the title policy under which the claim is filed, in USD. Establishes the maximum indemnity exposure for coverage analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Claim Reporting

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim is filed under an Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or a Lender's/Loan Title Policy (LTP). Supports owner-versus-lender policy coverage analytics.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Claim Reporting

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the investigation based on exposure amount, litigation risk, and regulatory deadlines. Drives workload prioritization and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Claims Administration System; State Department of Insurance Fair Claims Regulations

attributes.name: property_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the insured property subject to the claim investigation. Denormalized for investigation reporting; authoritative address is on the property/parcel record.

attributes.name: recommended_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve amount recommended by the investigator based on investigation findings, in USD. Feeds into the reserving workflow for case reserve establishment or adjustment.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Reserving Standards; ALTA Best Practices; SOX

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this investigation triggers mandatory regulatory reporting to NAIC, state Department of Insurance, or other regulatory bodies based on loss amount or claim type thresholds.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Reporting; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formal investigation was opened and assigned. Used to measure investigation cycle time and SLA compliance from FNOL intake.
attributes.references: NAIC Claim Reporting; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the subject property is located. Used for state Department of Insurance regulatory reporting and jurisdiction routing.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: subrogation_potential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation identified potential subrogation or recovery rights against a third party (e.g., prior owner, agent, attorney, surveyor) responsible for the title defect.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System; NAIC Subrogation Reporting

attributes.name: subrogation_target_party
attributes.description: Name or description of the third party against whom subrogation or recovery rights may be pursued based on investigation findings. Populated when subrogation_potential_flag is true.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; Claims Administration System

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Internally assigned target date by which the investigation should be completed per SLA or claim handling guidelines. Supports aging and SLA breach reporting.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Fair Claims Settlement Regulations

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the title defect or loss (e.g., forgery, undisclosed heir, survey error, lien not released). Used for NAIC loss cause reporting and frequency/severity analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Uniform Claim Reporting; ALTA Title Risk Taxonomy

attributes.name: underwriter_opinion
attributes.description: Formal coverage opinion issued by the underwriting department following referral. Informs the final coverage determination and claim resolution strategy.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: underwriter_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigation was referred to the underwriting department for coverage opinion or risk assessment. Null if no underwriter referral was made.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: claim_curative_action_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each curative action record within the claims administration system. Primary key for the claim_curative_action entity.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.easement_restriction. Business justification: Curative actions for easement disputes, encroachments, or CC&R violations reference specific easement/restriction records.

attributes.name: encumbrance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.encumbrance. Business justification: Many curative actions resolve specific encumbrances (mortgage payoffs, lien releases, judgment satisfactions).

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Curative actions (lien releases, corrective deeds, boundary agreements) must reference the specific parcel for recording submission, legal description matching, and APN validation.

attributes.name: party_id

attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding version of this curative action record, supporting lifecycle revision history and audit trail per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: recording_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the eRecording gateway submission record (Simplifile/CSC) tracking the submission, acceptance, or rejection of the curative instrument at the county recorder.

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title insurance claim under which this curative action was initiated. Links the action to the FNOL and investigation record.

attributes.name: title_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific title defect, encumbrance, or cloud on title identified during examination or claim investigation that this curative action is intended to resolve.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued owner or lender title policy (OTP/LTP) under which coverage is being asserted and curative action is being pursued.

attributes.name: title_requirement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Schedule B-I requirement, if any, that corresponds to this curative action. Null when the action arises solely from a post-policy claim investigation.

attributes.name: underwriting_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.underwriting_title_examination. Business justification: Claim curative teams review the original examination to understand the defect's history, prior curative attempts, and whether the defect was identified but not

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting referral or policy exception record created when this curative action requires underwriter approval. Null when uw_referral_required is false.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific curative steps being taken, the parties involved, and the legal instruments or proceedings required to clear the identified defect.

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this curative action, used in correspondence with courts, county recorders, and opposing counsel. Format: CA-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the curative action: open (initiated), in_progress (work underway), pending_recording (instrument prepared, awaiting county acceptance), resolved (defect cleared), withdrawn, or escalated.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Reporting

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the curative remedy being pursued. Examples: lien release, deed correction, quiet title suit, probate proceeding, affidavit of heirship, reconveyance.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred to complete this curative action. Compared against estimated cost for reserve accuracy and loss ratio reporting.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the curative action was confirmed resolved and the underlying defect or requirement was cleared. Null if still open.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Claims Reporting

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chain of Title Break Flag (COT Break)
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underlying defect involves a break in the chain of title (COT), such as a missing grantor-grantee link, unrecorded conveyance, or vesting discrepancy.

tag_set.value: Chain of Title Break Flag (COT Break)

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated and actual cost amounts. Typically USD for domestic US title insurance transactions.

attributes.name: court_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the court or judicial jurisdiction (county, state, federal district) in which litigation for this curative action has been filed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this curative action record was first created in the claims administration system. Supports audit trail and provenance requirements.

attributes.name: curative_instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of legal instrument produced or obtained to effect the cure (e.g., release of lien, corrective deed, satisfaction of judgment, reconveyance deed, court order).
attributes.references: ALTA; County Recorder / Register of Deeds

attributes.name: days_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this curative action has been in an open or in-progress state, calculated from initiated_date. Supports curative action aging and effectiveness metrics per VREQ-016.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying title defect or encumbrance being cured (e.g., mechanics lien, judgment lien, tax lien, HOA lien, chain-of-title break, missing heir, forged deed, encroachment).
attributes.references: ALTA; NAIC Title Insurance Loss Cause Codes

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this curative action was escalated to senior underwriting counsel, litigation, or management due to complexity, aging, or reserve impact. Null if not escalated.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total cost to complete this curative action, including legal fees, court costs, recording fees, and vendor charges. Used for reserve adequacy and loss exposure analysis.

attributes.name: evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the document management system record containing supporting evidence for this curative action (e.g., signed release, court order, recorded instrument image).

attributes.name: gap_cure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curative action specifically addresses a gap period risk — the interval between the last search date and the recording of the insured instrument.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this curative action was formally initiated by the claim handler or title examiner. Used to measure curative aging and cycle time.

attributes.name: instrument_document_number
attributes.description: Official document number, book/page reference, or instrument number assigned by the county recorder upon acceptance of the curative instrument.

attributes.name: instrument_recording_date
attributes.description: Date the curative instrument was officially recorded by the county recorder or register of deeds, establishing constructive notice and clearing the defect of record.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this record represents the current active version of the curative action. False for superseded historical revisions. Supports lifecycle history per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this curative action record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lien_amount
attributes.description: Face amount of the lien, judgment, or encumbrance being cured. Used to assess claim severity and negotiate payoff or release amounts with lienholders.
attributes.references: NAIC Title Insurance Loss Cause Reporting

attributes.name: litigation_case_number
attributes.description: Court-assigned case number for quiet title actions, probate proceedings, or other litigation initiated as part of this curative action. Null for non-litigated cures.

attributes.name: outside_counsel_engaged
attributes.description: Indicates whether outside legal counsel has been retained to pursue this curative action (e.g., quiet title litigation, probate proceedings, or contested lien releases).

attributes.name: outside_counsel_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or attorney retained to handle this curative action. Populated only when outside_counsel_engaged is true.

attributes.name: payoff_amount
attributes.description: Negotiated or agreed payoff amount required to obtain a release or satisfaction of the lien or encumbrance. May differ from the original lien amount due to negotiation or accrued interest.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this curative action, reflecting urgency relative to closing readiness, policy issuance lag, or claim reserve exposure.

attributes.name: recording_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the curative instrument must be recorded with the county recorder or register of deeds to be effective against third parties and to clear the title defect.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; ALTA

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount actually recovered through subrogation, indemnification, or third-party contribution related to this curative action. Reduces net loss on the parent claim.

attributes.name: reserve_impact_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount by which this curative action affects the case reserve on the parent claim. Positive values increase the reserve; negative values reflect reserve reductions upon resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reserving Standards; State DOI

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome of the curative action, including how the defect was cleared, instruments obtained, and any residual risk or exception taken at closing.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this curative action record. Increments each time the action is materially updated (e.g., action type change, cost revision, status transition). Supports VREQ-007.

attributes.name: subrogation_potential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has identified a potential right of subrogation or recovery against a third party (e.g., prior owner, agent, or closing attorney) arising from this curative action.

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Internally committed or SLA-driven date by which the curative action is expected to be resolved. Used for aging dashboards and closing readiness reporting.

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized NAIC or underwriter-defined loss cause code categorizing the root title risk driving this curative action. Used for regulatory loss reporting and frequency/severity analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Title Insurance Loss Cause Reporting; State DOI

attributes.name: uw_referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curative action requires escalation to the underwriting department for a formal underwriting referral (UWR) or exception approval before the defect can be insured over.
attributes.references: Underwriting Risk and Policy Management System; ALTA

attributes.name: name_alias

attributes.name: power_of_attorney_indicator

attributes.name: recovery_amount

attributes.name: representation_type

attributes.description: Current resolution status of this party's involvement in the claim. Tracks progression from open through settlement, release, litigation, or subrogation to closure.

attributes.description: Deadline by which a corrected or amended regulatory loss report must be resubmitted following a rejection, as specified by the regulator.

attributes.name: statement_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year of the NAIC Annual Statement or state DOI filing to which this loss report belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this regulatory loss report was submitted to the NAIC or state Department of Insurance, per VREQ-008 date field separation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Filing Deadlines

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root cause of the title loss (e.g., undisclosed lien, chain-of-title break, forgery, encroachment, tax lien, mechanics lien). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule T; ALTA Claims Cause Codes

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_description

attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule T; ALTA Claims Cause Codes

attributes.name: total_incurred_losses_amt
attributes.description: Sum of losses paid plus change in case and IBNR reserves for the reporting period, representing total loss exposure incurred, in USD.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule T; SSAP No. 57

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Real estate transaction type underlying the insured policy: PURCHASE, REFINANCE (REFI), HOME_EQUITY (HELOC), CONSTRUCTION, or COMMERCIAL.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this regulatory loss report record in the claims administration system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: change_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created

products.name: coverage_decision
products.description: First-class coverage determination record for a title claim, capturing the formal coverage position (covered, denied, partial, reservation_of_rights, excess_only), the policy provision or exclusion relied upon (Schedule A/B reference, exclusion number

attributes.name: coverage_decision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the coverage decision record. Primary key for the coverage_decision entity within the Claims Administration System.

attributes.name: coverage_approving_authority_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor, underwriting manager, or counsel who approved the coverage decision, required when the decision exceeds delegated authority thresholds.

attributes.name: coverage_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims examiner or underwriting counsel who authored and issued the coverage determination. Primary party responsible for the decision.

attributes.name: curative_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim curative action record initiated as part of or in lieu of indemnity payment for this coverage decision.

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim investigation that produced the factual and legal basis for this coverage determination.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Coverage decisions cite Schedule A legal descriptions and exceptions tied to specific parcels.

attributes.name: prior_decision_coverage_decision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preceding coverage decision record that this record revises or supersedes. Supports lifecycle history and revision chain tracking per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: recorded_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recording.recorded_instrument. Business justification: Coverage decisions reference specific recorded instruments to determine whether defect falls within Schedule B exceptions or covered risks.

attributes.name: title_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent title insurance claim for which this coverage determination was made. Links the decision to the full claim lifecycle record.

attributes.name: title_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_commitment. Business justification: Coverage counsel analyzes the commitment to verify whether the loss cause was excepted in Schedule B, required to be satisfied, or covered.

attributes.name: title_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.title_finding. Business justification: Coverage analysis traces the claimed defect back to the original title finding to determine if it was disclosed, cured, or excepted.

attributes.name: title_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issued title insurance policy (OTP or LTP) under which coverage is being evaluated. Anchors the decision to the insuring instrument.

attributes.name: underwriting_title_examination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.underwriting_title_examination. Business justification: Coverage counsel reviews the examination to assess whether the defect was discoverable, whether the examiner exercised due care, and whether the examination scope

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriting referral record when uw_referral_required_flag is true. Links the coverage decision to the formal UW opinion.

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which the claimant must file an appeal or request reconsideration of the coverage decision, per policy terms and state regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Policy Forms

attributes.name: appeal_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which a formal appeal or reconsideration request was received from the claimant or their counsel following issuance of the coverage decision.

attributes.name: chain_of_title_break_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chain of Title Break Flag (COT Break)
attributes.description: Indicates whether a break in the chain of title (COT) is the root cause of the covered or denied loss, supporting title-specific defect analytics.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Annual Statement

tag_set.value: Chain of Title Break Flag (COT Break)

attributes.name: coverage_analysis_narrative
attributes.description: Full text of the coverage analysis explaining the legal and factual basis for the coverage position, including policy provisions, exclusions, and exceptions applied.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: coverage_position
attributes.description: Formal coverage determination outcome: covered (full indemnity), denied (no coverage), partial (limited coverage), reservation_of_rights (coverage not yet confirmed), or excess_only.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: covered_loss_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the claimed loss determined to be covered under the policy. May be less than the claimed loss amount for partial coverage decisions.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: covered_risk_number
attributes.description: ALTA policy covered risk number (e.g., Covered Risk 1, 8, 11) that affirmatively supports coverage for the claimed loss, cited in the coverage analysis.

attributes.name: curative_resolution_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage decision is conditioned on or accompanied by a curative action to resolve the underlying title defect before or after indemnity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this coverage decision record. Defaults to USD for domestic U.S. title transactions.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formal coverage position was determined and documented by the claims examiner or underwriting counsel.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: decision_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this coverage decision by the Claims Administration System. Used in correspondence and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the coverage decision. Tracks progression from initial draft through issuance, any appeal or revision, and final disposition.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the coverage decision record was created in the Claims Administration System. Supports audit trail and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: Classifies the decision as initial (first determination), supplemental (additional coverage analysis), revised (updated position), or final (closing determination).

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the primary reason for a coverage denial or limitation (e.g., known_defect, policy_exclusion, schedule_b_exception, no_insured_loss).
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the denial reason, supplementing the denial_reason_code with specific facts and policy language supporting the denial.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: denied_loss_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the claimed loss determined not to be covered under the policy. Supports partial coverage and denial analytics.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: endorsement_applicability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more ALTA endorsements attached to the policy affect the scope of coverage for this claim (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1, ALTA 22).

attributes.name: endorsement_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ALTA endorsement numbers (e.g., ALTA 9, ALTA 8.1) that expand or restrict coverage and are cited in this coverage determination.

attributes.name: exception_item_reference
attributes.description: Specific Schedule B-II exception item number or description from the issued policy that limits or bars coverage for the claimed loss.

attributes.name: excess_amount
attributes.description: For excess_only coverage positions, the dollar amount of loss that falls above the primary coverage layer and is subject to excess policy terms.

attributes.name: exclusion_number
attributes.description: Specific exclusion number from the ALTA policy form (e.g., Exclusion 3(a), Exclusion 5) cited as the basis for a denial or limitation of coverage.

attributes.name: gap_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim arises from a gap period between the effective date of the title search and the recording of the insured instrument.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the coverage decision was formally communicated to the claimant or their counsel. Distinct from the internal decision date.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the coverage decision record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage decision is associated with active or anticipated litigation, triggering legal hold and outside counsel engagement protocols.

attributes.name: outside_counsel_engaged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether outside legal counsel has been retained to support the coverage analysis, defense, or curative resolution associated with this decision.

attributes.name: partial_coverage_description
attributes.description: Narrative describing the scope and limitations of partial coverage when coverage_position is 'partial', specifying what is and is not covered.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: policy_liability_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of insurance coverage under the policy at the time of the coverage decision. Establishes the maximum indemnity ceiling for this claim.
attributes.references: ALTA Policy Forms; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy under review is an Owner's Title Policy (OTP) or a Loan/Lender's Title Policy (LTP), per ALTA policy form classification.

attributes.name: prompt_pay_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coverage decision was issued within the state-mandated prompt-pay deadline. Supports regulatory compliance monitoring and DOI reporting.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: regulatory_prompt_pay_deadline
attributes.description: State-mandated deadline by which the insurer must issue a coverage decision or payment following receipt of a complete proof of loss, per state prompt-pay statutes.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why this coverage decision was revised from the prior version, such as new evidence, appeal outcome, or change in legal interpretation.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: revision_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating the revision number of this coverage decision for the associated claim. Value 1 = initial decision; increments with each revision.

attributes.name: ror_basis_description
attributes.description: Explanation of the legal and factual basis for issuing a reservation of rights letter when coverage_position is 'reservation_of_rights', pending further investigation.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: schedule_a_reference
attributes.description: Citation to the Schedule A provision of the title policy (insured estate, vesting, legal description) relied upon in the coverage analysis.

attributes.name: schedule_b_section
attributes.description: Identifies which Schedule B section is implicated: B-I (Requirements), B-II (Exceptions), both, or none. Drives the legal basis for denial or limitation.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the jurisdiction governing the policy and coverage decision. Determines applicable state DOI regulations and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Codes; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: title_risk_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root title defect or risk giving rise to the claim (e.g., forgery, undisclosed lien, chain-of-title break, encroachment). Used for loss ratio analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ALTA Best Practices

attributes.name: uw_referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage decision required escalation to the underwriting department for a formal underwriting opinion before the position could be issued.
attributes.references: ALTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified

attributes.name: changed_by
attributes.description: User or process that last modified this record

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or process that created this record

attributes.description: Date and time when this record was created
